Train 9618 of 03/23/2022. Very dirty train. You can scan a QR code to learn about the sanitization processes in detail, but from the photos I hope to be able to upload, these processes are very far from the reality found. You have to improve, but by a lot!!!!
Train n.8503, friendly but very dirty staff.... the cleaner passes between the carriages without checking if, at least the tables, are clean.... and... I booked the "Premium" with a supplement
It's not possible that every red arrow I take is late... 20/30 minutes every single time! It also makes me miss other trains forcing me to sleep outside a few times

At the time of the resurgence of infections, Trenitalia assigned routes by treating people like sheep.... one on top of the other... Traveling from Bolzano to Rome, 10 minutes after arriving in Trento I saw a girl arrive breathlessly with a lot of luggage who said she had the seat next to me... what distances... and above all no assigned seat on the board... after a 120 euro ticket booked twenty days before

Employees are awful, the woman working on the train yelled and tried to kick me and my child out of the train because I had a regular mask and didn’t have ffp2 mask(It was not written anywhere)!!! I’m disappointed and I don’t recommand to drive with it!
If you travel from Milano to Rome or other way around you have to pay around 100 euros for a 4 hour trip at day time. There is a wifi, but you cannot connect to it, which is not very nice.
We were on the Frecce Rossa trains from Turin to Rome, certainly the Covid situation and the limitations do not help to express a totally correct opinion but overall the trip was good

In the COVID period, above all, we expect decent cleaning, but instead we took the seats of other passengers who had landed in Milan without any passage from the cleaners. We found all the tables dirty. Wi-Fi doesn't work.

Poor service, less cleanliness. Paid more than a sandwich for coffee, left a tip for the attendant.... he tells me I'll come back on the train ride back to bring you coffee... gone, first Arrow Red experience... next time Italo
I LOVE FRECCIAROSSA. What better way to travel than by train? IF NOT ON A FRECCIAROSSA???
Fast and punctual train. Thanks to the screens in the corridors, more varied entertainment than repeated weather forecasts would be pleasant

I'm sorry to write badly about this company which has been excellent many times, but for the umpteenth time the wifi doesn't work (slow or activates after a long time) Today the internet connection should be a priority to be guaranteed and it is not possible to ignore it.

Unsanitized and deeply dirty environments, both the carriages on the floor and the seats and tables. Considering that a classic ticket costs €83 minimum, I expect much, much more. Furthermore, there is no immediate control of the ticket and the green pass, so I don't understand, if someone doesn't have them, what do you do if you don't check the ticket immediately but at the end of the ride? I honestly expected more
That on board a red arrow you cannot have a hot tea.....for a fee from the bar service let's be clear....If the journey lasts 9 hours.....

I book the trip in the "silence area" carriage for the second time and for the second time I find myself on a journey that is anything but silent! I realize that, unfortunately, it depends on the misfortune of finding travelers without common sense, but I believe that some more checks should be done and what the user pays for should be guaranteed. As well as checks on the correct use of masks and application of anti-Covid measures: non-existent. Punctuality is good.

we were mistreated by the Arrow Rossa staff. They prevented us from having coconut biscuits, which were instead given to visibly older customers; instead of biscuits we were provided with cheap legume triangles. #frecciarossaisoverparty#eciscattaladenuncia
Because the lights in the bathroom did not give a spicy atmosphere it would have been more appropriate to install red lights.
It would be advisable to regulate the air conditioning. It is not normal to have to freeze for 8 hours of travel. From Calabria to Milan we froze.

"The seats, arranged in rows of 4 are covered in leather and equipped with reclining backrest up to 109 degrees" states the official website...but the seats are not reclinable, at least not mine!"free WIFI access" says the official website...BS...I had to use my own phone to connect to the internet. I picked this train for business purposes and I needed to work while travelling, hence WIFI was a selling point for me.

Disgusting! Red arrow 35520 of 11.09 from Naples to Venice, two tickets of 105.00 euros each. Train 40 minutes late and obviously bar closed. Ok, yes, but not even a paid cart service to at least have drinks. They should still notify before departure. Terrible service.
It's shameful to leave right on time and arrive 10 minutes late and lose the connection to pay all that money for nothing

Train 9532 at 12.10 on May 9th departs Rome Termini headed for Turin PN A woman from the Bordo intiner staff humiliated me with her attitude several times, abruptly reprimanding me for the mask not being placed on my nose, while I was having a snack. She passed and shook her head. Tall, brunette, short hair... About 40 years old. 129 euros to be humiliated? No thanks!

In the standard class, the Arrow Rossa 1000 has uncomfortable seats: hard, crowded, slippery, without headrests, and not reclining. It is unthinkable to set up a long-distance train in this way and sell its seats at the same prices as the other arrows; both the ordinary Arrow Rossa and the Frecciargento have seats with a minimum of padding and good reclining: for which additional services do we pay a high price on the Arrow Rossa 1000?

Ticket costs are beyond any reason, for what you pay the cleanliness should be impeccable but it isn't like everything else. In every seat I have sat down I cannot enjoy any comfort because either you find a broken seat or you find the headrest disgustingly dirty, or the window curtain doesn't work, or the current scale doesn't work etc etc. Not to mention the Wi-Fi, I have never managed to use it because it never works despite the little voice that plays on the tape on the train repeating it continuously... all this is nothing because one time out of three it is late or for one reason or another but they always make sure not to exceed the time limit for the refund... really bad experiences and I'll start by saying that I take the red arrow almost every week but unfortunately I can't do otherwise the Italian rail transport has and this is...
A little expensive, but quite comfortable and spacious places... They should offer low cost advertising campaigns.

left today 23 October 2020 at 11am from Venezia Mestre towards Milan...departure on time but from the moment I sat down in first class carriage 3, the seats vibrated in a shameful manner! who designed and built them??? I demand that in 2020 and especially in first class €55.90 there is competence and professionalism and therefore QUALITY in all respects! It's 12.29pm and everything continues to shake, sometimes more and sometimes less but continuously! Nothing shakes only when the train is stopped! I'm starting to have my stomach in turmoil and I would never want this first class trip to make me vomit in the true sense of the word!!!

It's crap. Monthly subscription but there are never any places. At least 3 or 4 times a month I am forced to pay 10 euros more for each trip to travel at the time chosen in premium. How miserable... 400 euros a month for a season ticket and they don't even reserve seats. Not to mention the delays... breakdowns... etc etc. Trains at 1pm, 53pm and 2pm ALWAYS late...I am forced to travel but as soon as Italo offers convenient fares I change company. Squalor.
Prices out of this world around €90 Rome - Milan.. With Italo round trip €89 They gave me a bag which in theory contained water, headrest mask and sanitizing gel (which wasn't there) Italo for life 😂

Despite reading several negative comments, for me it was exceptional apart from the service at the station which certainly needs to be improved. On the train, however, comfort and also a good offer of food and drinks as well as comfortable seats. Punctual and fast route as always
terrible service. a red arrow with rude and neglected staff. Instead of seeing smiling faces it seems like seeing poorly paid staff. The smile makes the difference, kindness even more.

Freccia rossa 9542 left Reggio Calabria headed for Turin. Terrible!! Meanwhile he arrived in Lamezia Terme, where we got on, 30 minutes late, we don't know what caused it. We are looking for carriage 12 which isn't there, because the train has 11 carriages. They tell us to sit in number 11, in places that aren't ours. After making 4 stops the conductor shows us the places where we can sit as they are free until Rome. Among other things, there were people who had regularly assigned seats in carriage 11 who occupied other seats, a boy lying with his feet on the seat in front who slept without a mask, to whom the conductor said nothing. Euro 67.90 this is the price for a third world trip to say the least. What precautions and safety are we talking about? What if you can sit wherever you want and stay calmly without a mask?

Terrible, DO NOT take Trenitalia (including Freccia Rossa) highly rude train chiefs and controllers, they use the little intelligence they have to rage with extreme arrogance and superiority for the "power" they have over the convoy. Beyond the filth found. (I hope it is disinfected against Covid etc. etc.) but I don't think so. I'm sorry to say it but foreigners who don't want to behave as we all know are right. Poor Italy.

Horrible, the bus was better. Departed from Turin PN ticket booked well in advance, paid for seat 18. In carriage 9, because there was only one seat near the window, I found myself in a crowded train with screaming children next to me, and elderly people snoring in front of me, all the noise with the most uncomfortable seat in the whole train. By their good grace they moved me to a seat with only a small window, waiting for someone to arrive, I hope it doesn't turn into a nightmare. Note that the Freccia Rossa has carriages with steps, that is, if you get on the regional train there is no need to lift your suitcases, while on the Frecciarossa intended for long journeys, so with heavy suitcases there are 3 steps where you have to lift the suitcase to give it weight

Almost 500 euros of return tickets and the Frecciarossa company, in an empty carriage, is lost to the customer for a small packet of snowdrop biscuits. “We can only serve those who have now arrived in Rome” ... You should be ashamed! Italo is superior in service and respect for the customer.
I'm on the train I have to use the bathroom what do you close it close it I have to get off in two hours, terrible
Carozz booked for 40 people and none present... moved to another caroza.. where there was room... and then too sprung... you couldn't stand up

I went to Rome on March 7th leaving Bologna at 8.25am.  Especially in this time of coronavirus, it bothered me to sit on greasy and worn seats (but who decided to cover them with fabric and not with washable materials?).  However, I must say that the cleanliness of the carriage and the toilet was very good.

And in short, I take a business ticket when I work. Today there are severe delays on the Naples-Rome line. Today. Yesterday too. And, not always, but often, very often it is like this: slowdowns. To the point that high speed is useless because you run but then stop. Now I say, at least, on a train where the ticket is expensive even in economy, do you want to take care of the cleanliness? Nothing. Even in business, the carriage is dirty, the seats too but above all and it is unforgivable, from the single seats you can smell a strong bad toilet smell, mixed with that of dust, mixed with that of unidentified dirt. An unbearable and slow journey for "only" 65 euros.

I wanted to compliment the organization and availability of the hostess of the return for Milan - Florence Santa Maria Novella, Valentina, and for Florence Santa Maria Novella - Perugia, Matteo, very kind and extremely helpful to all passengers.

I took a standard Frecciarossa ticket from Milan to Rome and vice versa after some time and I noticed a deterioration in the service. First of all, the seats are almost like those of regional trains, the wifi doesn't work and, above all, the travel time has been extended from 2 hours and 55 minutes, highly advertised a few years ago at the launch of the service, to 3 hours and 10. My explanation is that the company was unable to maintain these standards and therefore decided to give itself an extra quarter of an hour so as not to be forced to provide too many refunds for delays.

Our trip on the frecciarossa was asome, we were in executive class. You have so much space you can recline your seat, but not like a bed. You have a cafeteria and at your seats the train has onboard WIFI which works. You have  access to the Freccia club at the station. The Train model was a etr 1000 which is there newest model.
Travel from Bologna to Rome comfortable and fast.....almost punctual.....delayed by almost 30 minutes at destination due to a slowdown on the Bologna -Florence section.

Trip Reggio Em. AV - Naples and return. The train coming from Turin announced as 15 minutes late, then 20... arrived at the station in Reggio 35 minutes later due to an unspecified "problem with the preparation of the train". . The Wi-Fi doesn't work and consequently the "Portale Frecce" application doesn't work either, despite it being constantly advertised by a persuasive female voice throughout the duration of the journey. On the way back, the train left on time (9556 carriage 6 of 01/22/2020) but here too there was no sign of life from the Wi-Fi. To complicate the situation, both toilets in the car were closed, because they were evidently unusable, without any of the staff bothering to point it out with a sign. Speaking with passengers who use Frecciarossa trains more frequently than me, it emerged with resignation that these mix-ups have now become a constant. In the past, I have traveled 2-3 times/year with Frecciarossa trains, obtaining a much better impression. Sin! The current feeling is that of being faced with a slow but progressive deterioration in the quality of service.  .

Fantastic train, punctual, excellent executive seats, unfortunately the service was a disaster, the poor waiter, perhaps it was his first trip!  he had difficulty serving, there were 6 of us in the carriage, he brought a plate, then a glass and again a plate and again a glass. My wife was able to have lunch half an hour after my dish arrived, the quality of the food was excellent. However, I repeat, a nice trip

Took the Rome to Naples, Rome to Florence, Florence to Venice, Venice to Rome.  All trips were business class.  These trains are clean, quiet, fast, and smooth.  All of the train staff were polite and friendly.  Can’t wait to ride Frecciarossa again.
Bartender today rude and rude, high prices (in bars) seats a little dated, with what the ticket costs you could do more

After taking Italo on the outward journey, on the return journey we take the red arrow Turin-Rome to return, the train was stopped at the station in Turin, but I must say that it was not very clean even if they had time to fix everything, I took the second premium class (it costs more than Italo's 1st class) and the seats were not very comfortable, the drink/snack service only came once for a 4 hour long journey (Italo went from Florence to Turin 2 times) Furthermore, I used the bar/restaurant and even though the train was not full, there was almost nothing left to eat, in conclusion I didn't find myself very well. I thought much better for Trenitalia's flagship service.

First time on the red arrow Naples Brescia 9658. I'll just say the seat near the window was extremely uncomfortable, very cramped with one arm on my neighbor, no possibility of stretching my legs, I had to move (luckily there was a free seat near it towards the centre. Cold air on the neck. In the tunnel they block their ears. For the record everything else was fine. But the purpose of a train is not just to take you to your destination. Italo is better compared to what I wrote. Have a good trip to everyone.

It is a high-speed train that we use to go from Rome to Florence in 1 hour and 25 minutes. The seats are very comfortable with a table to charge your cell phone and there is also a cafeteria. The one-way price was 29 euros and the return price was 27.

Rome, Firenze, Venice and Milan. Beautiful, large stations, everything very practical. You buy your tickets online and need to arrive 15 minutes before boarding. Everything punctual and efficient. High-speed trains with good comfort, reaching speeds of up to 300km/h. Much more practical than flying due to the location of the railway stations.

After having booked the round trip to Rome (New Year's Eve) in a travel agency for us and our dog and having paid a huge sum for the dog (for us around 130 euros for the return trip and for the dog 90 euros) and therefore in a relationship that was madness, once we got on the train we had to keep the dog between us between us between our seats for the entire journey... so it was a very uncomfortable journey... Unfortunately, the service was terrible also because if the children were up to a total of years they have not paid since they are not entitled to a seat I don't see why I have to pay for the dog which ditto is not entitled to a seat...among other things the price of the ticket is 50% of that of the person with a business fare or 1st class...while we traveled in economy...which is inconceivable...Next time I have absolutely no intention of paying any ticket for my dog unless the conditions change...Know this!!! I hope this message is useful for those traveling with our brothers animals!!

I often travel for work and whenever I can I do it by train to make the most of the time, I must say that the level of the Frecciarossa is clearly superior to that of the same category in Spain, Germany and Poland Spain: Short routes therefore with limited delays Wi-Fi introduced only a few months ago and poorly functioning, uncomfortable seats, unkept environments, first class too expensive, bathrooms often dirty, prices high service Germany: poor or no Wi-Fi, dirty interiors, and smelly (many have carpet!!), expensive and very often late Poland: New trains, clean but they travel on the standard network so they are not high speed, Wi-Fi not working, first class too expensive
departure and arrival on time, good cleanliness of the carriages, room for improvement. good travel comfort. wi fi not very active
The carriages are certainly comfortable. The service on board is also good, both cleaning and catering. Unfortunately, delays on the Rome-Naples route are very frequent.
Good train on the Naples-Rome connections, unfortunately the service is not excellent due to the on-board wifi, cleanliness is good but all services could be improved

For about 2 years I have been witnessing a slow and inexorable decay of our state railways and in particular Frecciarossa. Even if you travel in first class and pay a high price for the ticket, you receive in exchange a terrible service with terrible products and often without Wifi.

Great trains: Punctual, good value, comfortable and fast. Easy to book online through Trenitalia (watch out for third party sites with nearly the same name), print out your ticket - no need then to validate on the platform - or just quote the PNR code shown on the ticket to the controller, or show on your mobile phone. Love travelling with Frecciarossa!
It's the fourth time I've taken the Frecce Rossa to travel the Rome-Turin route and it's the fourth time it's been delayed. Terrible service. I only take it because I have to.

I wanted to thank Mr. Marcello Patrizi aboard the red arrow 9653 from central Milan to Rome Termini. He took care of us travelers with accuracy, professionalism, kindness, courtesy. Very competent and patient. Thank you Marcello Mara

Traveled with a friend for the first time on the Turin Florence line in less than three hours. Friendly staff, nothing to say, efficient service (if we want to dot the i's on the return he arrived 7 minutes late, but personally it didn't matter to me, even if we are actually talking about a service that should guarantee punctuality...) Clean bathroom, there were always cleaners checking... I didn't use the bar service. I'm satisfied with the service, thanks to Frecciarossa I was able to visit the splendid Florence, taking advantage of a same-day return discount.

I'm writing this negative review because we wanted to eat on the first class train and it wasn't possible.... After bringing us the menu as soon as we said goodbye, no one was seen to take the orders. When it was time to serve ourselves the drinks we asked if we could order but they told us it wasn't possible because they had to finish drinking first. We went to complain at the bar and they told us (also making us look stupid..) that they had stopped by but they didn't want to disturb us!! There are 3 of us adults so we are also wide awake. Our booking numbers are: WF4HNN Thanks for your reply Ps. Much better Italo Luigina Bernini

We often hear about the high European standards for train services, but we have this... and it works! It happens that there are delays, but in most cases it doesn't happen! The staff is KIND, COMPETENT, and ACTIVE! We just have to hope that this service can be extended throughout the national territory!

As a family of 5 we traveled from Naples to Florence on the 9524 service yesterday.  I splashed out some extra dollars to let the rest of the family experience their first time on a bullet train in first class (executive class is the top class in Italy).  I think it was something like 625Euro for 5 people. The carriage and the seats are very roomy, but some had some functionality issues eg foot rests wouldn't raise, charging port didn't work.  The service was just OK, friendly but not attentive.  Empty bottles and wrappers sat on tray tables, no one asked if we would like a second drink, some of the menu items were unavailable.Its certainly not the same as my experience with first class on bullet trains in Japan but it was a nice treat and made the trip a bit more special.  For a one off experience it was good but if travelling again I wouldn't spend the extra money.

The trip was quick and reasonably comfortable. The space was good for those with small to medium bags. The only problem was that my ticket was from Rome to Florence and we couldn't find our train on the notice board and discovered that it said Rome-Milan (with a stop in Florence in smaller letters). The platform only appears about 15 minutes beforehand. You need to pay attention. And take care of your belongings because the train terminal is an absurd movement. My ticket didn't need to be validated, but most of them need to be validated in machines spread across the terminal before getting on the train. If you have bags that don't fit in the luggage rack, be careful if there are stops and when you are leaving the train.

Arrived in Rome in style. Booked executive and that got us a lounge access in Santa Maria Novella.The staff at the lounge were sweet. Wifi toilet and some snacks.Train was comfy. Just a ride over 2 hours- but well stocked and got our lunch and wine on board. Service was great - but food was lacking quality. We ordered Milanese rissotto and it was hard and insipid.Ride is awesome and best way to get to Rome.

Can’t really complain about the trip from Naples to Florence. Seats are comfortable in business. Train was pretty much on time. Didn’t like the lack of baggage space. You need to be strong to lift your suitcases into the racks. Staff were no different to the staff on our trains back home so didn’t expect too much really. It’s the quickest way to travel as driving takes longer and direct intercity flights in Italy are lacking. Also at least there are fast trains unlike other places.

The business class is equipped with a silence room and a working room. The first is very comfortable, the seats are in leather, comfortable... Not everyone is silent, but we try to respect the rule! (I have never listened to a phone call) Definitely recommended! The working room is practical, but very uncomfortable if you are traveling with a large 4-wheeled suitcase, because there is no space to store it and consequently with the curves, it risks falling and moving, making it difficult for you to relax! Not to mention the back pain, because you are not facing forwards. They also offer you a bottle of water, along with other drinks, all accompanied by pretzels, chips and even sweets! They don't give you the newspaper!!

I hadn't taken a train since 1993, so since I had to reach Turin I thought of buying an executive ticket with the red arrow. Despite my doubts about the service and comfort. I must say that I changed my mind, as I found extremely kind and super professional staff that I thought was there. So if this review of mine were to be useful in improving the service, I would like to point out the hostess Azzurra as a very helpful, very efficient person who makes the most of train travel. She also took care of my children by constantly offering them drinks, as if she were their mother. In conclusion I would like to congratulate the careful selection that Trenitalia subjects to its collaborators. Well done Azzurra!!

I usually try to travel on business and use the Frecciarossa from Reggio Emilia to Rome for work, and I have always been happy, almost always, except once due to a problem on the line we were several minutes late. The trip was perfect last time too, on the way back I took the 7pm ride and my carriage was practically deserted. The staff, including the bar staff, are extremely professional and kind. Alexander.

We thoughly enjoyed our Frecciarossa trip from Naples to Rome and back.  The trip was a little more than an hour each way.  The seating area was very comfortable.  The ride was smooth and the scenary very nice.  We look forward to the next time we take this train.

It's already the third time that traveling with Frecciarossa I've paid extra to choose a seat and someone is already sitting there asking me to change for some reason such as children/dog/various reasons. There is therefore no point in paying extra to choose your seat because not everyone does it and those who don't, for socially unassailable reasons, ask you to change! The controllers say nothing and there is total anarchy! At this point, Italo is better where you can't choose your seat in any way but at least you know it right away (and maybe you don't plan to work on the train in a single seat) and you pay less for the ticket!

This year we decided to use the Frecciarossa for the outward journey for our holidays, very punctual in leaving, good service on board, friendly bar staff, the conductor, clean bathrooms, but the seats were uncomfortable, hard and then there is little space for the legs, the intercity is more comfortable. My destination was Sapri, after Naples too many stops you get the impression that it becomes a regional one.

We utilized the “Red Arrow” for a one-way trip from Venezia Santa Lucia to Firenze Santa Maria Novella on April 7. This should have been called the “Broken Arrow”. We departed Venice on time aboard Frecciarossa 9419 at 1025 and had a great ride until about 1150 when we pulled into the siding at Castel Maggiore due to “technical issues”, read that as “the train broke”. We finally were underway again at 1215 and arrived Florence S.M.N 38 minutes late at 1308. Other than the technical issue delay, it was a pleasant ride and they did keep us informed as to our departure from the siding. Price for 3 people was €85,70.

The attitude of the train conductor and another employee was disgusting after (I) having been locked in the bathroom for a long time, feeling sick to my stomach, once I came out they both scolded me for occupying the bathroom for an hour! They scolded, raising their voices and making me ashamed in front of the whole carriage. I explained my problems but they repeated the same things to me a second time, in short they scolded me and made me feel ashamed because I was locked in the bathroom with a stomach ache. Then when I asked for tea, the conductor replied "go and get it from the bar in the carriage over there" SHAME IT IS REALLY SHAME!!! WITH WHAT YOU CHARGE WHICH IS REALLY THEFT, YOU EVEN TREAT PEOPLE LIKE THIS! SHAME ON YOU. BITTERNESS...

Took the metro from our hotel in Rome to the main train station (Termini) where we boarded the Tren Italia Frecciarossa to Venice. It is a good, reasonably priced way to travel to Venice. The train lets you out right on the grand canal in Venice and you can grab any number of water transport to you hotel. We had four reserved seats in a regular (economy) coach car (carriage), a 2 and 2 configuration facing each other across a small table. The seats were clean and comfortable with just enough room. There was room in the overhead for our luggage. There are outlets at each seat. The train has free WiFi but the performance is pretty low. If I was reading the stats correctly the train reached speeds of about 250km/hour (~150mph) during our roughly 4 hour ride. The scenery of the countryside along the way was really nice. The small snack bar car ran out of a number of items early in the trip and we think they should have planned their stock better. Be aware that some of the platforms are a long walk from the central hall and they don’t give too much advanced notice on which platform your train will be on when it comes in.
We paid $70 AUD for a 1 hour one way trip to Bologna and there was no air conditioning. Entire trip was a sweat box. Up your game Italian Public Transport!

Incredible, I take the Frecciarossa expecting a quality train, the seats are made of marble, very uncomfortable. Better an old intercity with seats (ah but that way there would have been fewer seats). So you pay more for less. Among the worst trains ever used.
We bought tickets in advance and train service was excellent. From Rome to Florence in 1h12 mins ! Enough space for large traveling bags. Toilets available which was important with a 5 yr old !

We took a round trip from Rome to Naples. The train ride was awesome and very comfortable. But, Naples is a nasty and dirty city. Trash everywhere, seen what looked to be human feces in several places, unless dogs learned how to relieve themselves up next to the walls in that part of the country. Wife also got here Iphone pick pocketed while shopping.

We had a great  trip recently on the Red Arrow fast train ( Frecciarossa) from Rome to Bologna. I booked online some months earlier through ItaliaRail website and just printed my tickets at home. It was really easy and I would advise booking early to get good fares. Rome Terminii station is easy to navigate and Bologna was great too, with plenty of taxis available. We chose to train to Bologna and collect our rental car after 3 nights in Bologna as it is a walled city and you would not want ( or in fact need) a car in Bologna.

Everything comfortable and clean, very kind staff. But out of a total of 7 executive people (€170/person), almost all the dishes were already finished so we divided the last remaining mozzarella and changed the dishes (the sea bass and the homemade pasta with tomatoes and aubergines together with the mozzarella were already finished). The suggestion is to order X first courses 😊

Departure from central Milan and arrival in Rome Termini on time. I booked the ticket a month in advance to take advantage of the Super Economy offer. Given the small price difference between the Standard class and the Business class (Super Economy on offer) I decide to buy a Business ticket. At the time of departure I go to the platform and get on carriage number 2. The interior of the carriage is well looked after and the leather seats are reclining and comfortable. About 10/15 minutes after departure, two staff pass by with a trolley and offer me a newspaper (distributed only in the morning), a mini bottle of water, a drink of your choice, a snack (sweet or savory) and a refreshing wipe. Inside the carriage there is free Wi Fi, on-board monitor with travel information and entertainment, and ample space for suitcases. The products at the bar are of high quality and hot dishes are also available. The toilets are also clean. Excellent service, absolutely recommended for both work and holidays!

We took Frecciarossa from Rome to Florence, Florence to Venice and Venice to Rome. We were in what is called "Executive Class" and it was very comfortable. The food choice is a bit over hyped, but the service was attentive. We were early to our train in Florence, so we hung out in their lounge area. There were free drinks and ice cream available which was nice. The accommodations in the lounge were average for these type of lounges.
Round trip on time! Cleanliness good, coffee for €1.50 in paper cups but no! Clean bathrooms

I had already traveled with Frecce Rossa with positive results. Last round trip Milan Florence terrible experience. On the outward journey we were 50 minutes late, on the return we were 20 minutes late and the carriage was dirty. The cleaner passed by and didn't bother to empty and clean the table.

We were in Rome in may and traveled round trip to Naples on the Trentitalia Frecciarossa high speed train line.We purchased business premium tickets which enabled us to have  pre assigned high back leather seats.This class also got us a beverage and small snack for the 1 hr and 7 minute journey.Overall we were very satisfied with the service and on time performance for our roundtrip to Naples Cental station.This is the 4th time we have used  the Trentitalia when in Italy and it's high speed train line and would highly recommend it to future travelers.Best travels,John C.

I don't think I'm the first nor the last to have to travel due to a family bereavement. Are you ready to pay a higher amount than necessary to reach your destination as quickly as possible, 2nd class sold out; ok I'll take 1st... at the ticket office they tell you about the lounge... 228 euros for 2 tickets, I can't wait to get on and sit in an armchair to rest a little since I've just got off the night shift... and where do I find myself? on a chair that swivels... it's not the most comfortable (not to mention safe). I'm speechless... We need a little more attention towards last minute travellers
We were so excited to try the Frecciarossa trains. Upgraded to first class-large, comfortable seats. So smooth couldn't believe we were travelling so fast!

We pre-booked our business class reservation more than a month prior to the date of our travel. It is recommended you book as far in advance as possible due to the cost of reserving seats when doing it late/last minute. We used our Eurail passes for this trip which meant the reservation was an additional 20 Euro. To book these tickets on the day you are looking at 80+ Euro. Our train took us from Florence to Salerno, stopping 3 times in Rome and Naples before arriving in Salerno. The highest speed reached was 300km/hr which was really cool to experience.Business class gets you complimentary snacks and soft drinks, juice or tea/coffee. We did not purchase any meals, I'm not actually sure if they would have been included in our passes or not.We ensured we were at the boarding platform half an hour prior to departure which gave us plenty of time to find our platform and board the train. Tickets are inspected once you have boarded and have been sitting a short while. In business class the seats can lay back, there is plenty of storage room above the seats, behind the seats at the ends of aisles and also under seats for smaller bags/purses.There is a rubbish bin and charging point as well as tray table for each person.Overall no complaints and wish we had this type of travel in Australia.
They might as well get rid of "human waste" before each outing. How disgusting to have to go to the bathroom and see mountains of shit the entire way. And there was no water!

We rode the “Red Arrow” on 03/31 for a day trip to Milan from Venice and return. We departed Venice on time at 0720 and arrived in Milan on time. No issues on this leg at all. It was a pleasant, smooth, quiet ride in 2nd class standard. We booked these tickets in January for travel on the last day of March. Price each way per person was €27,90.On the return journey from Milan, the only issue was that one of the toilets in our coach was OOC. Other than this little glitch, both legs of the roundtrip were without incident and on time. If you are traveling between major cities within Italy, this is a very good and inexpensive option. Book early and save.

Excellent service in business courtesy excellent hospitality and service. Recommended for those who want to reach Milan from Rome in a short time and with a high level of service. Trenitalia top arrow

The Frecciarossa belongs to a family of high-speed trains that connect the most important cities in Italy. Our experience takes shape in a trip from Rome to Florence, very fast, with a journey time of an hour and a half, in a very comfortable car with air conditioning, spacious seats and plenty of space to leave luggage. The price of the ticket per person, €25.90 with reserved seat. The trip passed without anything to report and was very punctual. A very good experience, nothing comparable, of course, to the disastrous, uncomfortable and unpunctual regional trains of this country.
Watch out for the red arrow, to limit the delay he didn't give us time to get off and we were with a 3 year old girl. They made us continue and diverted to a regional one. Disgust

Excellent service and punctuality. Comfortable seats (for 2 people on each side and a table in the middle). They have a plug to charge cell phones and PC batteries. The hallways are wide for circulation, impeccable bathrooms. Luggage is left when entering the car. From Rome Termini to Firenze S. M. Novella one hour and a half, worth Euros 19.90. From Firenze to Venice Santa Lucia 2 hours, Euros 24.90. From Firenze Campo Di Marte to La Spezia Centrale Euros 9.90. If purchased for Internet and in advance, you get better prices. I recommend it,
From Mi Centrale to Fi SMN in two hours at a constant speed of three hundred km/h. One doesn't even notice it. Smooth as silk...

I rode from Florence to Venice. A mysterious man was sitting in my seat, but when I told him it was my seat, he disappeared somewhere. After a while, 300ml water bottles, juice, and snacks were handed out. The seats were a combination of 4-person seats with tables facing each other, and 2-person seats, so you could relax and enjoy the feeling of traveling. I think it's definitely more comfortable than Italo for traveling in the countryside. However, there wasn't much space for luggage, and even though there were almost no passengers, I had trouble finding a place to store my luggage. I can't leave it on the seat because there might be a passenger coming at the next station, and the deck might be stolen.

we had so much trouble  Had a booking confirmation and everything and then they say their is no booking.  They aren't interested in following their own policies and procedures and their customer service staff are rude and unhelpful.  I ended up with a booking that I had to pay  A LOT OF ADDITIONAL MONEY FOR!! Please don't use these people, enjoy your break without the worry of companies like this

In comparison, Italo can be considered an excellence! Definitely dirty, especially the bathrooms... The Wi-Fi never works therefore... if I pay for it in the ticket I should be refunded. On a positive note, the staff is friendly

Preferable to Italo for cleanliness, even if the ticket costs more. In second class, uncomfortable, narrow and hard seats. The headrest incorporated into the seat is non-existent for the use for which it was designed: difficult to relax. Wi-Fi doesn't work 9 times out of 10 and when it works it's painfully slow. You have to get on among the first to avoid having problems with places for your suitcases. The on-board staff is polite, smiling and kind. The call center is incompetent: it is useless to call.

Terrible booked 18 seats after an hour of travel they still haven't given us a seat due to a problem they have canceled a carriage for the restaurant car we are almost in Florence and not everyone has a seat. Never again. Usual state railways. Italooooo

Easy to use and very comfortable.  It was super fast, my son loved watching the speed on the screen.  In premium class you get a snack and drink included, which was great except that they made my tea with lukewarm water!
The red arrow is always a guarantee. The trip is super fast and comfortable. I really recommend it even if the prices are high.
My girlfriend and I purchased two return tickets from Rome Termini to Naples Central and the journey was very comfortable. It took us just over an hour to arrive.

Being first time travellers on Italian train, we were a bit uncertain. The info on other comments were not helpful. So we want to help others:1. If you buy europass, you need to get europass validated at the station itself on the day of first travel. 2. We bought our europass in august and it was mailed to us in Singapore. It has first validation stamp. 3. We need to get the second validation stamp. Before doing that, fill in passport number. Fill in start day - for first day of travel. Ours is flexi 1 month pass. Do not fill in end date. It would be filled by the station inspector when they validate. 4.  The validation is done at the ticket office. Get a queue number. When your turn, need to produce passports to prove identity. We went in early morning to validate. It took us 5 mins. 5.  We have reserved train seats on business class. With e tickets we do not need to validate the e tickets. 6. Recommended : 15mins before train arrival the platform number should appear. 7.  Boarding is straightforward. They do check tickets onboard. 8. And to help other travellers. The business class overhead is sufficient for 24” luggages. See our photo. 9. Complimentary drinks provided. Seats are very comfortable. Ride is smooth and comfortable. Highly recommended. For roma termini, do be careful as there are  suspicious people who follow others. We try to keep our backs to walls most of the time. Be alert.

I had already made a return journey from Rome to Turin and was pleasantly happy.... welcomed by a warm and welcoming environment..... yesterday's experience turned out to be anything but..... cold environment and very dirty toilets.....we who pride ourselves on our "being clean"!!!! I'm ashamed to imagine what the 2 English boys who were in our carriage might have thought.

I thought I'd do a review of the top of the Frecciarossa category: the EXECUTIVE. First of all, let's clarify... it has a nice cost :-) We're talking about Milan/Rome at 155 euros each way (so round trip 310)... then it depends on when you buy it, if there are promotions, etc. but in general, to give you an idea, this is the value I usually pay. However, the service is excellent and is undeniable: apart from having included access to the station (in Milan and Rome) to the Freccia Club (I attach photos of the one in Rome) which is very comfortable and functional for waiting and allows you to eat and drink for free, the executive carriage is comfortable and spacious (I attach photos). The service of the staff is very attentive and in the morning you can have breakfast while for lunch and dinner you can eat with a limited but good offer of dishes (and partly selected by Cracco). Obviously always included in the price.

Red Arrow is a Russian-like train name, but unlike those, the design of the train is modern. I feel that the service is a little inferior to its rival Italo, but it's better to be early, and if you buy tickets early once you have decided on your itinerary, you can get cheaper tickets even though you cannot change them. It is an essential vehicle for traveling within Italy.

In September 2018, we had a two-week trip around Italy. Rome-Florence-Venice-Milan. Initially, the plan was to fly to Rome, rent a car in which to drive. However, it turned out that not all hotels booked (particularly in Venice) have parking. And when I calculated the cost of car rental and parking, and also read reviews from tourists on this topic about traffic jams, toll roads, etc., I abandoned this idea and decided to use high-speed trains. We bought tickets in advance more than three months before the trip in first class. Their cost was more than 50% cheaper than buying on the day of departure. The trains turned out to be wonderful. The inside is clean. The chairs are comfortable. There are tables between the chairs. They serve water for free, and for an additional fee you can buy chips, nuts, soda, juice and newspapers. There is Internet, but the speed is weak. The main thing is the speed. On some in sections the speed is up to 300 km/h. Fields fly past and it is impossible to see what is growing on them. I looked into the second class carriages at the station through the window. In my opinion, the whole difference is in the lack of tables - in the second class there are none.

WORST SERVICE EVER!! Catch a bus or another train company.Not only do the trains always run late but the platform number is indicated that it arrives only 5 minutes before it does. If your a person with disabilities or have young children it is physically impossible to arrive to your platform.I missed my train by 10 seconds and the doors closed as I reached the train and they didnt open the doors.THEY DID NOT REFUND 70 EURO I was forced to buy a new ticket.The customer servise lady could not care less.I am EXTREMELLY DISSAPOINTED!

Nowadays for work I often travel with the High Speed ​​Frecciarossa, a solution that I personally prefer over the plane, especially for same-day return trips which enjoy very attractive fares. Based on my experience, I would like to recommend two things to TA friends: 1. If you have to make connections, always guarantee yourself a sufficient amount of time to orient yourself in the stations (Bologna for example is a vertical labyrinth) and to compensate for any train delays (which, despite what you might think, are not few).2. Although the Frecciarossa 500 is the older version of the 1,000, it is still preferable to the second because it is much more comfortable and nothing changes in terms of travel times.

Round trip from Turin to Rome. All good, modern train, clean, with worthy toilets and equipped with everything you need (finally!). We always traveled on time despite the stereotypes. The only flaw is the wifi really NOT working. In 2018 with so many foreigners and people working with PCs and tablets on board it's a bit of a shame.

Traveling to Rome: expected three hours, but a delay of half an hour, both on the outward and return journey. For the rest, always a nice journey, comfortable and pleasant. Just one (fussy?) note: information on delays expressed with the symbol m is provided on the screen (and every engineering physics student knows that m is a symbol of meters and not minutes). No one dies due to Trenitalia's inaccuracy, but it is confirmed that even the minimal notions of science take root in this country in a weak and difficult way.

We booked our train tickets about 10 days ahead of time online. All the round trips from Rome to Milan, Venice, and Naples were special fare due to the fact that our travel period in late April had promotional prices on train tickets (Italian holiday period promotions).  We were lucky to be able to get the buy one way and get return trip back free offers to Milan, to Venice and to Naples.One of our other trips from Rome to Florence was booked two days before our departure date online, so the fare was more  expensive . Always book it ahead of time to enjoy the lower price and seat selections. Overall, the trains are very comfortable and the seats are comfortable. Most of the trains had clean restrooms. Many of the trains we rode stopped in the middle of the journey for 10-25 minutes at time due to 'technical issues' or traffic related delays.Many of the trains also left 15-20 minutes late and changed platforms last minute . This happened many times on our journeys, resulting in late arrivals , so don't expect on time arrivals or departures with these trains. Also remember that the departure platforms will often not be known until about 10 minutes before departure , so watch the schedule displays to find your platform #.

Six of us had Business Class tickets on Train #9526 Rome to Florence on Sept 9/18.  The staff was not friendly and we when they served the lunch and wine, we were not informed that it would be at an additional charge.  The lunch which we received was called a "club sandwich" of which the bottom of the bread was wet and soggy.  Had we of known that we were going to be charged 54Euros, we would have sent it back.  Instead we took one bite and threw it out.  The wine however was drinkable.  This was a huge rip-off.

Really fast quiet and on time, comfy leather seats with a table in the middle.(four people). also a drink and snack was served and was in the price.......great service  and not dear. We travelled Rome -Florence- Venice.

Round trip Turin / MestreIn executive with the whole family. Outbound with the FRECCIAROSSA 1000, a fairytale, clean, warm and welcoming environment, perfectly air conditioned and excellent service, kindness and courtesy from all the staff on board. Return also pleasant but not with the FRECCIAROSSA 1000. Also in this case the cleanliness, service and courtesy are good. ONLY sore point, In Turin Porta Susa, the Frecciaclub doesn't open before 7.00 and we couldn't use it....If the FRECCIAROSSA travel all day, the club has to follow them......

I rode twice between Venice and Florence and Florence and Rome. I made a reservation in Japan about 3 months in advance from the official English website. Since I was able to reserve a seat, I chose a seat near the luggage storage area where I could place my suitcase. It's near the entrance. There were early bird discounts and Sunday discounts for three people, so I was able to get a great deal. This ticket was easy to use, as there was no need to hold it up against a special machine to stamp it before boarding the train, and just get on the train and have it checked inside the train. The economy premium seats you reserved come with water, juice, snacks (you can choose between cookies and potato chips), and a newspaper. There was a shop and cafe next to the 6th car I boarded.

We are a family of 5 with teenagers. We have spent the last 4 days in Rome with a further 4 days planned in Venice.We arrived at the termini in Rome with plenty of time to spare. This place beats the UK hands down, it's like an airport rather than a train station.Lots of shops and cafés. Displays everywhere. I downloaded the train app which came in useful to track the route and final destination.We opted for business class and I must say its well worth the money. I thought this was a bargain. Would highly recommend using this mode of transport to visit Venice

We took the train during our first trip to Italy and unfortunately it was during the snow “storm” so there were a bunch of trains cancelled due to the snow. That is understandable but there was NO STAFF willing to help us to determine what train to take... we were bushed from one staff members to another. Our tickets were purchased in advance and non-refundable so we were told we had to get on another train. When I asked an attendant if we were about to get on the right train he put his hand up to my face and walked away. One of the local residents saw this and did her best to direct us in the right direction (we were so grateful she was there at that very moment). We finally got onto the right train but all the announcements were in Italian (no english translation like other trains had). In Italian they were saying our stop was not accessible because of the snow and to get off at the stop before and take the subway. The only reason we found this out was another couple was going to the same destination as us and asked a local if the next stop was correct. If they had not of said anything, we would have stayed on the train, going hours past our intended destination. Needless to say we were not impressed, regardless of the conditions a companies customer service should never be sacrificed.

I have made many trips for work with Frecciarossa but in the last two years they have dropped in level. The bar has very little choice and is really excessively expensive. But the most important thing is that the toilets are often dirty or broken, even in first class, while the price increases! The wi-fi doesn't work very well. However, the staff is always helpful and professional, there is the Trenitalia magazine on every seat.

How can a service with so much potential be so awful??  They have comfortable fast trains that travel between 250-300kms/h all over Italy. Talking to other frequent travelers on the train all experienced the same logistics nightmares at stations. EVERY time we have caught a train there has been multiple platform changes with only minutes to spare or you don't know what platform till 5 minutes before. The stress for a tourist at the stations is terrible.The other issues are in SOME carriages no where for luggage... it is a litigation waiting to happen when someone hurts themselves lifting heavy luggage up on above seat racks while at the same time fighting people for space. This service could be so much better.  The people running this system I hope never run an airport, imagine that.

On our travels around Italy, we rode the “Red Arrow” a couple of times for the long haul runs. This review is of the trip from Firenze S. M. Novella to Veniezia Mestre on 03/24. We traveled on train number 9412, 2nd Premium class, coach 6, seats 7C, 7D, 8D, departing Florence on time at 1030. On either end of the car is a large area for luggage storage, along with an overhead rack for your smaller items. We had no problem stowing our 3 large suitcases. Shortly after departing the station, the attendants came through with cart service offering coffee, water and snacks. We took advantage of all 3.  The seating was 4 chairs around a central table. As we had purchased our tickets online in advance, we did not have to validate our vouchers. We arrived in Mestre on time at 1223.The total for 3 tickets, 2nd Premium from Florence to Mestre was €119,70. Overall a nice way to travel long distances between large cities.

First train trip with my daughter! Turin-Rome. What can I say? Beautiful . I don't understand these numerous criticisms. Perfect time. Very competent and helpful staff on board. Exemplary cleanliness. We don't always have to look for the needle in the haystack. And above all we travelers must set an example of education. The only negative thing was the rudeness of a traveler. I saw him stick chewing gum (we were in business) under the table. And I pointed it out. His answer? Mind your own business. He was in a suit and tie! Without words .

This was our first high speed ride and we enjoyed it . Super fast , silent, smooth ride, clean, comfortable, functional diner, clean wash rooms, on-time, great views and polite attendants. Since we had no luggage we didn't have a problem, otherwise one feels there is no space for luggage in the compartment. Overhead space is too small for big bags.

I traveled with Frecciarossa from Naples to Milan and everything went perfectly. The new trains with comfortable seats are incredibly quiet and fast. Punctuality both on the outward and return journey, friendly and professional staff. Honestly it was a pleasant surprise.

Frecciarossa Train - Venice to RomeWe booked Business class tickets on special on their website that cost less than standard Economy tickets.Overall a great travel experience (less than half the price of flying and far more comfortable and more or less same time it would take if you did fly)

We used the whole list of trenatalia trains as part of our eurail pass and it was not pleasant. The staff members were very unfriendly and would talk about you in Italian if you make a request (clearly shouting at you).  Some of the trains had no luggage compartments so you had to sit with it. One type of trains (I think it was the Frecce) only had luggage compartment overhead. I'm sorry but when a 50 kg female traveller is travelling with a huge luggage that weighs 20 kg, she's not going to be able to lift that up. It's just not designed very well. If you plan to use it, bring small bags.

Nice train cabinBut no space for a medium large suitcaseOnly overhead thing in which you have to place your own suitcaseNo portersCoach ticket agent had an attitude when I asked what to do with suitcaseI have been traveling 6 weeksNot a backpacker I have a suitcase. This is the only train I have been on that did not have a place for my suitcase.Train wasn't fullSo I squeezed it into empty seat leg room space next to my seat.What would have happened otherwise The wifi service on board was not working
Good and fast transport as we did a day trip between Grosseto and Rome. Easy to redeem tickets in machines at the station.
Rude and incompetent train conductor. Nauseating smell and broken air conditioning for almost the entire trip. Italo offers a much better service, as well as qualified and friendly staff.
I traveled for work on the Frecciarossa Naples Rome. The train was comfortable, quiet and above all it arrived on time. Worth noting is the ability to quickly change your booking online.

This is an incredible travel option through the major Italian centres of Milan/Venice/Florence/Rome/Naples.Take Business Class level.  We had 3 adults and paid for the cost of 2 due to the current pricing special(Prebooked online).The train was exceptionally clean, lots of room to stretch out, great toilet facilities and even had a good and beverage and food dedicated carriage. The staff were multi lingual and very friendly.  Wow.  If only the Airlines offered this type of service in their premium economy flights then distance travel would be so much more enjoyable for the price point.Italian Rail congrats to you this service is a winner all round.

I usually travel by executive on the Turin-Rome route. I recently traveled in executive from Venice. Attention:: be aware that there is no service. There is no lunch and dinner service, there isn't even an attendant. An attendant arrives and gives you a simple snack. Trenitalia does not say this when purchasing the ticket. You might as well buy a premium ticket, you will get the same service.

From Turin to Rome Termini via Milan in about 4 hours although on the way back there was a technical problem in Milan which created a delay of about 30 minutes. The premium formula gives the daily newspaper in the morning with a snack drink, water and coffee.

High speed but on board it is very uncomfortable... narrow seats, especially the blocks of 4 says if you find yourself with a person in front there is no space for your legs... you arrive in Milan tired

Second time took the train. First time past year from Milano to Venice. This year from Florence to Rome. Very smooth and fast. This is the train you have to take in Italy for great service and reliability. Easy booking thru internet.

A marvel (actually we traveled on the Italo which is the same) 300 km\h that doesn't even feel like it, excellent service, free WiFi the entire journey, free drinks and snacks at each stop, very comfortable seats, an impeccable trip.
The service is exceptional, the staff is very smart, the precision is impressive but damn the wifi is zero... not that it's of vital importance but eliminate it, you'll make a better impression

I confess I am a big fan of high-end train travel but don't get to do it too often "at home" because it is actually more expensive to take a nice train than to fly (or drive) most places. So when we had the opportunity to take the Frecciarossa from Venice to Florence (summer 2017, I'm a little late catching up with my reviews!) and it was well within our budget PLUS convenient, we jumped at it! (Okay, I jumped, my husband sort of bounced a little). As hubby put it, the Frecciarossa "reminded us of how (not very good) the US in regards to public ground transportation." We got to the station early-ish (as is my habit) so we could suss out where we boarded and then with plenty of time to kill got some eats and drinks ... mixed fruit and veggie drinks and some deep-fried polpette. We'd gotten whatever the equivalent is of first class seats (still really affordable) so we had big cushy single seats by the window and settled in for the two-hour ride. Though we'd been hoping for, maybe, some beautiful scenery (even on a gray, cloudy and grizzly day), this part was a lot more like the Amtrak Metroliner en route from DC to NY ... a lot of industrialized areas, though I guess in retrospect that's not surprising. And once we got past Bologna it was mostly tunnels so no views. That said, it was smooth, quiet, quick, and on time. The seats were super comfortable. The bathrooms were very clean and spacious. I can't comment on the food or drinks because we were full from the fruit drinks and polpette! But overall I have NO gripes ... quick, clean, on time, comfortable. What more can you ask from public transportation? Once we arrived, there was a long line of cabs awaiting passengers to get us to our hotel so it was a no muss, no fuss, easy go from start to finish.

The good: Speed. You get from Naples to Rome in the same amount of time the gawdawful Circumvesuviana takes to get from Sorrento to Naples.  And you actually get to sit down, not fear for your belongings, and inhale air that doesn't reek of body odor.  Seats are decent, train is clean. Naples -> Rome in 1hr 10 minutes. Great.The "meh": There are no dedicated luggage racks near the doors as you might expect. You have to drag your suitcases through the aisle, hoping someone else isn't trying to pass you.  You can try to heave it up to the overhead racks, or sandwich it between some of the seats, but if you have a suitcase large enough for a multi-week international trip, good luck.  We had to leave my wife's suitcase by the door (!), which led to a stressful situation when we disembarked, as we were left hoping and praying nobody stole it or pushed it onto the platform before we could get to it.Apparently there's wi-fi onboard, but it's not good enough that you paid for your ticket, you also have to register to get access, and registration includes giving them your telephone number for marketing purposes. Um. no thanks.  Customer service is garbage. There was a scheduled strike on the Circumvesuviana (don't get me started on Italian transit workers and their strikes, they are one of the reasons I'll probably never come back to this banana republic masquerading as a first-world member of the EU), which would severely impact our ability to get to Naples on time for the train. I chatted with customer service to see if we could move our reservation to the very next train (1 hour later).  They simply gave me copy/paste responses of the policy for the economy tickets I'd purchased and were of no help whatsoever. I understand that the tickets at this level cannot be changed or refunded, but when one of your country's rail networks goes on strike, could you MAYBE make an exception to help out the tourists that are contributing to the pathetic state of your economy?  After no small amount of stress we were able to figure something out and get to Naples on time, but our train was hardly full and I very much suspect, neither was the following train. They could have easily let us change trains.Basically, the train is clean and fast and if you're not traveling with a lot of luggage it's a decent trip.  But after my experience on SNCF's train, Frecciarossa has a lot of catching up to do.  TGV trains had luggage racks/shelves, more room, and wi-fi that was easy to connect to (without subjecting your phone number to texts and god-knows-what else).It's better than driving and considering how fast the trip it, better than flying.

First time traveling from Rome to Florence.  We bought train tickets on business class just to try it.  The seating was very comfortable.  However, the on-board staff completely ignore us and didn’t even come to ask what we wanted for our complimentary lunch meal.  It took him so long to bring drinks for the entire carriage 1. Then, he kept serving food only for the Italian people, completely ignore us and the other couples from USA .  We didn’t expect this kind of lousy service and attitude. We ask himwhy he didn’t bring us food even after we asked him. He pretended not to hear anything.  The worst service crew ever! And this is an executive business class! Horrible! In other countries, you don’t get this kind of service.  We don’t expect anything, just wanted to be treated fairly and with respect! Completely turns us off and left us very upset how we were treated on the train.  It was May 8, 2018 the 11:20 am train 9526.  People of all kinds should be all treated fairly and with respect.

We did a day trip from Rome to Pompeii and took an early frecciarossa to Naples. We bought the ticket on line at trenitalia and all you need then is the reference number of the ticket which you can either print off or store on your phone. No need to worry about validating at the station. The train was punctual and very comfortable with plenty of relevant information on times, speed, temperatures, etc on the tv screens. The catering service come round and give you free bottled water, a small snack and coffee. When the ticket control comes they are just interested in the number on your ticket which they put into their tablet to check. Great scenery, free wifi, high speed service.

On my short trip to italy which included Milan, Rimini and Rome; i boarded both- the Frecciarossa and the Frecciabianca. Equally priced, the freccia rossa had better seats, far more comfortable than the latter. We didnt realise how time flew and the cleanliness was on point.

No email warning that there was a fault from the night before, 56 euros for a ticket that you will have to reimburse in full, seems like the minimum to me, such poor service that it gives you hives! You have truly failed, never again and never rather with the competition

Travelled by frecciarossa from Milan Central to Florence (Firenze) Santa Maria Novella 1 hour 50 minutes. We travelled executive class, spacious and comfortable with clean toilets. Fast train and on time service.Ticket provides access to Freccia Lounge which is a comfortable and quiet place pre departure with tea coffee water, biscuits and clean toilets.Only 8 seats in our carriage no.1 with 6 passengers, ticket price included lunch with wine or beer. 4 of the passengers fluent in Italian we 2 Aussies were not. The service provided to the others seemed very good but we were treated poorly. In many years of travel this was the most supercilious service/ waitress we have ever encountered. Not offered drinks, no bread with Mrs Merlots soup - offered to others. No assistance with anything! Most annoying.So service on commercial class was no class. Barely one star.The actual booking, Freccia lounge and travel experience first class. Booked on Trenitalia on line and found very good discounts - 50% off normal price. 5 stars. Overall we went for the train ride not the service call it 4 stars and recommended.

Frecciarossa trains are fast and comfortable express trains in Italy with free wifi and complimentary snack/drink. Frecciarossa trains are excellent alternatives to airplanes as means of intra-Italy travel. With Frecciarossa trains, you can enjoy the views of landscapes along the way, and you don't have to face all the hassles at the airports. You don't have to worry about the luggage limits either. Since train stations are in the downtown area, you can avoid long travel time downtown and airports as well. We had pleasant trips by Frecciarossa last October from Rome to Venice, from Venice to Milan, from Milan to Florence, and from Florence to Rome. Last December, we had a round trip travel aboard Frecciarossa with children from Rome to Florence. Frecciarossa trains have 4 classes; Standard (2nd Class), Standard Premium (Premium 2nd class), Business (1st Class), and Executive (Premium 1st Class). We chose Business Class, which was more comfortable seats at slightly higher price than the standard classes. The seats were very comfortable, and the coach interior was clean. Luggage bin was near the coach doors. But simply brought our carryon and medium luggage inside the coach, and placed them in the spaces between the back-to-back seats. On the train, you can register for complimentary Wifi service. Just go online to be connected to Frecciarossa website, and follow the step by step instructions. In the process, you would be asked to provide them with your credit card information. Don't worry. They ask for your credit card information just to confirm your identity, not to charge you any fee. They would also ask you for your smart phone number for text messaging their confirmation code. Don't worry about the wireless phone charge if you have not made any arrangements for using wireless phone in Italy. Checking the text message from Frecciarossa website would cost very little. Once your registration process is completed, you can enjoy your Wifi sessions aboard the current and all the future Frecciarossa trains. You don't need to register again on another Frecciarossa train. Just use your login ID and Pswd used during your first registration.When we boarded Frecciarossa, complimentary snack and drink were served, which was just one time service during our train ride. Be careful when you order a juice. Orange juice would be more like a red colored sour grapefruit juice.The travelers with children or physically challenged companions might consider using "VIP Fast Track Welcome Service" offered by Italiapass. With this service, Italiapass' greeter would come to you with a luggage handler to take care of your luggage. If you order this service to board a train, they would meet you at the departing train station, escort you to the train, and load your luggage to your train coach. If you order this service to get off the train at your  destination station, the VIP greeter and the luggage handler will come to your train coach, unload your luggage from the train, and escort you to the station exit.If you order car service as well as "VIP Fast Track Welcome Service" through Italiapass, the VIP greeter would coordinate the greeting service and car service seamlessly. We used this type of combined service via Italiapss for our roundtrip train travel with children between Rome and Florence, and found it extremely helpful.
