Obviously the booked seats didn't match. We were told over the loudspeaker that we could take our seats at will, too bad that after taking our seats we had to move again because we were in a different class. The chaos. Bad experience.

Get trenitalia tickets instead. Most the trains I took were trenitalia, worked great with only a couple minor delays. But the one Italo train I took was delayed nearly 2 hours. Italo offers reimbursement for delays but the forms and paperwork are so complicated they may as well not even offer. Avoid unless you want to spend your time in Italy waiting at the train station.

On October 21, 2025 I traveled on train 8134 departing from Reggio Calabria and headed to Turin, getting off at the Naples stop. Unfortunately, the experience was negative due to the rude and inappropriate behavior of the on-board conductor. When the train was still empty, I kindly asked the conductor if it was possible to move two small suitcases from the luggage rack to avoid confusion at busy times. The request was made politely and only for reasons of order and security. The response was rude and annoyed, and not only were the suitcases not moved, but the conductor even told me that, if I didn't find accommodation on my own, I would have to get off the train. I consider it unacceptable that a railway employee, responsible for guaranteeing a public and safe service, would address a passenger in this way, especially when the request was made in a civil and sensible manner.

On October 10th, I sent a PEC with a refund request to Italo regarding the TGWV5Q ticket (train 8134 from Scalea, October 16th), since the departure time had been brought forward after the purchase. An apparently minimal change, but enough to make it impossible for me to reach the station in good time. Despite the reasoned and documented request for a refund, I received no response. A disappointing behavior on the part of a company that should guarantee attention and respect for its customers

Italo trains have rude, ironic and cynical staff. We were traveling from Florence to Venice. Italo terminal machine took our cash and never gave a ticket, it showed an error message, we approached customer care and they said they can do nothing but open a complaint and they will write us in the upcoming weeks. They said we need to buy tickets again.We lost €168. The Florence station manager of Italo company literally laughed at us and said stay in florence if you don’t have additional money to buy tickets again and told us it is your mistake to use the machine you could have approached ticket office.
Italo's first class is not first class. People on the phone, small groups talking loudly, unusable bathrooms. No one comes by to check that there is a minimum respect for the rules.

Do NOT Travel with this train company Italo. If your train gets canceled due to the strikes that are happening on and off in Italy at the moment, you WILL LOSE your money due to no fault of your own. They have offered to refund 25% of the cost of my tickets. They are refunding the money in a digital wallet for future use. The refund is not going back on your credit card and I am not a citizen of Italy. You have 365 days to use the balance in the wallet. We had to purchase two new tickets and they charged double the amount of the original tickets! They have no empathy there for the tourists, they will rip you off and exploit you. Please be mindful when purchasing these types of train tickets, of possible last minute cancellations…… as a visitor you have no rights and will not be treated fairly.   IE Toronto, ON Canada

After 1 hour of travel, we risked hibernation, because they had put the AC to minimum, at the request of 1 passenger... the entire carriage 3, 1 class, after coats and sneezing, upon request they realized the absurdity to which they were subjecting us... we also had to thank... and despite everything after half an hour they turned the air down again.#italotreno #italo 9916, 10Oct25 at the moment with 25 minutes late. The bathrooms in carriage 2 aren't even worth describing.
Train 33 minutes late terrible app that doesn't know the real delay or even the train when it leaves and where it's going. Never connected with real time.
Very poor toilet facilities in my carriage clogged toilet, in the next carriage lack of water, I was left with soapy hands

I am traveling from Padua to Naples on the Italo train 8902 on carriage 4. The bathroom has been out of service since departure, so we have to move to 5 to be able to go to the bathroom. If the users of two carriages flock to a single bathroom (full among other things), at least take care to clean and refill paper, soap and what is needed. Travel is not free.

Trip to forget from Desenzano del Garda to Florence and return. On the outward journey, seats were reassigned by the company (carriage and seats), no one knows for what reason, which meant I wasn't able to sit next to my parents as I had planned. This disservice alone, considering the price of the tickets, annoyed me quite a bit. But the gem arrives in the evening when the return train is 140 minutes late!!!! Italo should be a guarantee of efficiency but in recent years there have been more and more inefficiencies. I understand that delays can happen and that sometimes it's not even the fault of the company, but the serious thing is that at the station at 9.05pm there wasn't a single Italo operator who could help us since we didn't even know if the train would ever arrive and we were afraid of having to find improvised solutions for the night! We were completely in a panic and there wasn't a single person to support us, but only a phone number to call and a very rude operator on the other end of the phone. The human component in some situations is fundamental. I was left abandoned to myself alone in a station at night with two elderly parents to look after without knowing what to do…. The delay would still have been the same but at least we would have been able to talk to someone in person who could reassure us. Italo, good advice: fewer automatic ticket machines and stupid cutting-edge digital totems. Invest in your staff instead. Among other things, it is absurd that with such a delay Italo guarantees a ticket refund of ONLY half. The refund is 50% but the frustration is 100%.
italo has always been my best friend to accompany me to my loved ones, a return home, but also the ''red train'' that takes me back to the arms of my boyfriend! thank you iTalo, you are amazing <3

Italo completely destroyed my travel plans. Two back-to-back delays of more than 2 hours made me miss not just one, but multiple connecting trains. This company has no respect for passengers’ time, money, or schedules.Calling this “high-speed rail” is a joke — what they actually deliver is chaos, stress, and zero accountability. If you care about reliability, stay far away from Italo.

Turin Porta Nuova Reggio Calabria train departing from Porta Susa at 1.30pm with 175 minutes late. Ask for news at the ticket office information point but the very rude response is "coming soon" "check the poster to keep informed about the delay". I wasn't expecting a miracle but at least a little understanding and an apology.

Rude, ironic and cynical staff. Italo terminal machine took our cash and never gave a ticket, it showed an error message, we approached customer care and they said they can do nothing but open a complaint and they will write us in the upcoming weeks. They said we need to buy tickets again. We lost €168. The station manager lady Paolo (if I remember her name roght) literally laughed at us and said stay in florence if you don’t have additional money to buy tickets again and told us it is your mistake to use the machine you could have approached ticket office.

You move the ticket due to the imminent strike, you pay the additional fee and due to server problems the payment is not processed. What happens? My ticket disappears completely, both the old and the new... it turns out to be non-existent even when searching for it with the code! IT'S THE SECOND TIME THAT HAPPENS, and it wasn't a little money! Trenitalia costs more but is more reliable!!!
Terrible service, 55 minutes late. Missed work appointment and no refund before 60' I waited 30 minutes for the train and another 25 on board in the middle of nowhere

Inefficient company. Paid Business and then discover that the services purchased are not available. Train not used due to strikes and then to get a refund for a route YOU MUST PAY FOR THE CALL CALL! SHAME ON YOU! FRECCIAROSSA FOR ALL LIFE!!!

For the third time an hour delay, but of course we are told 55 minutes to not refund the ticket. Chaos on board because the carriages are as different as the assigned numbers, we are moved while the train is moving even under the tunnels with little security. Not even a trace of staff and we weren't even given a bottle of water for comfort. A shame they are worse than the regional ones and cost much more! As far as I'm concerned, I will no longer travel with Italo!

I have always found friendly staff but this morning I found an ironic and unprofessional member of staff. Not being able to lift the suitcase on my own, I was told how I would do it alone later since the suitcase was so heavy, complete with mockery in his voice. This attitude is inconceivable to me. Unprofessional and out of place

For heaven's sake, carriage 8 was dirty (Naples-Milan train) and when one or more iqos smokers were reported, the staff responded that they could only act if they saw them!!! And the smell??? Consequence of travel (fortunately on time) with nausea.

I often travel with Italo, but unfortunately every time I have to deal with constant changes in timetables and variations in the offer. This creates great inconvenience, especially if one organizes their travel in advance. The lack of stability in schedules makes it difficult to trust the service. It's a shame, because the trains are comfortable, but reliability should be a top priority.

What a disgrace!!!!! Rude and unhelpful staff who prefer to shout orders at you when trying to store luggage. Not enough luggage space for larger cases. Extremely disrespectful to foreigners who are elderly!!!! Never again will I travel with this bunch of imbeciles!!!!!!

No restaurant or bar on board, no drink service, and the train was unbearably hot. There is hardly any space for luggage, and the WiFi is so painfully slow it just makes you frustrated. Not recommended at all for long-distance travel.Take the Frecciarossa if you want comfort, service, and reliability.

Avoid Italo trains if you have luggage. Most people have to put their suitcase in the small compartments above their heads, creating a dangerous situation. At one end of the carriage is a small luggage rack allowing only 3 large bags. I spent my 3hr journey in the stairwell with my suitcase as their was nowhere to put it. Stairwell areas have no seats and no aircon.

Train scheduled to be more than 90 minutes late. The ladies at the assistance desk at the station are completely useless. They don't allow you to change trains, they don't know how to request a refund and they don't give any alternatives.
Bad experience.........a good Intercity, nothing special....among other things, dirty and noisy....it aligns with the scarcity of Frecciarossa

13 September 2025 train 8134 at 4.06pm does not arrive and there is no trace on the timetables. I go to the Italo office at the Bologna station to say that the train is not there, a very annoyed girl says that I have received e-mails, I point out that I have not received anything, even more arrogantly she repeats to me that the e-mails are being sent, I repeat that I have no communications, and this continues, a colleague of hers arrives and there are two of them, I have received no communications and worse still there are no communications of any kind on the arrivals/departures boards. I am 68 years old but not yet with dementia, I say that it would be enough to say, sorry, there is a disservice and they could give info, but no, they ask me not to raise my voice, which I didn't do, tired from the day, and I point it out, worried about the delay in the commitment made in Turin, disappointed by the irritating and defiant manner at 2, I say that they shouldn't take me for the...!!!! Yes . The train has been canceled and no one communicates anything. Very serious!!! But they are sitting calmly!!! I go out and go to an isolated kiosk, always Italo, there is a kind girl, she informs us that we have been moved to 9940 at 5.06pm (8134 nothing is known)!!!! I hope this review is read, and helps other users, another company, at least sends a text message warning of delays or inconveniences, it is likely that Italo will have to reduce its customers

Departed from Naples for Rome with repeated stops in the first half hour on a journey that would last 50 minutes. The business ticket offers various advantages given the price, including reclining seats that don't even move with hammering, fast tracks that don't even know what they are and if you want to use the lounge you have to shell out more money. I think the Trenitalia regional ones are better. Forget it, especially when you expect not even full refunds for delays under an hour. Never again.

We had a great experience on this train, we bought the first class tickets with the lounge which was great because we had somewhere to wait in Rome.  The train was very clean and the onboard service was great.  The bathrooms were clean as well.  So much nicer than Trenitalia.

I purchased a return ticket to Rome from Milan, logging into my Italo account. The ticket should have been for my daughter, too bad that by using my account the system assumes that you are purchasing for yourself. Result: ticket in my name. Having purchased a ticket with a flex rate (at a high price), I expected to be able to change the name for free. Instead, not only is the call to customer service subject to a fee (5 euros for the call), but I was asked for an additional 10 euros. Dishonest to say the least.
I often take Italo for various reasons on the Benevento Reggio Emilia route and there is never a time that the train isn't late.

Now downgraded to a mere regional train with very high costs. Hat racks reduced to the bare bones (trolleys don't fit in some places). Zero controls (Except for the ticket where they are very efficient). Air Conditioning fired at random. Noisy and rude passengers. (On the way back to Rome we encountered a caravan of Chinese who made a mess). If only one of the staff had come to say something. I'm going back to Frecciarossa. Never again Italo

The train was quite clean, as were the bathrooms. On the outward journey there were no problems except for the fact that a lady had an epileptic attack and there was no doctor on board the train, except for a PASSENGER. Of the series, if you feel ill but no customers on board are doctors, that's your business. Which was terrifying for me. I was two and a half hours late on the way back. We receive an email to request the monetization of the compensation, out of 4 I'm the only one that doesn't receive it. Paid assistance service not even contemplated in the slightest (for a refund of a few € what's the point of calling a PAYMENT number to obtain it), I'm left waiting on the phone with the toll-free number for 40 minutes only to be told that they can't verify the issue of requesting a refund as you necessarily have to call the paid number. I sent both email and certified email, no response. You suck.

No food or bar on train don’t be fooled into there services they don’t even have! No good really as we could of good food in the station had we of known. and the ticket guy was very rude about it also.

DO NOT BOOK WITH ITALO. Train got cancelled from Salerno to Rome at 9:30 pm. Waited all night for another train ended booking an entirely new one to get back to Rome. When I called Italo to get a refund they would not give it back and claimed the train made it on time even though it was cancelled along with all other trains that night due to a fire. Waste of money and a 1.5 hour train ride ended up taking 11 hours. Garbage train, garbage service .

It is unacceptable not to be able to use the overhead bins on the seats even with the smallest trolley! In the same carriage and therefore with fare mostly olive trees Ale there is a difference for travelers which in my opinion should only happen with class diversity! In addition of course to the usual delays encountered with this company!

Well what can I say, terrible experience without a shadow of a doubt, it was a high season travel period 01/09/25 the problem is not to be attributed to the Italo train company but the way in which the train managers at the Naples station handled the mix-up that was created was not of moral or even effective help after we missed the Italo train due to Trenitalia's fault they obviously shifted the blame to each other and when in the Italo assistance office someone with the desire to work helped us without create further problems we managed to solve the problem An Italian tarantella, nice service and nice staff
A 2 hour train ride to Rome on train #9950 was delayed 3+ hours. Very little explanation, no transfers in Naples allowed according to Staff.Never again

At the station itself, a person from the company appears and offers help, which is otherwise great, and on top of that, he sells us the Loung Italo service at the Bologna Centrale station. However, a couple of things he did not say is that it is 10 euros per person and not as a complete service, then if you have a long time to wait, if you leave the Lounge, you cannot return. They don't even want to store the suitcase under the pretext that someone could take things and you can't get inside without proof that you bought Loung. Everything would be okay if the guy emphasized that once you get in there is no going back.
We took Italo at Porta Susa station in Turin to go to Bologna where we had a connection for Cattolica. Clean train and on time. Prices on offer. Paolo Mappy

Lounge in central Naples: worsened after the "restyling" I consider Italo's fare offer for trains and the service in general to be good. Here I would like to share my opinion regarding the renovation of the Lounge at Naples central station: a terrible surprise. The comfortable sofas have been archived and replaced by very uncomfortable armchairs and sofas. After 5 minutes you just want to get out. Let's not talk about the bar offer: the desolation and a coffee that this time upset our stomachs. We choose Italo to wait for the train's departure in a pleasant and comfortable environment, but reluctantly we will also have to evaluate alternatives for future trips from Naples. Sin.

Terrible experience. Bathrooms closed and water not working for the entire trip, coffee machine that takes money without dispensing anything, non-existent sanitizing gel. Added to this are the usual "workmanlike" delays. Really disappointing service for a company that presents itself as a modern and quality alternative.

Good morning, I would like to inform you that for the journey on 08/06/2025 I took Italotreno 8913, window seat 36 and the seat was uncomfortable as the fabric was very hard at 5.15pm from Rome Termini to Lamezia Terme central in bisnisess class. The return on 08/21/2025 Italotreno 8158 at 1.50pm, window seat 32 the seat was uncomfortable, the same as the return trip and it is not advisable to take the italotreno, I will never take the italotreno again

Train 8158 of August 20th a seemingly endless journey Reggio Calabria Milan everything was fine until we arrived before Florence 30 minutes wasted randomly standing still on the tracks 0 services full and without air changes hell

I purchased  return tickets for my family of four for Rome to Florence. I also purchased return tickets for a day trip to Venice. I also purchased with the option to make changes within 72 hours of travel. Unfortunately, I could not travel as planned because of a strike in my home country. When I called  customer service and ask them to help me with moving the my travel dates. They  told me that the time had already passed to modify the tickets, and that I would lose the entire cost of my train tickets for my family of four. they were completely inflexible, they were not willing to accommodate any changes outside of the 72 hour window. I will never travel with this company again.

I am writing this review on board a Frecciarossa, because the driver of my bus 1183, booking code CGTBWY, decided to tell me and other people that the bus that would take us to Lecce would only stop in Naples, and then stop the journey and that the bus to Lecce was on the way. Unfortunately, perhaps the driver was exhausted, because in reality the one he didn't let us on was the bus to Lecce. I was lucky because I bought the last available ticket for the Frecciarossa, but other people remained stranded in Caserta and we will all report it to the appropriate authorities.

I purchased the Italian Milan-Padua ticket a month and a half in advance of my departure, scheduled for mid-August, to get a good price but on July 29th they wrote me an email: train cancellation due to operational needs. Furthermore, they send me another email in which they confirm the relevant refund, which I have still never seen despite the phone calls (in a twist 2 weeks ago they even told me a maximum of 3 days to wait).... Finally, I was forced to purchase a ticket with regional trains, spending more on that route...

Terrible experience on train 8944 from Reggio Calabria to Turin on 11 August 2025, an interminable journey due to work on the high-speed tracks, but the worst is the air conditioning at full blast as if the emperor penguins of the south pole were travelling. Definitely more comfortable in the car and the red arrow which at least doesn't make you freeze.

First time with Italo and terrible experience. On train 9940 from Naples to Rome, we didn’t know we had to press the button to open the door. We stood there with our bags, the attendant saw us and didn’t help. Missed our stop, had to buy another ticket. Rude service. Tip: Press the button to exit!

It has now become impossible to travel with Italo. Trains are continually cancelled, even with just one day's notice, creating logistical and economic problems. If last-minute seat changes and luggage racks that were too small above the seats could have been overlooked, wild cancellations could not. Never again with Italo!

This is the only way to travel Italy.  Very comfortable.  We booked early to get good seats and a 2x1 opportunity with tickets.We took two trips on it - Naples to Florence and Florence to Venice.Highly recommended.
Booked and the train is empty. Every time we stop, someone enters the empty carriage and has the seat next to me... shame

good morning, in May I purchased an Italo Business ticket from Milan to Bassano del grappa. About 10 days before departure they canceled my ticket with a reason still to be understood with a refund within 30 days. SHAME SHAME SHAME SHAME. In the meantime I had to buy another ticket which cost me triple .1 month to get a refund of 29 euros. YOU SUCK. NEVER AGAIN ITALIAN

Given the almost 8 hours of travel we chose first class...it's worth it for the seating space but nothing else.  Above all, the SHAMEFUL ABSENCE OF WIFI for both the outward and return journeys should be noted. It is a service included in the cost of the ticket and therefore it is dishonest not to offer it.

Always choose Trenitalia if you want to travel in a, at least, comfortable way!!  The Italo high speed "offers" a total absence of services, unlike the competition: no welcome kit with water and snacks, nor the possibility of a bar or restaurant break. The carriages are packed like a cattle wagon, not comparable to those of Trenitalia but with the same prices. The only functioning machine on the entire train does not have the possibility of paying with CARDS so either you have change for water or you can die of dehydration for a total of 6.7 hours of travel.  Indecent.
Terrible prices, then they say not to take the car, it's impossible to take the train and they even make fun of you because they make children pay full price. Terrible services. Italy is bankrupt.

Satisfactory train and prices. Web account not easy to use. In general the menu is messed up and not very intuitive to say the least, furthermore due to some bugs when loading the billing data page it switches to English. In particular, billing was not possible for me because it did not save my data. Tested with mobile phone and multiple computers with multiple browsers. I had to request with the paid number, expensive (1.3+€/min!) and I would also say slow. Maybe all this was arranged for this purpose? The doubt arises. The annoyance increases if you want to make a complaint: the pre-set categories are few and hardly relevant for example regarding the app and site there is only one very specific problem that I couldn't use. In theory I should send a registered letter. But please...Frecciarossa currently has a much better service.

The train was late every time we took it; from Bologna to Milan, it was even an hour late. And the delay kept getting pushed back by 5–10 minutes at a time — they could’ve just said right away that it would be a 60-minute delay, but instead they kept changing it little by little.

Good morning, I personally purchased a train ticket for the Bologna–Scalea route, worth €110, used today by my daughter. Unfortunately, during the trip she was fined €20 as the ticket was not registered in her name. I believe that this penalty is excessive, especially considering that the travel ticket had been regularly purchased and paid for. In a period like the summer, when costs are already high, similar practices seem more oriented towards generating revenue than actually protecting users. I trust in your feedback and in a reflection on a more fair and transparent management of these situations.

A disaster of company.  We took two trains on our trip through Itslis. One from Turin to Bologna that arrived 1 hour and a half late and without explanations... And the other from Bologna to Florence also late.  Do not rely on these trains to plan your visits to cities because you can lose reservations and everything you have.  A total disappointment and on top of that they are not cheap at all

An hour and a half delay on the outward journey and fifty minutes on the return journey: to be avoided if you have appointments that cannot be postponed or connections to make, but I must say that traveling the Milan-Rome route in just over three hours, in comfort, for a few tens of euros is still appreciable. Furthermore, the information provided to customers is good, not to mention the very useful lounge service in the stations.

Very bad experience. A friend of mine and I were simply sleeping when a person from the organization thought it best to wake us up and tell us that "we were sleeping with little decorum". Truly speechless. Plus the machines don't even give change, fix them, bye

Terrible travel experience Turin/Rome and return with Italo. On the outward journey we were more than 1 hour and 20 minutes late, causing an appointment at the Quirinale already booked and paid for to be missed. The staff tried to apologize by providing tarallini and a glass of water. For the return, leaving at 7.05pm from Termini, the arrival was scheduled in Turin at 11.30pm, but at the moment we are stopped at Milan Centrale to wait for another train coming from another line, accumulating a delay of at least 1 hour + 25 minutes already accumulated previously, an embarrassing situation to say the least. There are still 200 km of travel to go, who knows what could happen?! There is no saving on the air conditioning and the lights on, at night every internal light is on, making the journey unpleasant, uncomfortable, cold and nervous. As for the toilets they are dirty, small and 2 out of 3 are broken. Negative experience which I will strongly advise against
Terrible experience, I thought they were more or less in line with Trenitalia/standards, but I was very wrong. STRONGLY NOT RECOMMENDED

Took the Italo express train ride for several rides between Italian cities this month: Milano to Firenze, and Milano to Torino. The ticketing process was smooth - could buy the tickets online, or at the ticketing machines at the station. The confirmation emails were promptly delivered. One has the option of saving the tickets as pdf files, or downloading their app and saving them in passbook.The trains were on time (in my cases anyway), the signs for the platforms and boarding were efficient and smooth. The train rides themselves were comfortable, fast, with air conditioning (it was 35-36 degrees outside!), the wifi and charging ports were all working fine. The ticket prices were reasonable too. All in all I didn’t have any complaints about this service or mode of transport within Italy.

First class travel ROME/ TURIN At the moment I am in Bologna 50 minutes late. In first class there is only one bathroom available (for 3 carriages!!) and it is dirty and disgusting. It is full of urine and is not cleaned. Notified to the train conductor who responds: send a complaint via the site. Guys, you're screwed. Now I understand 2 things: 1 they barely give refunds (unlike Trenitalia which refunds after 30 minutes or more) because almost certainly something wrong will happen with Italo. The second thing I realized is that you don't matter a damn. However, Trenitalia always has priority and they treat you like rags (which you are).

Train canceled a few days before departure. Luckily I had added the refund option, but it wasn't that simple: two long phone calls with the operators were necessary and a procedure to do on the site that is not explained anywhere. If I hadn't called twice I wouldn't have received a refund, but only a new ticket on Italo where I will never travel again!

Trip Villa S. Giovanni - Florence, the train was delayed by an hour causing us to miss the connection with the ferry. so the situation was this: two women alone at one in the morning walking to go to the port from where the other ships left. furthermore, after the stop in Rome the staff no longer checked the tickets, allowing in particular one rather annoying individual to travel almost the entire journey without a ticket (he continuously went back and forth between the carriages, sat in empty seats, locked himself in the bathroom, lurked at the exit at every stop looking morbidly around). It was not even possible to follow the train in real time as it was not available on the dedicated website. The bathroom was broken, forcing several carriages to cross. In short, little seriousness and little consideration for customers

The bathrooms smell like disgusting, right from the start, some are "not usable" because they were deliberately set to "not active", others without soap, water in a dropper - Shame on you if you don't know how to manage the cleaning companies and change them. References - train 9924 Naples Turin of 16/7/25 and train 9935 Turin Naples of 17/7/25

Trains full of suitcases, I would say more luggage than people! Last minute carriage change notices, often even without notice via email. A maximum baggage limit would be needed even for train journeys! Not satisfied with the services!

Isn't it appropriate, in 2025, to improve the network service inside the trains? Can you explain to me how it is possible that the INTERNAL WiFi is blocked when passing through a tunnel? A person connects to the internal wifi precisely to avoid losing signal in these moments. It's time to do something.

I traveled from Naples to Milan for the first time with Italo because the fare was very advantageous... never again!! Left late, stopped in Afragola for 45 minutes, air conditioning below zero, uncomfortable seats and everyone stuck together. I was traveling with my two children and I also booked (paying the substitute) the seats so as to be close together in the seats with the central table BUT they probably changed trains because we found ourselves on double seats and not close together 🤨😡 Next trips another railway company

It's not the first time I've traveled with Italo, but as first class I only have air conditioning. Broken bathroom, both in carriage 3 and 2, dirty seats from those who were before us... (cleaning?) drinks service from the young lady nothing to say, but what you give is poor... watered down coffee, offer glasses of water and other drinks and in these periods you need more given the heat. Paying 97 euros in first class to have 4 tarallini and a glass of water... the whole trip... poor.
Used Italo from Rome to Florence and Florence to Venice.  Loved that the Prima Class offers drinks and gluten free snack options in the cabin.

Had a train leaving from Roma Termini. I wasn’t able to find the platform number on my ticket or on the departures board. I approached the Italo customer service desk to ask for help when one of the workers ran out of the store and began SCREAMING in my face in Italian. I don’t speak Italian, and all I wanted was platform information for my train. Instead I was screamed at and humiliated at the train station. Worst customer service experience in my life. Would never book on Italo again. Trentialia staff on my return journey were much kinder and polite.

We booked the train 2 months in advance and few days before it was cancelled and we were rescheduled for the next day  evening train. We tried to schedule online but they dont give option to re-schedule even though there's so many trains available. We were in a different country at the time. We tried calling noone answers.We came to Milano and tried to change and they said they cannot find any tickets. We tried online and was able to find tickets and show it to them . Then they changed it. The reason behind is we bought tickets way cheaper online and now they are cancelling those tickets and selling 3 times higher online. Really bas experience as we came to Italy. Welcome to Italy 🇮🇹
Return from Milan to Udine canceled one day before. In Milan they vaguely justify the fact with "technical problems". The refund, via voucher or uploaded to your app. No money.

Really, really bad. Went to Bologna with an hour and a half delay, furthermore due to this delay we unfortunately missed the train we should have taken to go to Parma station. I get on the train heading to Venice at 12.55pm at Rome Termini with code AV8916 (29/06/25). I show up at the station about 30 minutes early to go to the information box because I'm traveling with my cousin's ticket who unfortunately couldn't leave due to health problems. I ask at the information box if it's possible to change my name and in response they tell me that it's not possible because it's a discounted fare, therefore advising me to ask the train conductor if he could close a watch out. I arrive in front of the train 20 minutes early to have time to ask the conductor for clarification, but I can't find the conductor at his station, I ask 3 Italo employees and finally manage to intercept him. I politely present my problem and with great honesty I tell the conductor the reason why my cousin was not present, asking for authorization to travel in his name. (The ticket paid 90 euros) She looks at me and grumpily replies "but it doesn't exist, you're asking me something impossible! I can't let you get on." I tell her "What does it cost, the place will remain empty, if you want I will also pay for the name change but at the information desk they tell me that this is not possible." She, even more annoyed, tells me that it was not correct either to travel in the name of someone else or that the request had been made 2 minutes before departure. In the end, after having apologized several times for the mix-up, I manage to obtain her authorization obviously against her will and after practically treating me like a fish for 10 minutes she lets me on. saying "I do it exceptionally because it's not done like this". I add that the day before I left Venice with the same problem but in this case I was traveling with Trenitalia where the train conductor reassured me by saying: "don't worry, there's no problem, you think that there are people who do it worse, they don't pay, they get on the train and you can't even give them a fine because otherwise they'll raise their hands." Sometimes perhaps it's better to do what someone does, not pay the ticket, get on the train, forget about honesty and in case of fine move on to threats....NO COMMENT

Even if you buy tickets called business (and pay more for them obviously), below a certain cost there is no difference with the other non-business carriages, since when you book the seats (also paying 8 euros), or they assign them to you, you always come from the second, but more often from the third or fourth carriage, practically the real non-business ones, which is only the first carriage. But then call it something else but not business!! A free drink would be offered on board, I usually take a coke, but all the staff have the diktat to serve you a truly ridiculous quantity (less than half a glass, and I'm not exaggerating! but please!). The seats are uncomfortable because they slope slightly down and you constantly have to pull yourself up. The air conditioning is either too low or doesn't work at all and cracks in the heat. Last time I bought a booklet of 10 business tickets, only to discover that you save absolutely nothing compared to the normal ticket and it is not possible to reserve a seat, not even for a fee (they assign it to you automatically) and guess in which carriages? The non-business ones!! A fool's errand!  When the booklet ends I go with the arrows, it costs a little more but there is no comparison. If someone pays more, they want better service, not half a glass of coke!

Some members of the on-board staff immediately show appreciation and sympathy for our behaviour, traveling with a small child is never easy but we try to do our best for the good of everyone. The child falls asleep (finally) and we keep him in the micro stroller (foldable) next to the seat (single at the beginning of the carriage) specially booked to better manage these situations and avoid the worst (who hasn't traveled with a child - not theirs - who screams and cries?). Suddenly this diligent train conductor shows up ordering, without delay and with a rigid dialectic, to "fold the stroller and put it in the designated compartment"... While the child is sleeping...... I reply politely - and as a father - that we know the "rules" and we are asking for "common sense", also for the benefit of the other passengers and the pleasantness of their journey. The conductor responds angrily by saying that she has been "attacked" (among the embarrassed smiles of the other passengers). I reply politely by mentioning that I have not uttered any aggressive words nor that I have had such an attitude, only to ask for a bit of common sense. At this point the conductor leaves abruptly (probably having felt incapable of enforcing the rule/law that she represents on board the train?) and we hope that at this point the journey will continue peacefully throughout the carriage. After about 10 minutes, however, he returns, with a threatening manner and a tone of voice unsuitable for the sleeping child (and the other passengers), ordering again to close the stroller and that what we were doing was not possible (again due to the "rules"). At this point we just have to proceed as requested and obey this crazy demonstration of human inadequacy from someone who should "be in charge" of a train. We underline that the passage space has never been blocked or reduced due to the type of place chosen.

I remember hearing a comment about a despised former Italian leader that at least he made the trains run on time. Apparently Italian trains were notorious for being late. Said leader was fortunately overthrown and most if not all of his legacy was removed or replaced. Sadly, it would seem that applied to the trains as well. On our last full day in Italy, we were traveling by train from Naples to Rome for our last night in the country. Having experienced, or rather endured Italian trains a couple of days earlier on the Circumvesuviana commuter train in Sorrento I had some reservations on what was to come. Italo is the brand name of the Nuovo Trasporto Viaggiatori a company that began providing high speed train service in Italy in 2006. At present NTV serves 62 stations in 54 cities and averages about 90 trips a day.We had our electronic tickets printed out complete with QR code and the details such as train number and departure time.  Naturally we didn’t have a track number as apparently these are only given out at the last possible minute. When it was close to the train’s arrival time, we made our way to the track area and kept watching the electronic board for the track number to be posted. A few minutes before the scheduled departure time it was, or at least we thought it was. We made our way to the designated, and empty, track and waited. We continued waiting until well after the scheduled departure time and still no train.We then headed back to the main entry area to doublecheck the board. Here we discovered several other passengers also waiting for our train including one who knew how to properly read the board. The number 10 I though was the track number was in reality the number of estimated minutes the train would be late. Fortunately for us that was an optimistic estimate. Eventually our train arrived and the correct track number was posted, at the extreme other end of the tracks.  There was a mad scramble as all the passengers loaded down with luggage literally ran to the correct platform and began looking of their cars.Our tickets had both the seat numbers and car printed on it, fortunately our car was in the middle so we were able to get aboard before the train departed. Italo apparently is not in the habit of waiting. There was a big of a log jam at the end of the car and we soon discovered why. Prior to entering into the passenger compartment via a sliding glass door there was a sort of foyer area with the washroom and a small storage area for larger pieces of luggage. Smaller pieces such as backpacks and carry-ons could be placed in the overhead racks above the seats.Apparently, this was too much effort for those who had won the foot race to the train and they filled all the luggage spots with their smaller bags leaving no room for anyone slower with “larger” bags, like us. Our cases while not enormous were still too large to jam into the overhead racks. Fortunately, the car wasn’t full and I was able to wedge them into the seats across from us, and hoped no passengers would be assigned those seats at any intervening stops. Our seats were the last two in the car immediately in front of the sliding glass door to the foyer. This meant that with any luck we could be first off. Sadly, one of the other slowpokes, just not as slow as us, had solved the lack of luggage storage in the foyer in her own unique way. She had managed to jam her enormous, and I do mean enormous it was as large as both our cases put together, behind our seats against the bulkhead. In doing so she managed to jam the sliding glass door so it now only opened a few inches. Probably enough for a normal person to squeeze through sideways, as some using the washroom did, but not enough to get a suitcase through.  I began to realize we’d have to traverse the entire length of the car past all the other passengers many of whom I’m sure would be disembarking in Rome as well and hope there was enough time to get off before the train left. If the stops between Naples and Rome were any indication we’d have literally seconds. Personally, I’ve always Wanted to visit Florence the final destination, just not on this trip.The conductor did come by prior to reaching Rome checking tickets, both electronic and paper and soon discovered the jammed door and the reason. He looked at me as if to say is this yours, and I pointed first at my case across the aisle and then up the length of the car. He shrugged and then went off in search of the owner and was soon back with her. It was really jammed in there and it took both of them some effort to remove it. He then literally tossed it into the foyer section where it spent the rest of the trip rolling around on the floor. Our seats were in Prima Business Class the second of three classes on Italo trains. The only difference between this and Smart Class apparently was we received a free snack and drink, similar to what one gets on an airline on short flight. Naturally this was served almost before we arrived in Rome and we were just able to finish it.  Both classes offer 2x2 individual seating with easy access plugs for phones and other devices.The trip was so short, under two hours that had it been offered I doubt I would have paid more for the Club Executive Class with its arm chairs, individual TV screens and additional catering options. Today (5October2024) started out with excitement regarding getting to Venice in the afternoon and spending the day exploring the city. Little did we know that the day would turn into a hostage situation. Based on Google reviews, we purchased tickets on Italio train #8914 which was scheduled to arrive in Venice at 15:55. Shortly outside Rome, the train broke down. No electricity, no air conditioning, and no operational toilets. The crack team of Italia train personnel decided not to call for help but to walk around the train, inside and out, in some sort of dire attempt to exercise the train’s demons and allow us to be underway. Finally, 5 hours later, after a person became gait from heat exhaustion, it was decided that maybe having a replacement train would be best. During this entire time of being tortured with heat, dehydration, and then water refills galore - but no functional toilet, there were 31 other trains that speed past us. Thus, had a replacement train been ordered earlier, we might not have lost an entire day of precious vacation. Once the replacement train arrived, and we transferred, it took us another hour for our conductor to walk back and forth enough to get his daily steps registered on his Fitbit. He finally lumbered into the control room and we were off … at a rip roaring speed of 15 mph. While touted as a high-speed train (both the broken one and the replacement), I have seen giant tortoises move with more speed than our train. Our conductor took us into a mountain tunnel and we then spent more than 40 minutes creeping along. We would periodically take a rest, most likely because riding the brake was wearing out the conductor’s grip. Finally, we got underway with more haste - only to find we were going back the way we just came.When it was all said and done, we arrived more than 6 hours after our promised time. A whole day was squandered by the lack of proper train maintenance and unbelievable levels of incompetence once the train broke down. I am not sure what the legal limits of torture are in Italy; however, being from the United States, I can attest other countries do not allow such mistreatment. When people are sitting in hot cars with no air conditioning, do not have access to the toilet, and the event surpasses a couple of hours, most companies would move the heavens to rescue their customers. Italo seems to feel that 5 or 6 hours of such abuse is acceptable and easily rectified with a small bag of nuts & raisins. If you value your time and sanity, I would recommend staying away from Italo trains. However, if you are trying to extract secrets from someone, definitely buy them a Business Class ticket on a high-speed Italia train … they will give you all access to every secret they ever possessed.

We usually take Italo trains when we go from major city to major city in Italy. We booked several classes of service, including Executive, and were always completely disappointed.  Thankfully, we were lucky enough, lol, to miss our Trenitalia connection from Verona to Venice, and the next available train happened to be an Italo train.  What a pleasure it was to be greeted by a train attendant, sit on a clean seat, and be offered a snack and/or beverage several times over the course of 61 minute trip.  That 61 minute trip reinforced the realization we had made a major mistake choosing to try out Trenitalia and forgoing Italo.  Going forward, we will always book Italo for the long hauls between major cities, and then we will only take the Trenitalia commuter trains to go to the smaller towns and villages that are not serviced by Italo.  A little customer service and courtesy go a long way.

My experience with Italo Treno was nothing short of shameful. On February 6, 2024, at the Lamezia Terme station, I find myself waiting for the 2.41 pm train, headed to the Santa Maria Novella station in Florence. Once the vehicle arrived on time, I quickly headed towards the carriage assigned to me on the ticket, when suddenly I literally saw the door closing in my face (not to mention the fact that, at the moment I was about to get on, a man about to get off the same carriage was about to be crushed by the door). Despite numerous shouts and nods aimed at pointing out the fact that the door had been closed in my face and, consequently, the fact that I had not been given the minimum time to board the train, the conductor proved to be totally indifferent and the vehicle left as if nothing had happened. We could stop here, if some reflections didn't arise spontaneously: I wonder how a traffic controller, at a distance of about three hundred metres, can take it for granted that a person screaming and asking for mercy to open the door hasn't got their sleeve caught in it? This inevitably highlights the non-compliance and negligence of the controller, who did not even think of approaching to make sure that everything was safe, which, incidentally, should be part of his duties. Once the train left, I decided to turn to the police, who had remained inert watching the scene from the same platform and, on the officer's advice, I reported what had happened to a company employee, who was unable to help me. Having needed to arrive in Florence that same evening, I was forced, by turning to another company, to spend 139 euros on the ticket. The next day I reasonably thought of contacting Italo Treno by telephone (later discovering that the call was paid) and, when I got in touch with an operator, I was denied a refund for the lost ticket. I sincerely hope that the company takes into consideration what I am reporting, providing passengers (who, it seems worth underlining, pay for the ticket regularly) a valid and efficient service.

We took Italo trains 3 separate time throughout our Italy trip, and we would take them again if we return to Italy. I booked online ahead of our trip. Of note, they routinely have sales, so if possible wait for a sale to book. Also, create an account and use the mobile app (it was super easy to have our tickets on our phone). For each train, we booked in Prima, and paid to select our seats. We were offered complimentary snacks and beverages each train, there was also free wifi, restrooms were easily accessible, luggage storage was clearly denoted, and there was a snack vending area in a few cars. Train from Venice to Florence: Car 1 is the closet to the train terminal and there are signs on the platform that align with each car (be aware when booking your seats if you get motion sickness). The front part of car 1 was Club and the back half was Prima. The train was on-time, easy and quick to board, and they came through to scan our tickets at some point during the ride. The sun rises on the left side with respect to train direction, however there are window shades available if needed. We had seats side by side, which we ultimately preferred since there are foot rests, while the seats facing each other with a table in between don't and leg space is more cramped. There is a reading light, tray table, seat back mesh pocket, coat hooks, and the seats slightly recline.Train from Florence to Rome (Roma Termini): Car 1 was the furthest from the station on the platform. Our train was about 10 minutes late leaving S.M. Novella, and about 25 minutes late in arriving to Roma Termini as a non-stop train. We were in Car 1 (same breakdown with Club as our first train) with single seats facing each other with a small table in between us (see comment above). The sun rises on the right side of the train just FYI. This was definitely an older train then our first one, yet still very comfortable. Of note, we travelled with carry-on size luggage which fit on the rack directly above our seats, so we didn't need to worry about watching our luggage during any stops with passengers getting on/off. Train from Rome (Roma Termini) to Milan (Milano Centrale): This station you actually need to scan your ticket to access the train platforms, and there was supposed to be a Fast Track on platform 12, but we didn't see anything special and there were no long lines. Car 1 was the closest to the station on the platform. Our train was about 5 minutes late leaving, and about 125 minutes late in arriving to Milan as a single-stop train (there were significant delays through the Florence area based on the announcements). We were in Car 2 (Since it was a long distance train, Car 1 was only Club) with single seats facing each other and a small table in between us (another older train). The sun rises on the right side of the train just FYI. This train there were definitely some issues with the free wifi, but took the opportunity with the delay to sleep. This ride there were actually two separate services, the first was typical, and then the second was offering an espresso. Obviously car 1 was the furtherest from the station when we arrived in Milan. At all of the stations, it was easy to locate where the Italo offices would be if there were any issues, as well as the lounges if your ticket included access. All stations had multiple electronic boards to locate platforms of arriving and departing trains so we had no issues.

I purchase tickets for €660, the withdrawal from my account is successful but I don't receive the tickets, I call the non-paid number, I explain the problem and they say that to receive assistance I have to call the paid number! SHAME.

Bad service, for a simple phone call where I had to change the ticket exorbitant price, I speak to the operator to ask for a change to the ticket after 3 minutes the line goes dead, I call back after 2 minutes the line goes back again cost of phone call over 11 euros, I feel cheated, it's never a case again Italo
It is fast, clean, comfortable! Free snacks and drinks inside, plus very nice staff. Loved Italo! ♥️

We were starnded in venice as they cancelled the train to Rome, had to pay 226 euros  to travel later in the day with another company.NO help from italo staff.badly run service with rude customer service people.They didnt care and were not interested.Still struggling to get our money back

Today 30/05 my in-laws left from Naples for Reggio Emilia....when they arrived at the station they realized that the suitcase was no longer there.....they spoke to the train conductor but he replied that they had to look on the site and that if it were to be found, a photo of the suitcase would be posted....I ask any of you if this semi-rigid light gray suitcase was taken by mistake....thanks to those who will help us, my in-laws are desperate....
I called customer service to change a ticket, after 4 attempts the line went dead each time) they refunded me 60 percent of the ticket, i.e. 11 euros and charged me 25 euros for the calls

The total lack of comfort I found on board an Italo from Rome to Milan Rho Fiera is unbelievable. It felt like animals packed into a cattle car. Insufficient space for people and luggage. It is only saved in terms of punctuality. Last time I take a high-speed train!

To say that it's just terrible is a compliment! Paid for 5 nearby seats, 2 of which are over eighty, advised 10 minutes before departure that we no longer have assigned seats. Now we are all scattered without making the journey together!!!!! Never again

FRIDAY Mestre station towards Rome. We get on the train, we place our luggage, we sit comfortably and after about 15/20 minutes from departure they tell us that due to a technical problem we have to move to the back of the train because the first carriages have become 1st class. But why not say it when we get on board? What is the point of having seats booked and assigned? However, the seats are comfortable and the environment is comfortable
The refund for the canceled train cannot be monetized either at the ticket office, or at home, or with the computer. The paid number has eaten up a lot of money. What a robbery.

Don’t repeat my mistake and please book a different train company. My mother and I had the worst experience traveling on any train with Italo for our trip from Rome to Florence. We have 2 luggage and decided to book first-class tickets so that we would have more space for our luggage. When we came onboard, we realized space for luggage was a lot more limited than we anticipated, even in the first-class car. We couldn't find anywhere to leave our 2 luggage, and saw that 5-6 other first-class customers also were having the same issue. No employer of the train DID ANYTHING to help us. They just saw the issue and walked by like nothing was happening and left the issues for us to solve on our own. My mother and I had no where to leave our luggage, so we asked another customer at the back-seat if we can leave our 2 luggage next to them, while making sure to leave them space to get out of their seat comfortably. The other customer kindly agreed and we could not be more grateful. The other 5-6 customers had to leave their luggage in the intersection between the 2-cars. We thought that was the end of our issue. Then one conductor walked by our car and started yelling at us for not leaving our luggage where they're supposed to (mind you, there was no space left on the rackets). They told us to put the 2 luggage up on the top-rack right above other customer's heads, where the luggage barely fit in. Now each of our luggage weight ~50kg each, so we didn't want to put them on top of anyone's head in the risk of falling and injuring anyone. The conductor kept telling us to just do it and then just stood there, leaving myself and my elderly mother to put each 50kg luggage on the top track by ourselves, while the train was shaking while going at full-speed. He did not offer help or apologies or anything. The other 5-6 customers with luggage issue also got the same treatment. We eventually got the luggage up-top, with 1 of them half dangling out while there was another woman with a baby sitting right below. To add insult to injuries, during our drink service, we wanted 1 extra candy bar, and they just threw it on our table, like they were feeding beggars. Just to remind you, we booked first-class tickets in order to have more enough space for our 2 luggage and be treated with simply respect. Low expectations, and yet we were still surprised and felt insulted by the terrible customer service offer on the train. The train otherwise was comfortable, but it was such a shame that a big company like Italo would offer that type of bad customer service.

the efficiency of a service can be seen in the moment of need. I bought a return ticket for May 20th, route Bologna Milan, Milan Bologna, in the morning the train leaves regularly, but the return one is cancelled. And when do they warn? When I already arrived in Milan. And what do they do? Nothing, because there is no room on the other trains. Result? I had to take Trenitalia paying 30 euros difference which Italo had to pay.

Brescia-Roma first class tickets that have absolutely nothing about first class. Very dirty carriage, we don't talk about the bathrooms. The drinks offered are dirty water, very limited choice for example no milk for children. The lights were too bright for 6 in the morning, it was impossible to close my eyes to get some rest, the loudspeaker volume was excessively high, repetitive and disturbing. Nothing that would make a long trip with 2 small children comfortable. The staff are normal, nothing more.

05.20.2023 Convenient only from Benevento to Rome where I changed for Brescia. I haven't traveled by train in years in favor of planes and I'm going back to planes.

They must refund the money the same place and way they take it .l have tried to get my money back by calling the numbers they provided and the website and had no luck .they do it in a way that you will have to give up

I purchased a return ticket Milan - Rimini on the Italo website, the system gave me 4 tickets: a Milan - Bologna AR with Italo and a Bologna - Rimini AR with Trenitalia. Unfortunately, due to the bad weather that hit Emilia Romagna, the Bologna - Rimini route is interrupted, but Italo refuses to change or modify the tickets because the Milan - Bologna route is working. Simona works at the train station, since it was my first time in Italy she was helping us purchase tickets 🎫 and explaining the train schedule for us. Great job Simona much appreciated 😍

Delays, delays, delays while also travelling like its 1999 with no wifi even if they say its included. The workers are then shocked when nobody can connect, try testing the wifi before your passengers enter perhaps? Its not rocket science.

If there was the possibility, not even one star. Train trip from Milan to Rome on May 6th; the train stops in Orvieto due to a fault, I get off like everyone else and the train leaves again after 3 hours without warning, with the result that I and others remain at the station. I manage to get on another Italo train, but having my luggage on the other one, I turn to the conductor who contacts the colleague on the other one. The latter ensures that he has found my suitcase and will look after it before returning it to me at Termini. I arrive at Termini station only 5 hours late and no assistance, no one knows what happened to the train, no one was waiting for me. My suitcase was lost, the Rekeep platform to which it should have been delivered tells me that the train conductor did not give them my suitcase saying that he would contact me. I go to the station again and the Italo employees contact, at my insistence, the mysterious lady who was the train conductor that day, a certain Rita with no surname because they are all secretive. Mrs. Rita reports that she waited 20 minutes and then, well, the suitcase disappeared without anyone knowing what happened to it. An unprecedented shame, an unparalleled massacre from a company whose tickets cost up to €150.00, concessionaire of a public service. In that suitcase there were precious objects to which I was emotionally attached, which Mrs. Rita will have appreciated. Obviously I will file a criminal complaint and I will also transmit the news to the main newspapers (including "Le Iene"), given the absence of any form of justice. Italo declines all responsibility and does not even respond to the lawyer's certified e-mails. The assistance number, in addition to being paid (only €1 per minute), is not reachable. There is no way to contact them. Very bad. Needless to say, I will never get on one of their trains again.

Booked this train to leave Rome to Naples at 12:40 to hopefully arrive in Naples on time to catch our flight, which was due to depart at 19:55 on the same day. Payed for upgraded tickets for that reason. The train was over 1:30 delayed, almost lost my flight. Stressful, disrespectful, untrustworthy.
Excellent, train leaves on time, sears comfortable, staff gives out snacks. Top luggage space is well thought of. Good ride
Terrible lounge in Naples: it's not possible with the terrible heat that the air conditioning doesn't work. The lounge is a paid service! Not a gift from Italo it should be handled better

May 6, Milan Rome 210 minutes late. No information, just the speaker periodically adding minutes to the delay. Unclassifiable, truly scandalous. I gave up on a trip to Rome because train 8953 was almost two hours late. I believed in a better company than Trenitalia, but we are on the same level, you both feel sorry for us, you are just mercenaries, shame on you, I am increasingly convinced of road transport with your own car.

Angry and non cooperative staff. Long queues and super slow working. I was on a business trip in Milan centrale and have to take to train to Rome Termini on 3/5 at 2:55 PM. I have traveled several times with Italo, I always feel very comfortable... train on time departing from Bologna and on time upon our arrival in Turin Porta Susa. Very comfortable and very clean

A very fast and comfortable journey from Rome to Bologna in prima class. Train on time. Seat huge and soft. Small snack and drink offered by nice crew.

Travel Milan/Florence and return in first class. All went well, the return scheduled for April 20th the train was canceled due to an accident on the line. Don't tell me that the refund will be exclusively with an Italo credit, because I might not be interested. So, to overcome the problem and not lose the entire amount, we spent more money to move the booking and left the next day, paying for the extra night in the hotel.

On the outward journey the train was canceled and not refunded. On the return journey there was a delay of more than an hour which made us miss the last connection. Information at the stations from the staff is confusing or non-existent. Take Red Arrow instead.

It's Florence Naples, I travel in Prima, there are no other seats available, paying your considerable amount, I tell myself that for once I'll pamper myself a bit. My trip was delayed 3 hours. The truth is I lost part of the day in Venice. I do not recommend it since the service was terrible and no one gave us an answer.
There is little space between one seat and another and the seat appears small in size. The price is not very competitive but the staff is friendly and the train is on time.

Disgusting, they change your seat and carriage 10 minutes before departure, you have to argue with people because they have the same seat as you and they don't give you a voucher or a small refund for the inconvenience
Uncommentable trip from Reggio Calabria to Milan. Not even room for your suitcase! Poor space between seats. Wifi not working! Poor hygiene!

Sorry to text this but the servixe is very bad, the girl who was checking was rude and the vagon was dirty, and cold, it was 18° and after all this i had to wear two coats. Trip from Verona to Roma a desaster!

We wanted to go from Rome to Naples and came across the Italo train. We were lucky and were able to buy cheap tickets (under 50 euros per person) for the “Salotto area”. With these tickets you can use the lounge at the train station. There you can get coffee, tea, cold drinks and small drinks for free. Eating baked goods and using the associated toilet. It's very comfortable there and you can relax and wait for the train with your luggage. There were three of us traveling and we had the Salotto area (designed for 4 people) to ourselves. It is, so to speak, a “cabin” in the carriage that can be closed. You will also be provided with free drinks and one or two small drinks. Bags of chips, olives, chocolate etc. supplied. It was a very relaxed journey from Rome to Naples and the time flew by. Everything was very comfortable, neat and clean. We can absolutely recommend this train for a trip from Rome to Naples. It was just a shame that the tickets were only “activated” very late. So you can't book far in advance.
This is a must see put it on your bucket list! Most amazing trip I have ever taken! And it was fantastic to share it with family!

Milan-Naples tripWifi not workingOn 4 drinks distribution machines; 1 credit card not working, 1 out of order. The 2 working ones only accept coins or banknotes of 5 or 10 euros. Welcome to the Middle Ages

There will be no next experience. Train to Rome Termini broken down and waiting for about hours at the station, without information or even the possibility of taking another train. Horrible experience as before I took Italo

I took an Italo train from Termini station to Venice, I immediately changed carriage and seat. I had to travel 10 carriages to find out where I had to, I had my seat booked, the staff was ambushed and rude

On our trip to Italy we made several trips on this train line.  Excellent since you reserve it.  The units are super well maintained, comfortable, and not to mention the speed at which you move from city to city.

Outward journey from Reggio Emilia to Rome on Friday afternoon 30 minutes late then reduced to just under ... return journey train with 30 then 35 now 50 minutes ... we hope to leave .... It's the first time I've traveled with Italo Turin/Rome round trip extra magic. Departure from Rome for Bergamo, 2 hour delay!! But so as NOT to have to refund everyone half of the ticket....left with a delay of 119 minutes! The driver has a heavy foot on the brake, it's one of the worst journeys ever taken, furthermore you're dying from the heat and there's not even the possibility of asking someone to regulate the temperature because there is an absolute absence of staff on the train.

traveling from Milan to Bologna I forgot my cell phone on the first class carriage. The train was headed for Rome. Absurd

I'm stuck in Bologna locked on the train for 2 hours these are completely unreliable scoundrels. Never again Italo call him a shit

Without words, a train where it is not possible to buy water with debit cards from vending machines, forcing me to make a 3 hour journey without being able to drink! In 2023 it is unacceptable. Never again!

The education of the staff... practically as soon as I got on the train I took a coffee from the machine where it was written that it gave change... There was no report and I lost the €5..... thanks Italo, really compliments
I would like to take this opportunity to give extremely positive feedback to Italo promoter "Simona" in Rome Termini station. Cordiality, kindness and friendliness in a single word: Professionalism.

I travel from Florence Santa Maria Novella to Naples Afragola, 2 days ago, my wife and I manage to catch the train in a hurry, I pay right there at the station at point Italo, obviously in a rush I forget to indicate my customer code. I WILL NEVER TRAVEL ON AN ITALO TRAIN AGAIN, SHAME ON YOU. IS THIS THE WAY TO TREAT CUSTOMERS? RED ARROW FOR YOUR WHOLE LIFE!!!
A train was canceled and I had to queue to have my seats reassigned 1 hour later. Without apologies and refunds. Ridiculous wi-fi connection, they should remove it first. Very bad
Shameful, they cancel trains and leave people in the lurch! Ten gold at the station before returning home. Disgust

I traveled with my cat on Italo, complete with a carrier provided and, since the seats assigned to those who had pets with them were unavailable at the time of purchase (even though on board they were occupied by people without pets!!!) I at least took care to choose a seat (for a fee) that had a single armchair and even an empty space next to the seat. In short, my area was quite free. In the entire first class carriage there were a maximum of five of us on the route. Naples-Brescia. Ascertaining that the carriage was empty and that my Ciro wanted to curl up on my lap, I took him out of the carrier. I specify that my cat, however unusual, is wearing a harness and I still kept him on a leash and well tied to me! None of the controllers who took turns told me anything. Until, about an hour after my arrival, the one who obviously doesn't like cats arrived. He immediately threatened to give me a fine, without considering the context in which we were: semi-deserted carriage; the cat on my seat and on my lap, without anyone else I will walk around. I pointed out to him that I have always seen small dogs on a leash, not in carriers. But he ordered me again to put the "dog" (because my cat called him a dog!!!) in the carrier, think sanction. I have no words. Apart from the fact that there are ways and ways to say things, but then guarantee those who have a pet in tow to be able to use the suitable seats, at least. Or give some employees a chamomile tea, because it really wasn't a circumstance in which the animal was annoying other people or was making a mess or was doing any inhumane activity. I think my cat is more polite than someone who calls and makes a fuss in the silence area, as usual. They should get fines too. Congratulations Italo!

I have never seen such horible service before. How complicated can it be to buy a ticket? Very. They have these machines where you can buy them, but you have to enter the name, phone number and email for each person on the tichet. We were four, including a 2 year old. We waited 15 minutes for the 3-4 people struggling  în front of us to type, delete, retype...Then we went through the whole filling process. At the end we got the receit but not the tickets. We went to the other side of the train station, crossing the rail tracks, were they had to return our money and then  retype everything to buy new tickets.
