I also asked if there another train from another company that was leaving sooner. They said no, although there were at least two trains that went to Florence until we left. Very frustrating!
A 10-hour journey without a sandwich and/or anything else to eat. Trenitalia has a restaurant carriage. Distributors not provided

For three days I have been trying to register for the "Italo Più" loyalty program to get the benefits indicated on the home page of the site, but the message "unable to register. Try later" appears. Same problem in the Italo app. A telephone operator tells me that the technical problem is present throughout Italy and that it "should" be resolved tomorrow morning. He then informs me that I can purchase the tickets by telephone, providing him with the credit card details (including the security code). Are we kidding? Who can assure me that they don't misappropriate my balance?  In practice, those who urgently need to leave must settle for the full price (intended for non-registered people), or blindly rely on the telephone operator. Folly

Customer service to the limits of the complaint. Only paid number - and this already outlines the style - plus on the other number, indicated as "for modification/purchase of tickets" waiting time 32 minutes, 15 minutes for the first call with a classic drop in the line, 17 minutes for the second to be told that "that number is not used for ticket purchases and modifications". Ah, needless to say that the "refunds and exchanges" section on the site is in constant "momentary technical problem", precisely to push you to call and spend 55 cents per minute (plus 30 for the answer) which, given the time they have, means spending the money for any refund. I would say to learn from Amazon the respect of customers and the customer friendliness "Ah, needless to say that....", number two: I have been waiting for a refund since August for a train that left two hours late on a journey of one and a half hours. We are in January.

We often travel by train and prefer to pay more for first class both for the space in the seats and for the quiet. Result? A nightmare. Carriage full of people, rude people shouting on the phone, parents holding their children in their arms and making them play by kicking the back of the person in front of you and talking loudly as if they were at home. Usually first class differs in its tranquility, the attention received from the on-board staff and the presence of people who want silence. This trip reminds me of when I was a child and traveled on the express train of the state railways!!!!! Shame on you!
Use Frecciarossa instead of this awful company. They’re much better.  No hidden fees that “pop up” when they check your ticket…
It deserves zero stars, they are shameful, to use ITALO CLUB they asked for 10 euros per person, with a Smart ticket... I know they don't care but they lost a customer

Some inconveniences that passengers suffer with Trenitalia are unfortunately identical with Italo. The lack of cleanliness in general, especially around travellers' seats, is a constant in both companies. As well as the bathrooms, one in two doesn't work and/or is out of paper and soap. Italo manages to be even slower than Trenitalia: on the same route and with the same stops, 45 minutes longer for no apparent reason. The "average" rating refers to Italian transport which is of a low level but on average among them
Excellent (and only) alternative to Trenitalia's red/white arrows, prices always very competitive, shame about the sometimes less than optimal timetables.

I have always traveled with Italo but today an absurd disappointment!!!! On a 34-minute Salerno-Naples route the conductor made me pay 90 euros because my 4kg Maltese dog wasn't traveling in the carrier......he was in my arms in a travel bag just for him....also he's a very calm dog...I wouldn't have complained if it had been a sensible sum but 90 euros seemed like an abuse...especially in these times!!!!

In short, by taking club first class you expect a trip that is pampering. I was really curious about Italo, having always traveled by train. So I was a little disappointed...constant noises, staff in short....If I were them I would work hard to improve because in fact they are all things that can be improved...we would need that feeling of pampering that the competitor offers in abundance. Meh.

The staff working on the train, this evening, from Milan to Genoa...were so kind with me! They did all they could to make me Happy.Speaking of a Train more than half hempty and sold in as full by the Italo vending machine in Milano Centrale....a whole lot more to improve.

20' late on the outward journey with consequent loss of the connection and an hour's wait for the next one, 40' late on the return journey with consequent parking surcharge already paid by anticipating a half hour delay in advance. But Italo always manages to surprise you negatively. Water for washing hands practically non-existent. Poorly heated environment. Delays on the Rome-Turin route are quite frequent and reported by users for a long time but the service does not improve. Maybe it's time to spend a little more and travel with Frecciarossa.

If I could select 0 stars I would! Unfortunately I find myself traveling on high-speed trains due to work for many years, almost every weekend, spending around 500 euros a month, all at my expense obviously. For this Christmas I purchased a gift card (both from Italo and TRENITALIA) to get a miserable discount. I purchased a one-way ticket using the aforementioned gift card in which a certain amount remains. of euros. I look for another ticket for another day, enter the code and SURPRISE! I can't use it. I wrote to Italo and I was told that the gift card could only be used once and therefore the remaining amount was lost. In 2023 I can't believe how miserable a company like Italo can be. THERE IS NO GIFT CARD IN THE WORLD THAT CANNOT BE USED SEVERAL TIMES. I am disgusted and embittered. The services they offer you were not enough, including: toilets, rudeness and various delays. I bought from Italo when it was really convenient but from now, with a few euros difference, dear gentlemen, I can assure you that I will always and only purchase ARROWS from Trenitalia.

Very poor wifi connection, preventing you from watching films or listening to music. Luckily iPods still exist! You could choose the wifi option, and those who don't want it pay less for the ticket, at least I'm not paying for a non-service.

I've always had a good time. I've only had an hour's delay once, otherwise always on time. Automatic machines on board the train for water and snacks. I also tried the Prima which compared to the Smart only has the snack service, even the seats seem the same to me. It's not worth the difference.
For what it costs, the train has a low standard of cleanliness. An intermediate cleaning should be considered on long-haul routes
Really rude and rude staff!! Controller on the Milan Centrale Caserta train on December 24th at 5.15pm rude...change job!!!! I absolutely do not recommend Italian
The third world. Today we really seem to be on the boats of non-EU citizens. No space for suitcases, dirty train, totally non-existent wifi connection. For its prices, I don't recommend it.

Estimated departure time from Rome Termini is 5.40pm. At 5pm we received a message saying we were 70-80 minutes late. Delay of which Italo was informed from the moment of departure from Bari (expected departure time 1pm, actual 2.15pm) but did not even think of informing users in advance. Abandoned at the station, we ask at the Italo stand if it is possible to sit at least somewhere, answer: "eh no in these cases no" and in which cases then? When will you learn to work decently? Shameful, if I could I would have given you ZERO rating.
I travelled in Executive Club class. Journey was very comfortable, access to Italo club lounge was very convenient

Or for one reason or another, on December 15th at 7.35pm I wait in Turin Porta Susa for the train arriving from Turin Porta Nuova, an hour late, on December 17th from Milan Centrale to Turin, the train arrives from Naples an hour late...but are we sure it is a high-speed train?

Terrible experience on the Villa San Giovanni-Rome Termini route. The outward journey, despite the noted discomfort of the very narrow seats, was passable and in more or less humane conditions. At each station a cleaner took care of cleaning the toilets which were decent and usable. Furthermore, once the train arrived in Naples it arrived in Rome using high speed, taking only 50/55 minutes. The real problem arose on the return journey. As soon as we got on the train it was packed with people and full to capacity. The same came from central Milan and consequently by going up to Rome Termini there was almost no longer any possibility of storing the luggage. But the biggest disappointment was the seats for four divided by a sort of table that acted as a divider from the other two seats in front. The following seats do not have the same legroom as the two-seat seats, nor the footrest and the object holder. You are practically on top of each other, unable to carry out any type of activity such as getting up and going to the bathroom without disturbing the journey of three other people. It would be sufficient to inform travelers of the positions of these seats so that they can decide when booking to avoid them altogether by paying the supplement. Furthermore, the train never used the AV from Rome and Naples, taking an hour and a half. The cleaning staff never showed up making the toilet unworthy and unusable. The only praise: the train arrived on time both on the outward and return journey. Only one conclusion: NEVER AGAIN.

Terrible, terrible, terrible. On strike day I bought a second ticket since the first one wasn't guaranteed. Paid assistance is a joke. When I requested a refund at Rome Termini I was treated very badly, they were impatient and tried to lecture me. never again Italo never again.
Very efficient to get around Italy! Simona was very helpful and friendly. Look for her whenever you are at Roma termini. She’s amazing!

Another scam suffered, I book online by entering the data for electronic invoicing within the day, the invoice does not arrive and after about an hour of attempts at 892020 I manage to find out that since they don't think I have entered the data (false), no invoice and related VAT recovery.

6 hours on the train without a bar service and what's more with vending machines that don't accept debit cards or credit cards, not to mention the wi-fi as if it wasn't there... in 2022 it's unacceptable we are at the levels of regional trains... FrecciaRossa for life!

I traveled first class on December 9th, from Rome to Naples with Italo. We waited in vain throughout the trip for the welcome service with drinks and snacks, but no one came by. We asked for explanations and they rudely told us that there hadn't been time and suggested we make a complaint. We made a complaint using the methods provided on the Italo website and we received a banal response which tells us that Italo respects everything legally required and that if we are not satisfied we can turn to the judicial authorities. An absolutely ridiculous response, considering the extent of the report. In practice, the total disinterest in customer satisfaction is evident.

It is the most horrible trip, I do not recommend it to anyone. 250 dollars in first class, my husband and I, nothing to eat or drink, not even buying it, a small machine only cash with only cookies and chips, we had traveled by TRAIN ITALY and everything was different, they gave us sparkling wine and we had somewhere to buy food, however this company offers you things and there is nothing, imagine traveling for 3 hours without being able to drink or eat something, only water and chips, well I don't drink sodas or juices or anything sweet jams, we are ready for a glucose coma, I'm sorry for ruining my vacation trip with that money, I could have gone by plane faster, I'm sorry, thank you.

Venice Rome at 12.05. Booked seat in FIRST class at full fare Rome-Venice. Two travelers we were forced to travel on a folding seat. NARROW SEAT WITHOUT TABLE 90 DEGREE SEAT not reclining (such as short-distance local train). I asked the conductor (train manager) to change seats. He told me that he was working with a crashed reservation system and that I essentially had to adapt to the accommodation. I REPEAT A PLACE PAID AND BOOKED FLEXI FIRST CLASS WITH COMFORT less than a second on regional. The most annoying thing is the complete absence of assistance, traveling staff who decline all responsibility and do not qualify, a predatory online sales system that sells seats in the dark with services that do not exist and then once on the train they also try to pass off the fold-up seats as seats similar to the others. In short, first I'm cheating, then I'm also mocking. Never again Italo. For another last gem, the complaints number 892020 is also paid... they don't miss an opportunity. Incredible
Rude and uninformed customer service. If you need Italian assistance, ask the red arrow officials
A ridiculous transport...shameful...perpetually late...unworthy of being paid...a total inefficiency, always ready to find any excuse for the unexpected delay...Shame

3 operators gave me three different versions making me lose the possibility of changing the Flex ticket with their incorrect operations. I WILL NEVER TAKE ITALO AGAIN AND I WILL NOT RECOMMEND IT TO EVERYONE. In comparison to Trenitalia they are competent. VERY BAD SERVICE AND MONEY LOST THROUGH THEIR POOR SERVICE!!!

We have already traveled with Italo in the past, but this time we didn't have a good time at all. Pros: comfortable seats Cons: very noisy train, dirty and poorly functioning bathrooms, coffee machines not working, cold cabin temperature (we traveled for 6 hours with the jacket on). It is advisable to travel with another company (possibly with the heating on!).
Slow and useless WiFi connection. Non-existent staff. Ridiculous and insufficient space to store luggage.

But are you really doing it? To pee for a moment in your reception room you asked for €8 and what if I had to do more? Luckily the ticket I had was first class and I wasn't leaving but arriving...And you didn't make me do it...thank you

We left from Rome Termini directly to Villa San Giovanni, which I must say was a very relaxing and comfortable journey. The train was 10 minutes late but we arrived on time at the Villa San Giovanni station. We traveled in Smart, the seats were very comfortable with footrests and reclining backrests, charging sockets under the seats and the basket. We used the italolive catalog to watch various films during the trip with the WiFi provided by the train which, despite being in the tunnel, has excellent reception. We had a very good time and we certainly will we will take on other trips!!!

Since 2006 a group of entrepreneurs (including Luca Cordero di Montezemolo and Diego Della Valle) founded the company ITALO Nuovo Trasporto Viaggiatori S.p.A. Trenitalia's monopoly in the national rail passenger transport sector has finally been taken away. Unlike Trenitalia (chronically late and without qualified on-board staff), ITALO offers trains with a new technological concept, comfortable seats designed by Poltrona Frau, punctuality and above all a better on-board service than on a business class flight. The only drawback is that WiFi is slow in general and absent in the tunnel (although it must be said that this depends on the lack of infrastructure of the telephone operators).

Bari Florence train with return. on time in both cases. just the right temperate air. bathrooms clean enough. attentive staff. Wifi non-existent. traveled both in Smart and first class. differences: slightly larger space between the seats and the snacks in first.

Train 9920, 07:20 - 14:18, Salerno / Turin. WE ARE IN FIRST CLASS: bathrooms impractical, better to get off at the station and go to the public toilets. For a journey of about 7 hours, the Stuarts only stopped by twice, with minimal choice of food/drinks. The staff is reduced to a minimum and is inattentive to the needs of the customers. Only when I showed the photos of the bathrooms to the train conductor, they decided to send a cleaner.

I travel very often with Italo and, unlike many negative reviews, I am happy with it. I buy tickets well in advance so I pay little to travel from Rome to Milan and vice versa. With some exceptions, there are on-board staff who come to clean the bathrooms during the trip. The only flaw: both the Italo wifi and the data connection... it barely works... too bad it would be a nice pastime during the trip...
He is always late, never once on time. He should have arrived at 12.55pm 15 minutes late now it's 1.14pm he hasn't arrived yet

First trip with Italo and perhaps the last. Rovereto-Rome route. Booking first class online went well but as soon as we got on the train there was chaos for seats. Carriage and seats changed without any warning and "bailame" with other passengers who suddenly have no idea where they should sit. Friendly and helpful on-board staff but logistics management quite lacking. Thanks to the availability of passengers, the seat tetris is ultimately successful but the same problem reoccurs at every station. If you are traveling alone you can find a quick solution but if you are traveling as a family with teenagers and have booked close seats it is not possible to reassign them without taking these factors into account

The most total disgust. Dirty train, detached baskets, pitiful bathrooms. To make sure we don't miss anything, we enjoy the train on the street and they make us take another train that arrived an hour later. Compensation promised? NEVER ARRIVED.  Be very careful
Punctual, clean and friendly staff...but you can't die of cold!!! I also read reviews when it's very hot...so, they definitely don't know how to manage the temperature!!😩😃

Bad Wi-Fi, virtually unusable. Continuous shouting in the carriage. Train conductor non-existent. Tickets not checked

We used Italo train services as much as possible in a 5 weeks trip around Italy. We had good experiences. It had air conditioner and free wifi. Also, space to put our suitcases.Also, prices were very affordable. However, Italo does not run all routes in Italy, then we had to switch to Trenitalia. Comparing both I think Italo is by far much better.
Punctual clean and bar service included, book online and get on without having to print a ticket, it did its duty, in 4.50 min Bergamo Rome

Not advisable. I was traveling for business having to work as usual while traveling and I got - without any prior information - assigned  a handicap seat, with no table, no hanger for jacket, no space for suitcase and in an area packed with other clients suitcase. And when I asked to change seat, I have got no help whatsoever, if this was not enough the train had 15 minutes delay, and I was told this is pretty usual as Trenitalia gets priority. Kind of a nightmare experience which I will not to repeat.
40 minutes late. Cattle carriage with no less than 27 degrees. Lower air conditioning demand. Answer: we have already done so. The train manager, given the delay, was never seen again...

I traveled with my family of 4 adults in a smart carriage. At the time of booking there was no other availability. Unfortunately, the assigned seats were not close together and the spaces were limited. Furthermore, the carriages were dirty and it kept coming from the bathrooms... zero ventilation. Good for punctuality and friendly staff.

We used Italo for the first time and we were really very happy. From the assistance at the station (central Milan and Florence Santa Maria Novella and vice versa) to the journey and the cleanliness found on the train. Congratulations to everyone…

We have taken the Italo train  #8908 from Bologna Centrale to Venezia St. Lucia station . It left Bologna on time and arrived at Venice on time. The train was very clean (even though the original departure point of the train was Napoli, I think), and the seats were comfortable. During the one and a half hour ride - soft drinks, coffee and pastries were served (like a service on a flight).We bought the ticket on-line, 22.00 Euros per person "low cost prima" fare, (no special rate for Seniors), and got the exact window seats that we booked.We have enjoyed the ride and we recommend it.

Terrible management. I leave my bag on the train, go to customer service and they give me two phone numbers that don't work and a site where they post lost items. I go to the police station, I provide the details of the trip and they tell me that the Italian driver has it and they tell the police that they will publish it on the platform. It was never published! Italo Bologna terrible, they don't help at all!
Bad experience with the train, no clear info for the train, eg train number was wrong, staff was rude, train delay more than 35mins.

Terrible Customer ServicePaid telephone assistance even for those who are customers and have already spent hundreds and hundreds of euros on tickets. Rude and arrogant staff. They waste time on the phone so they lose money and in the end they don't even solve the problem.

Let me start by saying that I often travel on Italo and I never thought I would find myself in such a situation. Around 9am on 20 10 2022, I book a ticket, the site works badly and keeps reloading the page. I finally manage to select the ticket for 10 27 2022 at 6.10am from Turin Porta Nuova for 12.90 euros, I proceed by inserting my credit card and finally I receive the ticket. I check the date on the ticket again and I see that the site has booked me the same train at 6.10am but for 26 10 2022, therefore one day earlier. I decide to call customer service to try to find a solution, exactly a few minutes after the incorrect booking. The very polite call center guy apologizes saying that he can't do anything because it's a rate that doesn't include exchange. I also pay 5 euros for the call. Now I wonder, is it possible that I have to pay for something that the system booked for me incorrectly? 12.90 +5 euro call, basically I paid 18 euros to have nothing in hand. Basically Italo works on quantity, the more it sells tickets at low cost, the more it earns on the systems that book the wrong tickets! Instead focus on the service. I was a regular customer but at this point I will have to change.

We decided to try the Italian train, Desenzano/Rome. (we usually take Trenitalia) we took the 1st class tickets, we got on and we couldn't find the numbers of the seats booked (carriage 1) after some back and forth we finally asked the ticket inspector and he sent us to carriage 4 because they replaced the train but we were not notified, neither with an email nor with a message (they had our names). THOSE WHO LEAVE THE OLD WAY FOR THE NEW ONE KNOW WHAT THEY LEAVE BUT NOT WHAT THEY FIND.

Milan Rho Fiera-Reggio Calabria route. I had the opportunity to use this train to go from Milan to Naples and vice versa: disappointing experience! Small and not very clean train. Special spaces for luggage are absolutely inadequate considering that the route is long and passengers are certainly not traveling only with small luggage.

The assistance number is paid and costs more than an intercontinental call, plus it should be added that the operators put you on hold with the sole purpose of making the time pass. The result is that I spent more than 20 euros and I didn't solve my problem.. Hope you never have to call customer support..

From the US and wepurchased 16 train ticketsmany months ago to getfrom Rome toNaples/Capri. However toget to Capri, we had to usethe Ferry and the returnFerry ride was seriouslydelayed due to extreme,severe weather and weunfortunately, after rushing,arrived at the train fiveminutes too late. We wentin to look for assistance and was told that they would nothonor our return ticketbecause of the low price andwe were forced to purchasesixteen new tickets at a costof approximately $53 perperson. The attendant andher boss could have caredless that our delay was theresult of bad weather, high waves and unpreventable  ferry delays with a ferry that tried to capsize many times.  Theferry ride was so bad thatpeople were falling, glasswas breaking and alcoholwas falling out of the bararea. We were in danger!We did our best to arrivetimely but are lucky to stillbe alive.

We booked online tickets for three people on the same day from Rome to Florence. The service was excellent. Departure was punctual in both directions. Going, we were traveling in first place. Big, comfortable seats, with a lot of space in front of the legs. It had sockets for charging a mobile phone. Coffee or juice as well as a snack were offered during the wonderful ride. On the way back we had single seat tickets. A minimal difference in terms of dimensions and comfort and of course the treat was missing. I can say that the experience is worth it. As for the cost of the tickets, there are many offers that one can find depending on the time of travel and the trip does not cost much. So it's worth it

Italo is truly terrible. First and only experience. If you can choose anything else, do it, even a trip on the back of a mule. I'll tell you about my experience. Then I have no doubt that others may have had excellent impressions of it. Despite the communication in advance, it was not possible to change the time or request a refund to get another ticket. On the site (and on the annoying daily emails they send) they advertise discounts and promo codes which, in reality, do not exist. Even with the BOLOGNA code they advertise discounts which have not been applied (55.90 as an unregistered user, 55.90 as a registered user, 55.90 with the code BOLOGNA). Number to contact customer service, an 892 at exorbitant costs, not contactable from most cell phones (in my case, three phones with three different operators). Trying to contact the landline number, after an infinite wait, a rather sour young lady continually told me to contact the number 892, despite the fact that I had explained several times that it wasn't possible for me from my cell phone. He repeated the procedure to follow like a recorded tape in an increasingly annoyed and reproachful tone (now, I understand that it wasn't his dream to work in a call center, I'm privileged to have achieved mine, but I can't explain his rude and contemptuous nature, as if the interlocutors were inept). Last but not least, the aforementioned telephone operator, confirming the professionalism with which he carries out his work, decides to send me a fanc... and closes the conversation. Rating 0. I was complaining about Trenitalia but, compared to Italo, they are great professionals, even though I continue to consider them really poor. If I, as a doctor, did my job with the same passion as them, I would have a lot of complaints and disciplinary proceedings. P.S. I wanted to return the wish to the telephone operator, since someone like her floats and wallows there

I boarded in Turin with a bulky "hold" baggage, but which I could not fit in the designated compartment as it was far from my seat (in first class) and unattended. I couldn't risk my luggage being stolen. I placed it in front of my feet, making myself uncomfortable, but making sure not to hinder the service staff. Everything was fine until 40 minutes before my arrival in Rome. At a certain point, the person in charge of distributing food (and not the train conductor who had already seen my accommodation several times without saying anything) ordered me (rudely) to remove my luggage and put it in the designated compartment. At that point I traveled standing, in front of the bathrooms, to be able to store my suitcase. I am aware that I couldn't keep the suitcase in front of the seat, but I couldn't do otherwise. There are no indications on the dimensions of the suitcases. I also wonder: if the train conductor and the staff checking the tickets didn't make any comments to me, why did a restaurant worker have to do so? Furthermore, I felt called a liar... UNACCEPTABLE!!! I have now purchased the return ticket, but Italo is unlikely to be among my future choices again.

For sure ITALO will no longer see us going up. Paid 100 euros just for a small dog in tow. What type of assistance do you give to pets since they don't even have space to get out of the carrier? Noisy rolling stock with abnormal vibrations. Wi Fi non-existent except for commercials which, on the contrary, work very well with every connection attempt. Difference between SMART and PRIMA? Perhaps for a snack and a coffee which was promptly declined and refused? 351.00 euros for a service that I hope to never use again. CENTRAL NAPLES not even a chair in a waiting room. I enter the Lounge Club and discover that I have to pay 7 euros each just to access it. You are forced to stay outside the access part with unsavory acquaintances and sit on makeshift seats. Communication of the platform 12 minutes before departure with Fantozzi-like scenes of approach to the carriages. There is and you can choose better. ITALO adieu !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Due to strike, cancellation of the train on 9 September. The call center staff was kind, contacted before the departure date, who tried to find an alternative (unfortunately not possible due to incompatibility of schedules), and who reassured me SEVERAL TIMES that I would receive a full refund for the trip (return for 3 people). Received partial refund (A only). Contacted the call center again, which this time suggested I only call the paid number. Complaint sent via web and two communications via PEC. Result: identical and standard answers, with which they reiterate my "obligation" to use the PAYMENT number....But is it ever possible????!!! Isn't it enough to see me canceling the train half an hour before departure, having to make do to get to my destination by my own means, seeing me reimbursed around 1/4 of the amount spent months before, despite the reassurances of a full refund? Now I have to spend more money to get any response??? If generally replying is courtesy, IN THIS CASE IT IS A DUTY FOR ITALO and a right for the user! I willingly accepted the inconvenience because it was due to strike, but what followed is TRULY INDECENT!

Treviso 8.31am on 10th October...a LONE mother with a 3 month old baby, pram and suitcase...she can only travel if some kind soul helps her get on the train...because no platform or other support service is made available to the passenger to access the train...and nothing is specified during the purchase phase...the switchboard operator on the phone (for a fee of more than 1 euro per minute) is the only thing he was able to do tell me....surely you will find someone who will help you....I'm shocked! Italo never again! Nb: upon inquiring I discovered that Frecce Rossa provides a FREE assistance service even for those who do not have disabilities but simply need help! This service is called blue room!

Very easy company to deal with, I was able to swap trains when our plans changed. Travelled premium class, we used the Italo lounge in Milan. The service was excellent from all staff. The train left Milan precisely on time and arrived in Firenze on time.. The service on the train was very good with sandwich lunch and drinks supplied. The lounge in Milan was very clean with drinks and snacks available. The train very comfortable and clean. Will certainly use again and recommend

One star is too many. September 9th, Milan-Salerno train not guaranteed due to strike. I had return tickets, I made the request for a refund on the same day, I was ignored, they pretended nothing had happened, at the call center I was told that I am not entitled to a refund and the complaint was answered vaguely and uselessly. Shame on you, you've been taking my money for years and just once I ask for a refund, it's your fault, too, are you making such a fool of yourself? When Trenitalia refunds everything easily in the same case??? I will never travel with Italo again. Disgust.

35 minutes late on departure from Rome, then we were held for 40 minutes close to Naples. We were supposed to get to Naples at 10:53. Now it’s 12:00 and we’re still stuck. Also it’s very hard to understand how to get compensation. Don’t take this company!
Heat and 1 hour delay leaving Rome for Verona. Absurd. They don't respect anyone. I chose an early time, but I will still be late for my appointments.

I took a trip from Rome to Verona, when I got on the train it was a shock, it felt like I was entering a dry sauna, that's ok, the train is about to leave and it should get better, what, the train that was supposed to leave at 8:25, left at 8:37, and it only predicted that it left because at a speed of 15 to 20 k/h in 30 minutes we arrived at Roma Tiburtina station and then a 7-minute technical stop left again at turtle speed, an hour before the scheduled time for departure, we were still in the metropolitan area of Rome and with our shirts soaked in sweat, I don't recommend it, rent a car, take a bus or a trenitalia, go on foot, but give up on Ítalo, terrible,

Absurd and depressing how much the Wi-Fi service you offer sucks. I have been traveling first class for years now and have never experienced worse service than this. Already 5 hours to travel from Bergamo to Rome. Add to that the one hour delay. Obviously no refunds. Very bad

The worst that can be said about this company, very bad, late flights and bad crew, they have no solutions to compensate the passenger for the delay, very very very bad company, i will not book on this rabish company again never never never

A more than positive experience starting from the reservation via the toll-free number for ticket purchase and request for assistance for people with disabilities. Milan-Rome, Prima environment. A few minutes late arriving in Rome (about 10). The comfort of the seats and the snack/breakfast service that passes in the carriage are excellent. In my opinion, the comparison with Trenitalia wins.

BAD. Train number 9927. An eternity from Florence to Rome Termini, it stopped countless times along the way. I missed three connections for them and obviously paid dearly for the ticket: 40 euros. Shame on you, I hope I never find myself in the situation of having to GIVE YOU MONEY as a GIFT
1 ball because you can't do less, a shameful experience, even without criticizing the assistance strike insists on you

Ticket taken a month before, terrible strike management. I'm 700 km from home and I have to look for a hotel? Luckily you're a private company, I hope I never have to deal with you again
Lazy service. Unfriendly staff. Don't take any responsibility for their paying customers. No special service for first class passengers. No clear communication with the customer.

Shameful management of the strike! I bought a ticket on a day when there was going to be a strike. Italo doesn't allow you to leave on another day but only on the same day with a "guaranteed train according to them", shameful!!! They don't know where to get the money

Train strike is scheduled for Friday 9th September and mine is not guaranteed. I call the indicated number and in addition to not giving me the possibility of having a refund in advance as is possible on the Frecciarossa, it doesn't give me alternatives and on the available train not having seats in the same class it doesn't allow me to change even by paying or losing money. I'm in smart, I have the first one, I ask them to give me the smart one, I don't want to get upset and they tell me no. In the end, the problem is mine. I have to go and wait if it goes well otherwise nothing. And I also booked the hotel which I risk losing. From complaint

Italo requires the use of masks but does not provide passengers with the ability to purchase one on the train. 99% of Italy does not currently require the use of masks which makes it likely that passengers, especially those who do not travel every day / tourists, may forget. The “train manager” required us to ask other passengers for masks - which they did not have - and was extremely unpleasant and persistent on an 50% empty train. We saw other people also have the same issue. After we walked through 5 cars asking other passengers for masks and failing. The “train manager” magically found masks and proceeded to give us a lecture on traveling in another country and Covid procedures. Perhaps this was racially motivated because we have been on  other Italo trains where passengers were given masks. Another passenger stated that they had masks available on another train they rode and she proceeded to say that is because ItaliaRail is a publicly funded train. As a private business, we would have expected Italo to be more commercial, especially when purchasing their “business class” Prima tickets.

We traveled from Milan to Naples return and booked first class seats. Clean environment, friendliness of the assistants, possibility three times to have coffee, tea or drinks with biscuits or pretzels, clean toilets, comfortable and spacious seats (single seats with table) and, very importantly, Italo was very punctual!!!

In addition to leaving with a 20 min delay. I discover that the 4 booked table seats do not exist, the explanation given to us is that for technical reasons the train has been changed and any seat is occupied with the same class. So tables were also occupied by those who hadn't booked them. There are 4 of us traveling in different carriages for a journey of over 5 hours. Very bad experience.

Italo club offers a medium-low level of service, the catering service is practically non-existent, and the environment is also not comparable with what is provided in the Trenitalia executive environment

Train delay. Experience not to be repeated. Do we realize that the toll-free number where you can request information or change reservations is subject to a fee? €0.30 response charges €0.54 per minute. After I have already spent the money on the tickets. A shame. But who knows, maybe companies will change in Italy...
I don't understand the presence of people who claim to be from Telethon on Italo trains. Why aren't checks done?
Just a note: the air conditioning is too high, I froze. Otherwise clean, punctual, friendly and professional staff.

60 minutes late (Rome-Udine) accompanied by over an hour standing at the mercy of the train's oscillations... poor Wi-Fi service and food dispensers not provided. Seat different from the one assigned, very narrow in Smart class.

I am now traveling on an Italo train, I am not at all satisfied with the mask checks, I don't like wearing the Ffp2 but since it is mandatory, I wear it, evidently not everyone thinks like me: some wear it under their nose, others have the surgical one, others still don't wear it at all. Who should check???

It seems like a joke, they say that there is Wi Fi on board when in fact it only works if you use their application. If you try to use any other app other than theirs the wi fi suddenly stops working. At least avoid writing that there is wi fi throughout the train. For the rest everything is ok.

We chose Italo for a holiday in Venice, from Turin, with exchange in Milan Centrale (round trip). With the promotion, we chose first class on both trips and were satisfied. Comfortable seats, great welcome service, clean bathrooms. The problems were waiting: in all cases the trains were all announced 10 minutes before departure, with the consequence that we had to run from one side of the station to another so as not to miss the train. Too bad the Lounge Club wasn't included in the price and we didn't think it was necessary to add it to our trip.

Terrible, the worst high speed trip of my life. I'm currently on the Turin-Naples train and the USB sockets don't work. There are three guys who have been disturbing us since they got in by laughing and talking loudly and also trying to open a bottle of alcohol: wouldn't it be a good idea to take a trip every now and then to check? Total lack of staff

€95 from Turin to Lamezia, 1 hour of senseless delay, this train and the whole company makes me vomit, bathroom of my broken carriage so 2 hours in line, close the company, trust me, make a better impression

I made a ticket for my son with the Italo app, I didn't receive the email with the code while Paypal immediately sent me the report via email. I called 06 422991 because I don't have credit, they attacked me repeatedly, then a very unwell girl answered and told me to keep my voice down (it was very low) and told me repeatedly that she wouldn't give anything. For now I'm without a ticket for my son and then why do you have to pay for the call when Trenitalia is free with standard fares. I hope the email arrives with the ticket. Never again with Italo....big companies recognize themselves on these small details, this company doesn't have much progress.

I have been traveling on Italo since its foundation. But today on the 8158/60 on the route from Salerno to Bologna a strange case is happening: every time the train enters a tunnel the driver turns on the horn. Will it be for safety or for fun? If it were a once or twice game it would be fun too. At 3 it becomes a pain in the ass. However, average service and discreet cleanliness of the train. Rating 3*

Unlike the reviews I read in the days before my departure, which had made me worry, I am happy to express my positive opinion on Italo for the Milan-Foggia route. It's probably a matter of "luck" but I traveled very well: train on time, clean, right air conditioning, comfortable location (single first class seat). The only criticism was the wifi with rather fluctuating reception.
Excellent transportation from Milan to Rome.  Very easy and comfortable.  Recommend it...spring for the first class

pleasant punctual train I booked several routes rome termini florence florence venice return I booked smart and first I am very satisfied dry my family comfortable on time numbered seat I highly recommend it

The train left Florence 15 minutes late and arrived at Benevento station more than 2 hours late. The expected refund was 50% of the ticket per person. There were 4 of us: 2 adults and 2 teenagers, they only refunded us 25% for the two tickets!!!! And the children???? The rest of the refund???? It never arrived!!! The staff on the train were very helpful and very kind (5 stars), from an administrative point of view - terrible
Second class Paola Reggio there are no rules.. everyone without masks and the controllers pretend nothing happened... absurd....

I just bought a Prime-low cost ticket but I got the wrong name and it won't let me change it anymore. Can anyone tell me if there are penalties at the time of the check? The name should have been my brother but instead it automatically went with my surname
As always Italo precise. You need to bring an electronic device from home for some entertainment on the train. As always excellent. Excellent.

Currently traveling, on time, clean and everything perfect except that the ticket inspector has already come by twice to check the tickets but has never checked the masks. The train registration only repeats that you only travel with ffp2 under penalty of interruption of the journey, but... many have simple surgical masks and some kids even got on without them. Sin…. To be improved
I thought better, on the way out the seats I had on the ticket were changed and no one notified the travel agency or myself

comfortable and all, but there is the speaking voice that speaks every 2 minutes and I'm not joking, I got on twenty minutes before departure and was told to wear the masks I don't know how many times, I couldn't take it anymore.

Train is heavily delayed, no furter info on delay. No acces to almost empty lounge, as „on this ticket you can”t even buy access”. So we need to wait for their train more than an hour. Of course no chance for return or change. Just a voucher. Who needs one on a short vacation? Highly disapointted.

Italo the worst! train canceled at 10.28. the train was supposed to leave at 10.35. I called the next day for the refund since the day before the switchboard was always busy and immediately afterwards I had to work and the next day they told me that it was no longer possible to receive the refund since I had to call the same day and this information was not written either by text message or by email. the worst train company! highly inadvisable.

Forced to take a ticket from Naples to Milan after the cancellation of the flight. Train delayed departure 1135 actual departure around 1300 hours. A girl made us leave the lounge area in an unpolite manner because we had to pay....if there was a sign warning....we didn't know.Carriage booked, 11 actual carriages 7!!! None of the staff came to warn us that we could go up anyway. In short, in addition to the inconvenience of the delay, we found rude staff with zero respect for older people... Let's review the approach with the customer who pays and wants to be treated politely.

Apparently the offers are amazing if you buy in advance, it's a shame that if you have to change a train or if you have to ask for a refund in the end you spend a lot more than if you bought the ticket on the same day, in fact, between penalties and restrictions you can't get out of it anymore.... Certainly the trains are beautiful and comfortable (even make them ugly and uncomfortable!!!) Anyway, I don't think I'll use them again.
Horrible experience, dirty, rickety and uncomfortable trains. Delay of more than half an hour which made me miss my connection.
I wonder if people think they are on public transport or on the beach. I understand the heat, I understand everything but if we all went barefoot......

The Brescia-Milan route is constantly delayed. But to add to the joy of the journey which is longer than it should be, there are: dirty bathrooms, air conditioning kept at the minimum level of legality (but do you understand that you are dying from the heat?) and rude staff (they respond with condescension and arrogance). I STRONGLY DO NOT RECOMMEND

I traveled on Italo train on July 22 from Bologna to Padua. A nightmare! Sitting in my assigned seat, I noticed that both the three girls next to me and the quartet next to me were all without masks. At this point, in order to avoid useless discussions with similar people, I preferred to raise my heels and make the journey standing near the door.  During the journey I noticed that there were a lot of people without masks or with masks not worn correctly. With the current times and with covid cases skyrocketing, it is shameful that there is no effective control. Terrible!

Milan-Rome route in first class. Perfect trip. Punctual train both outward and return, very spacious seats, Wi-Fi with entertainment, snacks and hot and cold drinks. Staff on board very attentive to masks. Found a very convenient offer, it couldn't have gone better!
I may have been lucky but the train was punctual, clean, breakfast and kindness. All with an offer of 36 euros Milan-Rome. I can't ask for better than this!

return to Rome from Milan in the same day cost 250 euros, CLUB class with lounge - too bad there is no lounge in Rome! train delayed both on the outward and return journeys terrible wifi, impossible to work, carriage n.1 hot with very little air conditioning experience not to be repeated
Price and punctuality are impeccable. The only concern is that people authorized to go up wake you up to promote associations, albeit beneficial, without giving you any respite.

Very few controls for the use of the mask, furthermore, having arrived in Milan in the evening, several non-EU citizens get on without paying, to reach Turin, they know that there will be no controls and they travel blissfully for free, since there are those who pay.
There has never been a time when the train wasn't late!!!! They are disorganized!! Because of them I missed my flight! Never again Italo!!! Not recommended
Toilet very dirty up to the entire route without cleanliness and hygiene! Terrible service. I expected more cleanliness from a company as important as Italo. Disappointed

Train 9924 of 06/07/22 Florence Milan, 12.25pm I sent a registered letter on 8/06 RW200474033553 (to which I have received no response to date) I also made the complaint online to Italo with my customer code 1223543 (I have been a customer for several years) they gave me a protocol code: 2-28366911345 (which now according to the operators on the phone does not exist as a practice...????) The most serious thing about this is that when I called to to make a refund claim they told me that: THE TRAIN CONTROLLER STAMPED MY EMBARCOATION FROM FLORENCE TO MILAN WHAT???? How is it possible that a ticket inspector only checks if the seat was occupied and assumes that I am the one sitting? how do you not check the ticket code and traveler name?? VERY SERIOUS...this service is a disaster and completely inadvisable...cheap ok...let's say because I spent €40 which I don't think I'll see again...but the customer service is disastrous and they HAVE NO RESPECT FOR THE CUSTOMER

purchased club level family of 4 car to travel.  Train mechanical caused to change train.  The new train seats were open.  A party of 2 took both club level box of 4 seats separating our family.  The guests were rude, but Italo should never allow breaking up a family, when origianl tickets purchased together, especially when paying extra for the highest level.  A man saving seats for his friends gave us our club car back, but this should NEVER happen.  My child would have been sitting almost 2 hours with a stranger. So, if you have a mechanical and want to stay with your family.  Get first in line to enter your car on the new train.  (You might have to turn into the rude traveler and push your way up to the front!)
4 trips out of 4 made with italo. Always late for the most disparate cases and never once does the train arrive on time. Really great service for the money. Shame!

We have the return ticket from Rome (Claudio Baglioni concert) for 5.40pm on 06/14/22, carriage 7, in the lead. Being early, we asked if we could change the ticket for a ride a few hours earlier: we can't because ours is a promotional ticket. It fits. A few hours before departure we check: the train is 70 minutes late. The very kind hostess tells us that it is Trenitalia's fault (the station loudspeaker says that it is due to a delay in preparing the train). After spending about an hour in the heat, studying the shop windows of Termini, the train arrives. Everyone rushes up. Everyone except us. The controller asks us to wait for the train conductor: he also gets on from the same entrance and, if he found it cluttered with passengers, it would take him longer to reach the driver's seat. After a few minutes he also arrives (evidently someone took the time to inform him that he had to drive that train), signaled by the conductor "See? It's that boy in the orange shirt: he's coming!". On carriage 7, however, the services do not work: you have to go to carriage 6 by going all the way backwards. The air conditioning doesn't work. The waste bin, normally placed between the two front seats... is missing. The passenger next to us points out to the conductor that the power socket isn't working: no problem, just move to one of the free seats in the other carriages. Italo reiterates several times that the ticket will be partially refunded. Not ours, which was on sale: it fits. Ah! Claudio Baglioni's concert was fantastic: professionalism is not water!!
Why has it been months since you have had a punctual train after 2pm? High prices for a total disservice. What a shame! In the last 2 weeks alone I have taken 7 late trains...painful!!!

traveled in train in the private room. Was in a group with only one name on the private room. Left my bag in the room under the seat, company could care less. Stay very much away from this train line. I had someone from italo at the station call as the train was leaving and they actually suggested me meet the train at the next stop. I said how in the world would I do that, I just took the train. I have researched and other train lines have processes to get your lost items back...This one does not.  Only a form and that's it. I see why this company gets such low reviews.

In September, loaded like a mule, I was preparing to return to Milan from Caserta. The train was two hours late. Yes two. And once we arrived at our destination the doors to my compartment didn't open. It was now one in the morning and the train, which had been stopped at the station I think for less than a minute, left for Turin with me inside in a fit of rage. Controllers? No! They were sitting comfortably in their cabin without worrying about monitoring and/or intervening for any problems. Like the one who then actually showed up with me. Despite the enormous inconvenience that had been caused to me, I decide not to argue about what happened. After all, these are things that can happen. Oh no, today I say no! We cannot remain silent in the face of ineffectiveness that creates problems. Over the months I have heard other stories similar to mine, if not worse, and all with Italo. Four days, four days I've been trying to get a ticket to return to Caserta, without success. Apparently a problem with the site was preventing the transaction from progressing. Today was yet another and certainly last attempt. I had almost managed to book what, according to the wording, was the last place available. But once the transaction was made, a message informed me of the lack of available places, inviting me to change my departure time in the certainty that I would find more availability. Now, not only does it not let me make the time change but they don't even respond to the help center. Which among other things has a shocking cost. VERY BAD EXPERIENCE!

Nothing to say about timetables. It's a shame that lately 4 out of 4 times they change seats and carriages on a Smart trip at the last moment, 1 time with notice and three times not. Followed by: nice races with luggage flying for the space of 6 carriages in 6 seconds; nice discussions with other passengers, especially when the 4 Smart carriage becomes 4 first class and it seems like they stole your seat but instead it's just someone richer than you; nice considerations when you finally put your hindquarters on the new and unexpected place: "but how much fun is Italo having with this perennial bingo?"...how nice of you!

Route Milan Naples. Finished water from the vending machine. Coffee cost promptly adjusted to the price increase (€1.20 from the distributor). The conductor does not look at the tickets but only if you have a mask. Wi-fi with speeds that make you lose your patience and that always manages to lose the signal between tunnels and stops in the station. Economy imitation leather seats that allow you to slide under the table: extremely uncomfortable.  But have Italo managers ever spent a couple of hours sitting on it? It's difficult to go back to trains like this. Terrible service.

Total absence of information. Padua-Milan train delayed by more than two hours due to investment on the route (and this is not Italo's fault), but...the controllers disappeared and the total absence of information (the train was diverted, it missed a station), travel in an ice-cold carriage and the only comfort items that can be purchased at the vending machine (which only accepts cash). This is not the case

I am traveling in the club car for the third time this week. The train is fast and clean. Unfortunately the air system is not working properly so there is very little airflow.  I, like I saw two other customers do, will be moving to a lower car to get fresh air.

The Club and Prima level service of Italo boarding is very problematic. Only one entry door. And people with much luggage. In Venezia we were pickpocketed in this queue whilst actually on the train. The queue to board was stalled. It turns out by a group of gypsy. They took much money. Italo staff didn't care. And they did not watch to see who boarded Club car. Many peoples were stolen from including us. Again. This happened on the carriage car. Not on the platform. Italo service was very bad to let this happen. Empty wallets found all over Club and Prima carriage one. No one cares to check. Never use Italo Prima Or Club. The boarding is terrible. Pickpocketed. And no room for luggage. For premium price the servizio was very bad.
Terrible service. They did not communicate that the train would not pass through the planned station. Terrible assistance at the station, and even worse in the call center.

I hadn't traveled on an NTV train for a long time, and I did well! Nobody informed me that my train would not leave from the scheduled station, but from another... and this could be enough if it were not for the absence of the possibility on the train to buy water or anything other than with cash... in 2022!!!! Never again!

After many decent, or rather good, journeys today, a terrible journey and unfortunately arrogant and, to say the least, shameful staff: Italo 4.09pm from Venice Mestre with arrival in Milan Centrale at 6.25pm, carriage 3 seat 3: welcome drink arrived from Mestre only in Desenzano, the ticket was not listed by the train conductor and instead as soon as he showed the pdf he changed his mind and it was valid. The boy with the ticket, who also checks tickets, to check for a malfunction at the door of the bathroom reported by me and another traveler: he raises his voice and shouts like a desperate person. Shame on you, I was your customer but I would rather spend 20 euros more on an arrow than have to deal with the arrogance of your employees. How disgusting!!
Italo train's always delayed. My 3rd time and ALL of them 60+ minutes delayed.  They give all kind of excuses.  Maybe train system in italy is obsolete or lack with time commitment.   Be prepared!

Leaving aside the delays due to the accident which cannot be blamed on Italo, the rest is a disgrace. Terrible internet connection, and okay, I can ignore it Seats that don't even fit the Ryan Air Air conditioning in fits and starts. Empty water dispensers with a full train and with delays that now exceed two hours. A shred of conductor to tell you something, no eh... It seems bad. You are scandalous. Scandalous. All for the modest sum of €106 per skull. Never again in my Italian life. I gave one star because you can't give less than 25. You suck.
Shameful, 60 minute wait, trains without a snack bar. After 5 hours they announce a material control check. Never again with italo

I understand that there is no fault for the 90 minute delay (due to the train derailment of recent days) but that the snack service scheduled for the BEFORE has been suspended... well I really don't understand that. ABSURD
Clean train, comfortable seats, even in economy class (smart). Train left on time, Classe Prima serves drinks and biscuits. The service at the station counters just needs to be improved.

We bought the express train tickets from Naples to Roma termini. Suppose to have reached in an hour and tickets were 3 times the price!!!. After we boarded and the train was moving they announced that there was trouble with lines and we will be delayed by an hour. But we reached almost 2 hours later than we were supposed to!

Extremely disappointed. I had chosen this carrier hoping for a better service than the red arrow since it also costs more but today on the Rome-Venice train there was absolute chaos. Ten minutes before boarding we were warned that the assigned seat no longer existed but rather that it was free to choose, that is, wherever you are you sit! Of course you had to respect the environment! Imagine the absolute delirium given that the train came from Naples and was already full. Moral of the story, there were 4 of us, with two minors, we traveled in two different carriages and places far from each other!! I find it really scandalous.
The only way to travel safely with all the comforts. the train bathroom super super clean. a very pleasant trip

Deeply disappointed by this operator which presents itself as an alternative to the Trenitalia Frecce service. Wi-Fi service totally absent without informing customers. Choice of food limited to a simple machine that doesn't take credit card. I don't recommend it.

I have read negative reviews, absurd complaints. My trip: Vicenza-Padua-Rome and return went very well! Traveled in a smart car with the family, comfortable seats, very friendly staff, trains on time and perfect air conditioning.

I took a trip from Verona to Naples and back. When booking online, I read that there were piadinas, sandwiches or focaccias fresh daily. It's a shame that I only later discovered that not all Italo trains have this service. So 5 hours of travel from around 6.30pm to around 11.30pm - so it covered dinner time - without being able to eat anything, other than two pretzels bought from an automatic machine, which also doesn't accept credit cards or banknotes over €20. I don't want to complain for the sake of it, but how do you arrange a train that covers long distances during meal times, without providing (or clearly indicating that there is no possibility of eating on the train) a comfortable and minimal possibility of buying something to eat other than a snack or an energy bar? I believe that certain information should be clearly visible and highlighted, as you do with the photos of the sandwiches that you put on the site when booking seats, which however you only give on certain trains. I hope you make changes in this regard. Thanks. Pietro.

We took Italo twice.  First experience was from Bologna to Florence.  We did not pre-purchase a ticket since we were unsure about our flight arrival and time to clear immigration at Bologna airport.  Tried several kiosks to buy tickets but kept getting “system error” message so had to find ticket office.  We were in coach which was bursting at the seams with people and no room left for our large suitcases (we were on a two week trip).  50 lb bags had to be stored overhead.  This trip rated one star.Second trip was from Florence to Venice and was great.  We had pre-purchased Club tickets.  They have a nice, private waiting room for Club travelers with free snacks and drinks and clean bathrooms.  Club car was very nice with free sandwiches and drinks.  The higher price was definitely worth it if you are a weary traveller.  This was a five star trip.

It may have been a coincidence or pure luck, the fact is that I had a really good time. Prices are now far cheaper than Trenitalia. The smart class is more crowded but still comfortable, while the first class is truly a "luxury": they also bring you drinks, food and hand wipes. the train was very punctual both on the outward and return journey and there were no problems. Among other things, thanks to the numerous discounts and/or preferential rates, you can also avoid spending a fortune. I will definitely use the service again!

In May the air conditioning was freezing, it was unliveable to be on that train, an icebox! Then I didn't understand why the train didn't stop but stopped in Bologna... Paying to select seats seems absurd to me given the price of the ticket...

Too bad I can't give zero....892020 just a number to steal money since it's payment after more than 20 minutes and about 30 euros of credit and several times waiting, the answer: I'm sorry, I can't help you, after half a day spent at the IEO I found myself with my wife in the emergency room of the hospital, my request was simply how to postpone the train time to the next one (I'll start by saying that I'm from Caserta and I was in Milan).., in the end?? Tickets not refunded and cost to return 240 euros.. incompetent assistance

Service Or terrible tickets with disproportionate cost Delays that don't allow you to make connections Stop for minutes and minutes in stations that aren't stopping A train can't have delays Maybe rail traffic needs to be organized better
Train 9948 Naples-Centrale, 100 min delay, assigned seats don't match, bathrooms out of order (near my carriage) and even the machines are jammed. From now on I will opt for arrow without any doubt.

Apart from the delay of our train 9935 coming from Turin, but paying for first class and not even receiving the snacks due, is the sole responsibility of Italo which has recently cut back on the service offered... is this normal?

I took a trip with friends from Padua to Naples and back... My trip went well, I would like to write something about the carriages, the passage is very narrow, if you load a suitcase you stop everyone... and they are too long and poorly soundproofed. This is why voices can be heard too much, we were called back but I swear we didn't raise our voices, we just spoke normally... I miss trains with compartments☺️ Unfortunately you can't expect people to keep quiet for five hours of row….I recommend bringing earplugs when travelling.

If I could give less I would give it. Italo is a private company which unfortunately does not guarantee that a passenger will arrive at their destination if they have to make connections. With this phrase "we don't care what you do after taking the Italo train", the controllers dismiss a 55 minute delay, saying that not only will they not compensate anything, but that it is the passenger's problem if he fails to arrive at his final destination. The truth is that if you take Trenitalia you have a minimum of guarantee and care from the company and the staff, who will try to help you already inside the train. The last controller told me it's a European law. In Austria and Germany, if you don't arrive at your destination, they pay for your taxi, when possible, or otherwise they pay for a hotel. Without excuses, and without having to complain. But here we are in Italy.

Instead of continuing to underline the use of the mask upon threat of getting off the train.... It would be appropriate to remind passengers to lower their voices and put the phone in silence! 🙄I also don't understand why stop in Florence when there isn't the scheduled stop... absurd
Very quiet train, friendly and polite staff. Excellent drink and snack service, but above all I travel without a mask 💪🏻💪🏻💪🏻

Florence-Milan train delayed because in Naples the train was prepared 50 minutes late, then 55, then 45, then 50 again, anything less than 60 to avoid triggering a refund which in any case cannot be easily obtained through decent customer service. Ah, and this was after taking a 30 euro advance on the train which ultimately left at the same time as the one originally booked. Zero assistance, zero sense of management and customer care. I will definitely never make the train early again since the trains are prepared a little whenever you want, you move forward two hours and end up leaving after three...

the worst customer service everthe train left without being noticed the number of the platform they refused to give me another ticket, i paid 34€ extra as the supervisor said it’s not their fault !!worst experience with unprofessional stuff ever

My parents and grandparents were all railway workers of another generation and they would be turning in their graves with shame. If I could I would put a zero. Having climbed up with difficulty, sweating, with a 3 month old baby in a pram, I was told that "I can't go back and forth with the stroller because it's cumbersome" and that "I had to get in in my seat because they (Italo's staff) have to be able to pass" (and not me?). Meanwhile, suitcases... backpacks... everything along the aisles and they don't help me... they didn't say anything... in fact they scold me... I'm trying to say hello to my partner from the window with this girl who stands in front of me without helping me and tells me I have to see the ticket first... but are you outside?!??More importantly: Getting in and out with a wheelchair independently is impossible. If you are: A SINGLE MUM/DAD with a STROLLER, an athletic handicapped person who does not need special assistance or if you have broken your leg and have to take the train with your wheelchair, forget your freedom. THERE IS NO lowered PLATFORM (as in towns and on civil trains)... you have to call the service that "takes you by hand, on the shoulder"... what a humiliating thing! Regress! But a little information, passion, foresight, right? You have to be humiliated if you're in a chair and please friends in wheelchairs don't walk along the cluttered corridors and I've said it all! But it goes… but it goes….

Customer service bordering on embarrassing. I called 4 times today alone (topping up with €15 since their rate is around €1.2 per minute) without getting anything done. Every time we got to the point the line went dead. But this is nothing. After several attempts I decide to go to the physical office, and if the only certainty was that of being able to change a section of the ticket (which was confirmed by 3 operators on the phone), the lady at the office told me that it was not possible and therefore wasted money (and TIME) for nothing. Embarrassing

Train late??? Don't worry, ITALO customer service and assistance will take care of it. BELIEVE IT!!!! Paid number, they answer and remain silent and then prevaricate with useless questions to make you spend more without solving the problem.

I have always traveled with Italo, I considered it a good service in the pre-Covid era. Now it sucks.... It's Reggio Emilia-Naples, NEVER ANYONE who came to check the green pass or the ticket!!!!!! I, in carriage 11, had to go to carriage 7 to get some water (€1.50), people without masks, people with surgical masks, people who spoke continuously on the phone from Florence to Naples, never a controller to check on the passengers' possible needs. The price of the tickets is not worth the price of the services!!!!!Return journey made with Trenitalia, as soon as you got on the GP and the ticket were checked, an inspector passed every few hours, bathrooms were sanitized every hour. Now that's a service!!!!!!!!!!!

Rome Termini-Bergamo route, we leave 15 minutes late and up to this point it's the long weekend of April 25th, there's a way around!!!! I booked a seat in first class for the modest cost of 94.90 euros and I found myself sitting in seat No. 57, without even the window and partly in the food closet, for the entire journey the boy was constantly removing and putting the trolley back in and slamming the doors without any hesitation, so much for first class!!! The train for this route is comfortable but Italo should review the services and check that the on-board staff carry out their work adequately.

April 25, 2022 I take the Italo train from Venice at 5.05pm. Carriage 5 warns you every 10 minutes to put on your mask and that the conductor will come by for the green pass. Do you know when it passed? At 10pm!!!!! Just before arriving in Naples. Shame!!!!!!!

Inadequate and poorly governed infrastructure, dirty trains, frustrated and rude staff, passengers without masks or with cell phones or tablets at full volume without any intervention... the "train manager" who doesn't care.... 😂😂😂Great experience!

Train delayed by 45 minutes causes a breakdown along the route, which obviously does not depend on the employees. However, we had a connection that we would have missed due to the delay, and I must say that the customer service girl was really kind and helpful... or maybe not. He replied in an annoyed manner that the seats on the next train were sold out… well… I checked from the app and the moral of the story was: the seats were available! An additional €60 for a ticket to be able to make a connection that we would otherwise have missed. Nice service, congratulations! You are not even able to explain what is happening and follow up with the customer, helping him. Congratulations, you will go far

The assistance is terrible, if you need to change tickets or for any problem you have to contact the telephone support, there is a fee. Furthermore, even via certified e-mail you will not be calculated, only through legal channels will you have an outcome... Shame.

Uncomfortable seats. Internal temperature... freezing in April, inside the carriages the air conditioning is non-existent, too cold! You can't travel 6 hours with your coat used as a blanket. The ticket price is exaggerated for the services offered.

We took Italo's high-speed train from Rome to Venice. We used their top-of-the-line service, which is their Club Level with their Salotto compartment. This gives you the most private experience where you get to sit in a four-seat compartment. The Club Level also allows you a sandwich, plus drinks and snacks throughout the four-hour trip. The car attendants were good, the rails were smooth and the ride quiet. The compartment is open on the top for air flow, so you can hear conference calls without headphones in other parts of the car. But otherwise good. There are vending machines for all passengers a few cars down. But with the included services that was unnecessary. The windows were kind of dirty, which was disappointing for someone like me who wants to take photos on the trip. Fare was 115 Euros per passenger, which we found good. Italo is recommended as a good way to get from Point A to Point B in Italy.

Used in SMART on the Reggio Emilia/Rome return route: both trains perfectly on time, with a good level of cleanliness. Punctual ticket + green pass control on the outward journey, but totally non-existent on the return journey, despite a journey of almost three hours!!!

Paid customer service 892020, I'm calling to change the names following unavailability for health reasons. No one answers, on the other hand I was charged €8.40 for the calls (!!!). Given the situation, I called 060708 Bigglietteria Italo, also having to add a ticket for a child. After explaining the previous problem, the operator, annoyed, ended the call without providing a solution. Shameful service

purchased first class ticket with the possibility of free change. the site is blocked at 10.36am on Sunday 3 April and says to contact a telephone number for the ticket office. I call and they tell me that to change a ticket I have to contact another paid number (also very expensive). embarrassing.1. it should be noted that the change is free only if italotreno.it is online, otherwise the number you call has a very high cost2. the case is a disservice by italo which is passed on as a cost to the customer, which is not correct.

Whatever destination you say you are going to, if possible take the car or the plane! I am writing this review directly from the train, after almost 100 minutes of delay the train is still in the station. Unthinkable I could plan a day if you rely on Italo or Ferroviedellostato, for what you pay then.

We drove from Bologna to Florence in the PRIMA class. The journey only takes about 40 minutes, but when booking it was stated that snacks would be provided. But this was just a wish - because the employee ran through the train with the tray as if he had to be faster than the train - no snacks were given. Car material and comfort were top - service FLOP!
Rome Milan trip. Excellent. Punctuality of the train, extreme kindness of the staff and finally gluten free snacks. Thank you
This is Italian mafia.  Be careful stay away. Uneducated and rude staff. Expensive tickets. You can find much cheaper.
Why don't they check the green passes BEFORE getting into the carriage. Result: an hour of waiting in Bologna waiting for the railway police for two passengers without green passes

It's a continuation of repetitive and unbearable ads. Almost worse than on a plane, since they are repeated at every stop. The English translation is unnerving. At least trenitalia puts a recording in the native language.

Central Bologna, I was served by a woman with short blonde hair, a very rude woman, I needed information, she treated me very badly. The train number didn't appear on the board, I entered the Italo box office, she addressed me very badly, doing nothing other than reiterating that the train number must already be there - since it would leave an hour later - and that according to her it was me who couldn't see it (impossible since I had taken photos of all the boards to look even better). Furthermore, he didn't look me in the face but was messing around with who knows what on the computer. I left the box office to go and check again, she magically appeared, she was angry, even though it was her job, she got up and left the box office and came near me. Saying that I was the one who didn't understand why my train left at 11:57, not 10:57 so I should have waited for it to appear since it was early and an hour away, contradicting what she said previously.

On Italo, an Fp2 mask is mandatory, but the bathroom in my carriage has no water, an employee tells me for two days already. Indeed, hand hygiene is negligible for them. Another note, they run around in the rather annoying Telethon volunteer carriages that occupy the corridor and obstruct the passage by putting their butt in the face of the passenger on the other side of the corridor. It doesn't seem right to me to allow this, thus disturbing travelers who have paid for a regular ticket.

The normal carriages (so no first class) are dirty and smell musty, I don't think the ventilation so emphasized in the sound announcements is there, you can't breathe. The seats are dirty and narrow if you are in two seats. Cleaning should be there even if you are not traveling in first class!!!

Frankly, I found the service to be good. The train was clean and the staff were courteous. I knew I had to wear the FFP2 mask and therefore I made sure to have it with me. Punctuality for both the outward and return journeys.
It is not possible that every Italian train has no internet connection and does nothing to solve fake line problems

Dear all, I am traveling on your train to Rome. First class. The conductor orders me to wear an ffp2 mask. The mask broke before I got on the train. So I decide to wear 2 health masks. I also want to say that I am a healthcare worker and that today we no longer have the obligation to wear an ffp2 mask... but let's leave it at that. What leaves me stunned is that upon my request for Italo Train to provide me with the requested mask, I am told that no, he doesn't have one available and if another passenger doesn't provide me with one I will have to get off at the first possible station. It is only thanks to my neighbor who provides me with one of his that I can still travel to the capital. I find your failure in this regard embarrassing if not shameful. I expect a kind response on this matter. Giada Mariani

I have been using Italo for a few years to go on holiday to the South and I must say that the holiday already started with a smile as soon as we got on board. Now.... I understand the two years of pandemic, the restrictions and limitations.... but I found the service poor and the staff no longer as kind as they once were. I booked the first class lounge for two people. Our carriage was empty but for most of the journey the ticket inspector sat in the lounge next to us chatting loudly with a colleague about his own business.... and this is a carriage where silence is required.
