Furthermore, the toilet was out of order in the first class carriages. The first available in carriage 4, very crowded and therefore.... very popular. Long wait and little cleanliness. What can I say... you can feel the discontent of the staff who reach us passengers. And I'm sorry because on Italo I have always felt "welcomed and welcome". I really hope it's a moment and... "Italo stays as you were"

Paid 70 euros for a Rome-Milan ticket and no social distancing required, sitting next to a stranger, a train full of people with 100% capacity. We are still in a pandemic but evidently the distancing rules do not apply for Italo. Never again.

Being a graphic designer I need to use connections to servers like Dropbox or Google drive to be able to upload fairly light files, but this is not possible on ITALO trains, as the connection does not allow it. I advise all professionals in Smart working to choose an alternative because ITALO does not meet the required bandwidth expectations in the slightest. The staff however remains kind and professional.

Our train was delayed by ONE HOUR (at first they said 25 minutes, then 35, then 45, then 50, then 55 and finally 60 which made it impossible for us to actually know when it was coming and reorganize ourselves in order to catch our plane in Bologna. The staff told us at first it would in no way be later than 45 minutes which turned into one hour in the end. Absolutely unbelievable. We then asked if it was possible to wait in the lounge since the station was full and it was cold to which they said no because of COVID (even though there was only one couple in the lounge). We asked it it was possible to charge the phone and they pointed to a corner where we ended up sitting on the floor to charge it. After asking to connect to the WiFi in order to check our flight status they finally said “No, it’s not possible since we do not have free WiFi.” The WiFi they had was only for the lounge and you needed and access code to use it which they couldn’t give us even though we needed to catch a plane, booked an early train and they delayed by ONE HOUR. In no Moment was there any apology or a “we’re sorry for this”. Absolutely horrible. Still the worst was that instead of saying right at the beginning it was gonna take one hour they simply added 5 minutes to the delay every 10 minutes so we couldn’t do anything about it. Terrible service, honestly.
Padua Rome. Like being in a bus. 60 euros ticket each. Never seen distances for Covid. The image of an old and affluent Italy. Never again

Pessina experience is a compliment.  I book the lounge in the executive club. None of the screens worked. I mentioned it and after 2 hours of travel the train conductor came telling me that there was a network problem. We ask for food since it is included in the price but I am told that due to Covid there is no catering service. I show the menu I downloaded from the Italo website and I am told that it is an old menu. That is, it's all nonsense. Paid 400 euros for a pitiful trip.  Without services that I paid for, and 5 hours and 30 minutes of travel without being able to eat!!!!! Never again Italian!!! Never again. Worst trip ever!!!!!  Paying 400 euros for not having wi fi, not being able to have breakfast or lunch, that is absurd... failed on all fronts... we are a daughter who travels often but this was the last experience with Italo. Never again. Nor will I ever recommend it to anyone. The other competing company is clearly superior on all fronts.

I have always booked the Club carriage. I made two return trips, Milan Naples and Milan Venice.  Returning from Naples to Bologna, a person wearing a surgical mask gets on board and benefits from the drink and food service. No checks and only after pointing this out to the staff (more than an hour passes) is she checked...without a ticket or green pass and is sent away.  Another trip back from Venice, the Club should be a quiet area... Phone calls from the fish market and children screaming/crying. Italian staff non-existent. Never again

After having paid €90 for a ticket, with the belief that there was distancing and all the rules, I found myself sitting in a carriage, which for goodness sake was economy, but this was truly disgusting. The seats were all occupied and not, as a precaution, one yes and the other no... I ended up near a stranger, I didn't know who he was, or if he had Covid... nothing! This makes me smile because at the station and on the platforms, so they spaced us out in the open, which was useless given that we were crowded together on the train. A mess because of the passengers, screaming children, people chatting loudly and no one who stopped by to scold them, besides the parents who seemed accustomed to all this shouting. Now, as long as a trip like this lasts an hour it can last, but 7 hours... Don't expect it! For goodness sake don't book.

Italo Treno is certainly the worst transport company in Europe; I was lucky enough to travel a lot, especially by train and unfortunately the worst of the worst is always in Italy. They are the worst because they have exaggerated prices compared to the type of service offered, they have incompetent staff and they are scammers on refunds. For the prices: if you think you can save money with Italo compared to the arrows you are totally deceived, the trains cost a little less but they are always and I repeat always late, if you want to save money it is better to buy intercity trains which cost much less and are equivalent in duration. The staff perhaps now accustomed to offering terrible service is always rude and often aggressive, plus they don't enforce the rules of fpp2 masks. They are scammers (not to mention thieves) regarding the refund policy, in fact every time the timing of the delays does not reflect reality, for example you travel 2 hours late (maybe) but when you arrive at the station you either go immediately to ask for a refund or the notification via email automatically deducts 45 minutes from the delay so as not to issue the right compensation. Management incompetence, prices too high for the service offered, rude and incompetent staff, refund scammers. I don't think anything else is needed to describe this useless and pathetic Italian transport company.

There is no control over people who, even after two years of pandemic, still take off and lower their masks on trains. However, a stewardess passed before my eyes and saw the gentleman who had his mask lowered and said absolutely nothing to him. Furthermore, he continued to cough. Congratulations to the on-board staff for their work...., obviously I'm being ironic...............,
Well done Italo...punctual time...exceptional service...then the ticket costs the right price...from Florence SMN to Rome Termini €22.90...thank you Italo

I found Italo's customer service to be discreet. My father and mother, over eighty, had to, after a cardiological examination at the San Donato Polyclinic, take the train back to Rome from the Milan Rogoredo station. They lost it twice because the information provided regarding the arrival/departure platform was inadequate and there was no one to provide assistance in getting on the train. In the end, to avoid losing him for the third time, they got into a taxi and headed to Milan Centrale. Italo helped me change the departure time and place twice (even though telephone Customer Service is expensive). There are 2 changes that should be made. On the part of the Milan Rogoredo station (and perhaps here Italo could intervene), they should communicate on the various boards well in advance the precise platform (avoiding last minute changes) of arrival and departure of the trains (so as to guarantee sufficient time for disabled and elderly people to get to the platform - distances and stairs must be considered). As far as Italo is concerned, it would be appropriate for an operator to temporarily get off the train (or at least check) to assist its Customers, especially the most fragile ones (they missed the first train because they couldn't open the carriage door and no one helped them; problem not understood - the train didn't even stay in the station for a minute). It would be a better service.

Traveled several times on Italo for work reasons, always in executive, on all trips the entertainment system worked only once (the first many years ago) then it was always impossible to watch a film or use the Wi-Fi constantly. As they age, the carriages now have vibrations and squeaks worthy of Trenitalia regional trains, the only positive note being the on-board hostesses who are always very courteous, a little!!!
The customer service is scandalous, firstly for not having a toll-free number, secondly I didn't get a refund for a ticket I didn't use due to testing positive for covid

It's been years since I took Italo, and it will serve as a lesson for me to never take it again. I made a mistake when I bought a ticket (Bologna Roma instead of Roma Bologna). My ticket is changeable, but I find that I can only change the day and time and not reverse the stations. Lastly, paid customer service with exorbitant costs, not even an email available. Services of this kind should not even exist in a civilized country.
Comfortable train, punctual, good service. A very negative note is that the Italian WiFi network is almost impossible to use. The connection always fails

Terrible and inconclusive call center service. I'm calling to find out the procedure for requesting a REFUND since I should have left today but due to my positive swab test, I can't anymore... I'm calling twice because on the first attempt, oops... the line goes dead... The second operator, rather hasty (whose phone call I record today 1.1.22 at 10.15am) tells me to send me an instant email, a form to fill in where I self-declarate of being positive for covid and not being able to carry out the planned trip. But do you think the email ever arrived? obviously not. He hung up on me and greeted me hastily without giving me a chance to reply. The email never arrived, not even in spam. I suggest he send me the form to another email in my possession and....coincidentally, the line goes dead again. This means that they didn't want to send the form....In short, the cost of a phone call for a few minutes is Euro 11.98. The conclusions are up to you....I will no longer travel with Italo. I prefer to take planes or Trenitalia, but Italian NO!

After many years I made the Turin-Rome return trip by train. I chose Italo because I already use it to go to Milan and, this time too, I was happy with it. As someone over 60 I almost always choose first class because the price difference is minimal, but the service is better. Slight delay on the return but basically everything OK.

This summer for the Villa San Giovanni route I took a Frecciarossa9658 due to a cause attributable to a fire of unknown nature, I was forced to arrive in Rome two hours late and also received the bonus due. This Christmas I decide to try Italo and contrary to my expectations I receive a nasty surprise, in addition to an accumulated delay of around 45 minutes the progress of the train was compromised by the lack of power for the entire duration of the journey. Next time I will think at least twice before choosing Italo.
2 year old children without a seat Dirty and noisy Late No services And many times also expensive

Everything is perfect, except that every time in the Club there is always someone who ruins the trip for the whole carriage by talking loudly on the phone. The staff should say something and make sure that silence is respected. Especially because you purchase the Club service to travel with peace of mind.

Worsened over time. This trip on 12/23 was devoid of any comfort for travelers. Staff you have hardly seen at all. Controller that we saw shortly before getting off at the final station of the route. Wi-Fi is really inefficient, to offer it like this is a joke. I'm sorry but he's losing points really fast!

Luggage forgotten on the train, an ordeal to contact someone and try to recover it. Unique n. PAYMENT telephone number 892020 to just tell you to go to a lost property site and maybe in time you will find it. But if there is a bomb on board, how are the staff notified?

I booked a train trip from Rome to Bari for 12/16. The train was canceled due to strike but I was denied a refund. The official reason is that more than three days had passed, but it's an excuse: in reality in the days before the toll-free number was always busy. They practically cheated me of 40 euros.

ATTENTION: I need to change the ticket reservation for another day and it seems to be a state affair. I manage to make the payment, but despite having collected the money it gives me an error and doesn't give me the new ticket. I call the only number available for these cases, at 30.5 cents per call plus 54.9 cents per minute: it leaves me 9 minutes and 45 seconds on hold and then magically free... for two seconds, then the line goes dead. The judgment is up to you!!!!

This company of incompetents who only waste people's time and money must be allowed to fail. Delayed trains (only theirs), initially they communicate a delay of 30 minutes which gradually becomes 40 then one hour and then two hours so you don't even have the chance to regroup. Total disappointment.
Simply on a horror trip....as always. There is never a time that there are delays. Then the strange thing is that the arrows pass there..... we stop. Absolutely not to be taken.

It's from ReggioEmilia AV to Benevento, never again.. one of the most degrading experiences I've ever had. Train changes, seats assigned to several people at the same time... people who have been left without a seat for more than 20 minutes. Checking tickets and green passes... 10 minutes before I had to get off at the scheduled stop. CONTINUOUSLY DELAYED!!  NEVER AGAIN ITALIAN!

I purchased a ticket for Reggio Emilia AV, as soon as I printed it I found that the time did not correspond to the one I had selected, I immediately called assistance to change it and they made me pay 16 euros for time change, (two hours before). ABSURD!!! 16 euros for a time change requested two minutes after purchase, truly ABSURD. TRENITALIA does not charge for this service as it should be, I'm only sorry that at the same time there was a red arrow train and I was undecided between the two. For future trips I will always choose FRECCIA at this point. NEVER AGAIN ITALO!

Naples-Rome route 9 Dec 2021 departure with 55 min delay. No one checked the green pass and ticket. Return as always happens, welcome service at the bare minimum (glass of water, if you don't ask for it they even forget to tell you about the snack, napkins: not received) without education and courtesy. As for the covid rules, only soaked wipes. It's true that the Naples-Rome route is short but we pay handsomely for the ticket and therefore the service must be the same as that offered for longer routes!

Zero checks and anti-covid regulations!!! It is unacceptable that, in the carriage I was in, there were people who continually lowered their masks and no one noticed! I turned to the conductor twice, who simply passed by and asked us to raise it, and as soon as he walked away, the uncivilized passengers lowered it again and none of the staff did anything or came to check again, unless at the invitation of those who, like me, demand (especially in a time of pandemic) respect for the rules! Not to mention the crowds. If I could, I would have written 0 as a score after today's trip!
Bologna Florence route very crowded, no greenpass control, people without masks. I advise against it.

Nice service and the ticket is very good.  I went from Milan to Turin in 58 minutes with a ticket cost of 29.90. The trains inside have wi-fi and are free and fast. Comfortable seats.  Online reservations.  On the way back I also changed the time of departure from Turin for free at the local office of the central station. 5 stars from me!

I travel with Italo train from Rome Termini to Venice S.Lucia, due to an error regarding the time of the ticket I was forced to do it again, with today's prices and not those previously paid (obviously with a surcharge), I am disgusted by the arrogance and aberrant inhumanity with which I was: threatened with a verbal warning and with paying the total amount within 5 minutes, otherwise kicked off the train at the first useful stop, when I asked for mercy at least for organize myself and make phone calls to find the huge sum that was requested of me in such a short period of time, to my humiliation. I would add that this train traveled 1h30 minutes late. For such a poor and unpleasant service it is not worth wasting so much money. If I had to give advice to the company, choose your staff more carefully, because they are arrogant to say the least and I dare say ridiculously disgusting.

I traveled on the Florence Naples train and vice versa. On the outward journey they came to check the green pass after Rome, on the return journey there was no check. I could have traveled without a ticket. The seats are very narrow. Not recommended, considering that the price is the same as the arrows.

I had to make an urgent ticket exchange which proved impossible using the website, I kept getting an error message. I then called customer service who sent me a paid customer service and the operator put me on hold during the call for several minutes and then disconnected the conversation when I asked him what his name was. I would like to underline that the operator quoted a ticket change price 50% higher than what turned out to be the right amount for the ticket change made at the station. This is truly terrible, unspeakable and fraudulent customer service. Never again. Call made to the call center on Sunday 28/11/21 at 10.10am for 7 minutes. Cheaters.

I traveled with Italo from Milan to Bologna, first time for me and I found myself very well, brand new train, clean, comfortable seats, Covid regulations respected, rightly asked for the Green pass, only 10 minutes late, otherwise comfortable journey.

BAD! I often travel for personal reasons from Milan to Rome. Italo is very convenient from a price point of view, but as soon as there is a problem (refund, ticket cancellations...) it is not able to provide you with assistance. I rather recommend paying €20 more but traveling with Trenitalia which is much safer!
We choose this transportation from Florence to Rome.The train was clear and the seats really comfortable!There wasn’t delay and we arrived at Roma termini in time!

I often travel with Italo route Venice Rome. When there are no problems, Italo can also be advisable. But at the slightest problem (delay, ticket change, refund) no one will find a solution. Customer service exists only to make you buy the ticket but not to solve problems. It is unthinkable that in 2021 they have a paid call center (made on purpose) and it costs you 1.30 euros per minute and you also pay when they put you on hold (for 4 minutes in my case). Unfortunately we are too small and they do what they want.

Beautiful travel experience. Reggio Emilia - Rome Termini route. No problems and a completely relaxing journey. On the way back, we found a first class promotion and it was truly the best. Wi-Fi to be reviewed. Green pass check carried out. Trains smelling fresh and clean.

Creating a user profile with Italo is much more difficult than it should be. Initially I bought a booklet of 10 tickets (pendulum), and then I tried to create a user profile via the same email address: impossible. Not even after the carnet expired, I was able to use my main email address, now linked to the carnet, to create a profile. The telephone support, which costs something like 1 euro per minute or so, also gave me wrong information, there is no email address for customer support, and if by chance I wanted to file a complaint, my type of problem doesn't exist on the appropriate form. Creating an Italo profile proved a lot more difficult than it should have been. I fist bought a 10 ticket carnet (I commute), then tried to create a profile using the same email: impossible. Not even after the carnet expired. No support, nowhere to send an email, nowhere to file a complaint (except for a multiple choice complaint form where my problem was not listed). I refused to call the paid support, which gave me incorrect information last time anyways ($5 for a 5 min call).
Departed from Rome on 28/10 at 2.57pm towards Naples. No one checked the ticket but above all the green pass!! The carriage was packed.

I was travelling from Rome trimini to Bologna Centrale. I booked club executive class for my parents and I. I went for the salleto and what an experience of travelling on a high speed train in Italy. We really enjoyed ourselves. Even though the train had to stop for a while on our way to bologna. It didn't bother us we had a pleasant time on the train and the staff on board were lovely and helpful. The food was good as well.

I signed up to Italo Più before booking a return trip for two people. On the site it was advertised that after registering with Italo Più I would receive a 10 Euro voucher, to be used to subsequently purchase tickets. After signing up I did not receive any voucher; when I booked tickets for two people (without using any discount code) I didn't have the 10 Euro voucher. At the end of the trip I was credited with the Italo Più points relating to the trip taken but to date (after 10 days) I still have not received the promised voucher. By asking with a private message on the Italo Treno Facebook page I am redirected to the paid assistance number. Honestly, it doesn't seem right to me to have to spend (and a lot) to speak to assistance to get a 10 Euro voucher, which should be sent automatically with registration or at least once the journey has been completed. I find it not serious that Italo Treno does not provide a chat or a toll-free number for customer assistance.
Good trip and train conditions are very acceptable nice staff and cleaning. FREE WI-FI is a very big PLUS

Train 9946 left Naples at 2.20pm on 15 October 2021. It still has to arrive in Bologna and is 100 minutes late!! Incapable, inconclusive, poor!!!! Instead of making promotions with stupid names, like October, Autumn, Pause, and other similar nonsense, make one calling it COMMITMENT!! SHAME ON YOU!!!!  SUCK!!

No quality control on the individual carriages, I found myself having to defend myself from 6 people who were chatting calmly and taking up the corridor and my standing room halfway through the journey

Let me start by saying that I deeply love animals and have always had them, but buying an early ticket, therefore paying more, hoping for a relaxing trip and instead finding myself the whole time with a poor dog that did nothing but whine, I guarantee you that it is embarrassing. Naturally none of the staff even bothered to come and check. I find this unacceptable, given a ticket that is more expensive than the standard price.
Terrible service. Salerno Milan train, no ticket and green pass checks for the entire journey. The hot drinks machine robbed us of 5 euros. No cleaning service between trips. Phantom staff.

I respected top health standards on the outward journey. Comfort and technological aspects were truly appreciated. On the return, despite repeated reminders to use masks for a long-distance train, no one let off a group who had taken them off as soon as they passed the control. Is it worth noting that you can't see or can't you let them off?.. Unfortunately, the financial penalty is better heard than the vocal announcement..

We traveled in the executive club and in the other compartment there was a family with a child. Not for the child but throughout the whole trip I heard the mother talking, singing and keeping the volume of the cartoons high. The child perhaps would have wanted to sleep but the mother didn't. In short, none of the staff was worried that our peace of mind was being disturbed on the Milan / Naples route. The service was good.

Trip from Treviso to Rome Terni in a lounge club environment. I was pleasantly surprised by the finely maintained and clean environments. The wide range of snacks on board including an excellent espresso coffee is excellent. Extremely kind and polite on-board staff, ready to pamper you and satisfy every need for a top journey.

Seats booked but seats change half an hour before departure, chaos among passengers. No green pass control, people without masks, company employee passing by in the carriage but not saying anything. Ball air conditioning felt like December. Seat buckets not emptied therefore train not sanitized, bathrooms not cleaned. Tickets paid handsomely. To forget

Terrible support service. I canceled a ticket, as I was late, therefore entitled to an 80% refund. I purchased the next train. I never received the money, and so I called PAYMENT customer service. PAYMENT customer service, in an annoyed tone, as if I was bothering them, told me that the cancellation was not in the system, and therefore I should dream of a refund. I told them I had the procedure done, but they basically called me a liar. Now I have opened the case but I have big doubts that it will be resolved. Terrible service, IT system not working with inefficiencies affecting the consumer. Very bad.

Train to Naples, left 40 minutes late.  In the meantime they tell you that you can sit at their Italo club lounge and, not only do they not compensate you for the inconvenience but, they ask you for an additional 10 euros per person. Pitiful veil!
Missed the train while waiting on the platform. They changed the platform a minute before with no evidence on screens. I had to pay extra To take the next train. Welcome to Italy.

The anti-Covid regulations are totally non-existent. People with masks under their noses and Italo staff pass through the corridors without saying absolutely anything. I spent it all traveling next to a gentleman I didn't know and who invaded part of my seat. There was a man in the carriage who was coughing. They didn't check my ticket or green pass. Shocked.
It's not possible that the first train is at 9.30 in the morning! They have to wake up and make other connections first!

Expensive ticket (but I think it's due to distancing and due to lower ticket sales), we get on the train and there isn't an empty seat to put our luggage. We complain to what they pompously call the train manager (???) who says he can't do anything about it. We are forced to keep them on us the whole trip. Hat racks that are not deep and can only fit a backpack (does it take much to make them 20 cm higher so that you can fit a trolley?). Tickets sold without the minimum distancing, 8-hour journey next to a stranger, who eats and often lowers his mask. Dirty bathroom (they came to clean it after 5 hours). No restaurant cars, only vending machines (for those who have money in coins because there is no currency exchange and prices are high). No green pass or temperature checks, with visibly ill people on board. Never again! Children and seniors pay the same cost as adults! I thought Trenitalia was terrible... but there is worse

I took Italo trains for about three years and, apart from some faults on the line not due to the company, I had always found myself quite well. In July 2021, an episode caused my satisfaction to drop drastically. The Bologna-Rome ticket had an incorrect code, so that the train I was looking for never appeared on the billboard and I lost it. I reported the fact to the ticket office. The employee acknowledged that there had been an error on their part but the most he could do was to issue another ticket at the same price. Addendum to the episode: I wrote a complaint on the portal and after a month I received an email saying that they could not take the complaint into consideration as it was written in incorrect format (thanks very much, there is no menu item that says "wrong ticket number"!). Further addendum: I asked for my Italopiù account to be cancelled. They haven't even responded to me and continue to send me commercial proposals.

Seats in FIRST CLASS Milan-Rome 359.80 for two people return. DIRTY SEATS AND DIRTY TABLE!!! At this price I expected at least HYGIENE AND CLEANLINESS! Very crowded train and no place for suitcases! NEVER AGAIN ITALO TRAIN

Experience is good but the staff was very rude and very impolite! She was mocking us just for having the scooter. Very un professional btw my train was from Verona to Firenze. My train number was 8959. I really hope the company will notice this. Because it's very dissappointing when the experience is good but the customer service is worst. Thanks

Very bad experience and very rude staff! Customers are not treated like this, I spent 325 to go to Reggio Calabria because a certain Andrea who works in Rome Termini doesn't know how to do his job and treats customers badly! I will never take Italo to travel again!!!

Italo disappointed me. In the carriage where I had a reserved seat, there wasn't even room for my luggage. The space above the seats was the size of a backpack. Considering that the route was long-distance, they could avoid hooking up a small carriage. The seats were equivalent to those of a bus. I was in a smart car, ok, but still I paid €116 for Turin-Salerno. It doesn't seem like much to me. Not to mention the corridor and the services. An overweight person would have some difficulty passing

Today 23 August I take the Pesaro-Rome train 8168 (but on the board it is indicated as 8169, so I have to ask for confirmation from the assistance service, in order to avoid probable errors... the train is the same, but the voice at the station did not communicate the number change). I get into the Smart carriage and to my great amazement I find myself next to another person... and the time difference???? Ok, Italo has invested 50 million in ventilation filters, like those installed in airplanes. But they could also warn! Ultimately, nothing has been officially said by the Government which has yet to pronounce on the possible new distancing on trains. To date nothing has been said! Meanwhile I wonder: the poor bars and restaurants forced to maintain the reduction in the number of tables to respect distancing EVEN OUTDOORS, and nothing on Italo!!! Everything as before!!! I am very pleased with the innovation of the ventilation system introduced (very welcome as a precaution for covid), but THEY DECIDED THEMSELVES THAT WITH THIS THEY COULD BRING THE % OF PRESENCE ON THE TRAIN BACK TO THE PRE-COVID PERIOD!!! NO, IT'S NOT CORRECT. And in any case, write it on the site!!! Finally, I find it aberrant that in the Smart carriages the diatancy is no longer there while in the previous carriages this is still there. But what kind of discrimination do they do?? There would be no need to even ask Italo what he means: in smart customers can be less protected because they spend less???? Obvious joke.....

We missed the 11/40 train × Naples not × our fault delay of 1 hour and 15 minutes the train from Domodossola made us repay the ticket in full however dirty bathroom seat without charger and basket never again

Pesaro - Naples Centrale train of 22 August 2021: carriages almost 100% full and people without masks, the on-board staff stopped by to check only once at the beginning of the journey and then disappeared. I made a report to the telephone assistance number but it was of no use since the report was immediately closed and no action was taken. Much better is Trenitalia, where at least the seats are still spaced apart and there is less chance of traveling with functional illiterates.

In the name of an elusive ventilation system, non-existent distancing in smart class and zero efficiency of the on-board staff (in the carriage in which I travel a person started coughing insistently and the ticket inspector, who was present, didn't even turn to check). Can someone advise the company that the pandemic is not over?

Really good experience; we chose Italo - First class for the Florence SMN - VeneIa S.L. route.  (A/R) in the middle of the Ferragosto week. Everything was ok really: very comfortable seats and lots of legroom, quiet environment, snack (choice of savory or sweet) and drink, friendly staff, party arrived on time. Well.

Never again, rather I travel by car. Painful assistance, and even for a fee. Complaints impossible except in certain specific cases. Money-consuming vending machines without disbursements, to be avoided.
As usual, Bolzano Roma travels with a delay of between 35 and 45 minutes. It's a terrible habit, detectable both with Italo and with Trenitalia. Then they say to use the train.....

On 08.09.2021, I and 10 other passengers on the Italo train from Peschiera del Garda to Rome Termini were left stranded due to negligence on the part of the Train Manager. In fact, upon arrival in Peschiera the train did not open the doors, not allowing us to board, even though we pushed the green opening buttons on the doors. Furthermore, the train manager didn't bother to understand what was happening. After its very brief stop, the train continued its journey, leaving us on the ground in disbelief at what had happened. Additionally, the exterior door screens were not functional. This event created a considerable inconvenience, even if customer service will take care of fully refunding the ticket. I give 2 stars to Italo with great regret because I have traveled other times with this company and had never had any problems.

There is no bar service on the train. There are no sandwiches or sandwiches at the vending machines. If you don't have coins the staff can't change money and the machines don't accept cards or debit cards!!!

I bought a first class ticket from Venice to Bologna to travel on 7/31/2021. My bagagge got lost. I called Italo to report the incident. They said the train ended in Salerno with any lost item on it. I request to make an investigation *check the cameras to find out who took the my luggage from wagon number 2. They said they are not responsible for missing items. I noticed a couple from Spain had the same problem on their honeymoon. It is unaceptable thay Italo also refused to provide a written report/claim number in order for me to get a new passport and to claim to my insurance. Luis Nunez from NYC, USA

Before the pandemic I spent €195 to buy tickets from them, which I couldn't use due to covid. They sent me vouchers by email after a year. 2 emails, with 2 codes: one for the outward journey and one for the return journey. When I was using the codes, I discovered that the amount was €49... they hadn't given me a full refund. I called (their only paid assistance number) and I was told that my previous trip (which included 2 outward and 2 return trips for a total of €195) had been divided into 4 vouchers worth €49... but per trip, I could only use 2 of them. So to use them all I was forced to make 2 trips (which in my opinion was very incorrect). I point out to the assistance guy that however only 2 of the 4 codes had been sent to me....he tells me that he will start the process to get me the other 2 by email. After 2 weeks, without having received anything, I am forced to call back the paid number, the lady tells me that the colleague has not started any request for the remaining vouchers....so she will request again but I will have to wait 3 weeks (if all goes well) to receive them. I had found a way to use the other 2 vouchers but making a trip for which I had to buy the tickets quickly enough to avoid having to pay a fortune. On the phone I get angry with the girl, it's not possible that they've already played the trick on me by dividing my previous trip into 4 vouchers, without any explanation in the email, where instead I thought that the 2 vouchers received were one for the outward journey and one for the return for a total of €195 (too bad there's no way to verify this except when purchasing a trip), plus the colleague who "forgot" to send me the 2 remaining vouchers, but what a terrible service it is this??? Furthermore, I am told that I cannot even ask for the return of the 2 remaining vouchers by converting them into currency! The young lady, not knowing how to justify herself, hangs up on me........ coming soon, I will be careful not to travel again with a company that treats its customers like this!!

I bought the ticket, from VERONA to NAPLES departing at 6pm and 10pm. The train arrives 5 minutes late and leaves 11 minutes late, during the journey it accumulates more and more delays until arriving at 60 minutes late on arrival. I sat in carriage number 7, where the toilets were out of order, as well as in carriage 6. In carriage 5 there were drink dispensers, wow, great idea considering that it is the 31st of July, unfortunately also those out of service! Well, I spend my time watching Netflix, there's free wifi anyway, ah but it doesn't work, for more than 3/4 of the trip! In short, €70 per ticket, but the worst quality I've ever seen in my life. I would really want to insult in every possible way, but it's no use and in the end, the best thing I can do is never go on ITALO again! Ps. In seat 5 and 6 where I was with my partner, the tables were dirty and we cleaned them ourselves (I say this because throughout the journey a voice recording only reminded the passengers how much they care about cleanliness) oh yes, I saw it! 🤮
There is no distancing. In the "smart" class we travel crowded together as if no pandemic existed. Shameful! I can only advise against using it.

Accurate and recovery of any delays, clean carriages, but a sore point seems to be in refrigerators, although highlighted garlic drawers on the train made journey Caserta Bologna not in well-being. We looked like penguins
To be absolutely avoided. Not very serious and without warning that distancing is not required. If you don't keep Covid, you'll get it

I have always traveled with Trenitalia, weekly, for exactly 10 years with my dog, a cocker, for a timetable issue I purchased a ticket from Padua to Naples with Italo. A NIGHTMARE. Given that I also tried to purchase the ticket for the dog with the app but there was no dog ticket purchase, I called the toll-free number 3 times because they hung up on me, they told me it had to be purchased at least three hours before departure and it costs €50, furthermore only 3 dogs can board the Italo train, they advised me to leave on another day! Madness! I get on the train anyway with a first class ticket and they tell me that the dog without a ticket has to pay a fine of €90, I simply reply that it seems absurd to me even considering that the dog on the hydrofoil pays €4 and on Trenitalia pays €5, doesn't even have a seat but is on the ground next to my feet. The girl who serves the drinks who made the journey from Rome to Naples, of a unique rudeness and antipathy, an hour's journey to make me uncomfortable every every time she passed she said something against the dog that was bothering her, I wonder if you don't want to be in contact with the public, change your job. NB instead of thinking about the dogs, clean the bathrooms which are disgusting. There should be a check on how employees work.
I recently left central Naples thinking that no one would sit next to me due to distancing but instead I was suppressed from Afragola I have a neighbor bhoo 🤨🥺😤😡But it's normal

Non-existent distancing and shameful overcrowding. They say that there are filtering systems that are ok, but if I have the passenger next to me 30 centimeters away, the filtering is of no use at all! The god of money always wins

Terrible experience in 1st class! Stopped between Naples and Rome due to technical failure. Air conditioning stopped and zero air exchange and no distancing. Many people who eat without a mask despite everything. Let's hope we don't catch Covid! Italo to avoid

I travelled from Bologna to Rome, return.  The cheapest tickets are generally around €92, but I forked out slightly more at €98.80 as I was unable to book well in advance (Euro 2020 COVID ticket uncertainty).  However, it was certainly much cheaper than Trenitalia.The trains were modern, the staff extremely polite, the WiFi very powerful meaning I got some work done too.  The whole experience was fine.The outward journey was on time, the second was an hour late although apparently due to an overturned lorry on the track.  That said, don't rely on Italian trains for tight connections when you are cutting it fine.

Zero distancing. The safety meter is no longer respected and passengers are made to sit next to each other with the impossibility of changing seats if they want to respect the rules. Maybe Italo forgot that covid is still here?!

Complaint experience. Train delayed by 20 minutes, we arrived at the station early. We wait half an hour and the train does not appear on the tracks. Obviously, while waiting for the platform that didn't come out, we got distracted for a moment. The moment the platform came out, after 1 minute it left, among other things before the time of the delay it had to make. Terrible, never take Italo again.

journey from Naples, departure at 3.20pm in Bologna on 20 June, carriage no. 6, the air conditioning doesn't work, the train is full... in spite of safety against Covid. Despite the complaints made to the Italo staff, no solution was possible. Train also very dirty. The return form does not include any other items other than those provided by them, therefore no possibility of reporting the disservice. They will never see me on their trains again

Paid assistance..... and you are already beggars! 1.28 euros per minute....of which 6 minutes the employee is silent on the phone and you listen to him typing on the keyboard! I had a problem with monetizing a voucher, after calling the toll-free number for three days in a row, hearing the music for half an hour, they didn't know what to tell me until the last day I was told that perhaps paid assistance could help me.... Well 10 euro top-up, two minutes I speak to explain the problem, a minute to give him the data, 4 minutes of silence and obviously the line goes dead and no solution. Worst customer service! evolve

Last trip Rome - Turin: new "Covid-proof" EPA filters installed, so ALL seats are occupied (to be clear, passengers sitting next to each other, like pre-Covid). But the PRICE of the ticket has not returned to the pre-covid one, not that! Since the pandemic began, ticket prices have almost tripled, which was initially understandable, since there were half the available seats. Now, however, this increase is NO LONGER JUSTIFIABLE, as all the seats are available again.

Rome/Milan train delayed by 2 hours. No assistance. All topped off with a locked door and a crazy buzzer (for 80 minutes of torture and acoustic harassment), without anyone intervening. Train boss in panic, at around 10pm, suggests to people who should have reached Milan by 11pm, to cancel the trip (arranging for accommodation in the capital at their own expense and management) and ask for a refund for the cost of the ticket, obviously through their paid call center. Next, without demonstrating any management skills, the train conductor suggests to the now exhausted passengers to move, equally self-managed, from carriage to carriage (in defiance of any hygiene rules linked to the pandemic), to find a new location and avoid the diabolical continuous buzzer. While the mother of a newborn baby begins to cry in despair due to the complete indifference of the staff to her evident discomfort, in the absence of any information or certainty, we take our luggage and begin to proceed between the carriages, trying to escape the acoustic nuisance. We finally find refuge, much further away, only to be reprimanded by the now mythological train conductor, who scolds us and insinuates our move is an attempt to take advantage of the comforts of this very pleasant journey aboard the phenomenal train, illegally introducing us into first class. As I write, we are still again... undecided whether to laugh or cry about such inadequacy and the misery of those who don't even know how to apologize... as a person and as a company. Once upon a time it was called "blissful ignorance". Rejected without appeal

Zero respect for the civil rules of living healthily on a train (silence, children in their seats) but above all I think that here at Italo they have forgotten about a certain global pandemic that has been going on for a year and a half: ZERO distancing AT THE SEATS (seated next to another passenger, despite the ticket which guaranteed separation and respect for the basic rules) for almost the entire carriage ABSURD LINES at entrance and exit (there is no signage in the direction)

We had to reimburse me for the train of March 9, 2020. Continuous complaints, to get the money back, via voucher, a practice open for a year, suddenly closed. I was forced to call the paid number, spending an additional 5 euros, and they told me that the voucher had already been sent to me at the end of March, which is a bummer considering that the practice has been open for almost a year.  I add more money, the tickets are skyrocketing, in addition to the voucher and money spent, and in the end, due to mix-ups, I miss the train, even though I had the flex ticket. I call the ticket office number and ask if I can somehow recover the ticket. The ticket agent says it's as if I didn't show up and I have to redo the ticket for the next day at the full price, and answers my questions annoyed, for them I always have to call the toll number.  For her I have to spend another 90 euros and that's it, for the Milan-Rome route. I discover on my own that I have enough points to get a free ticket, the telephone ticket office refuses to help me and says that I have to do it with the paid number or with the site... you can't get there directly from the site, I had to make long trips from external links. They make you accumulate points, and they advertise you in every way to make you spend on tickets, but then by giving free tickets, they try not to give them up. Because I didn't get the Voucher back straight away, I went through a year of ups and downs, without ultimately being able to take any trips, despite the 95 euros wasted. For them the voucher was given to me in three weeks, in reality I was not able to use that ticket, and I had to use the points, with great difficulty, in order not to use another 90 euros again.
Terrible service! Disappointed by the quality of the service, the delays incurred and the crude information given to customers, from today I will rely on the much more professional Red Arrow
Worst customer service. Most of the staff is super rude. I got misled by them and ended paying the ticket once again. Never use it...!
Tickets canceled due to covid. After almost a year they still have my money. Nothing to add.

It's the second time I've traveled with them in First Class and everything has always gone smoothly. I always choose Italo for the availability of the single seat (in my opinion even more important now), but even by not choosing that they don't allow 2 people from different families to sit together. Last time 2 hours late due to a fault on the line (so it wasn't their fault) and they also credited me with 25% of the ticket without me asking for it. On board the staff is super friendly and the train is very clean and the disinfectant gel for the hands is made available in every cabin. Satisfied

Very bad. They changed my train time without asking me if it was okay. I try to get assistance and the only service available is a call center costing 1.15 euros per minute. It costs me more to call than to buy a new ticket. Terrible
Classic Italian film! Controls yes, but only for tickets! No respect for the rules, both for Covid and much less for anything else!!

Due to Covid, during the lockdown it was obviously not possible to use the "Italo Più" loyalty reward points. Italo could have extended their validity and instead - very unhonestly - chose to make them partially usable only with the purchase of another 4 tickets within the month of July (then this date was extended to September). Despite having purchased the 4 tickets by July, I did not see the crediting of my points. I was therefore told to wait until September 30th (absurd), but to date (we are in October!) my points have not yet been credited. Furthermore, there is no way to report this disservice, except by calling a PAYMENT number. Dishonesty upon dishonesty. Definitely bad

Round trip from Milan to Florence... no Covid checks either in Milan or Florence!! Zero sanitisation... the train arrived at the platform, just enough time to let the passengers off and they let us on immediately... No checks for access to the platforms... on the train the boy without a ticket was asking for alms for a purchase!!! I would add that the Lounge in the station in Florence was not available, closed due to Covid... while the Frecciarossa one was available...

I have been traveling with Italo for years, but although there are many positive aspects, this time I will limit myself to pointing out what I consider to be the problem NEVER RESOLVED. The on-board staff limits themselves to checking tickets and then disappears, the rules they impose and those of civil coexistence are not enforced. Is the temperature of the carriages intended to keep us young? Is it necessary to travel for hours in a sweatshirt because it must be 10 degrees? But we know the main problem, the controllers, do not check, do not remind travelers to silence ringtones or to use headphones to listen to videos/films and so on. Just as they don't call out parents who let their children scream, demanding that others have to endure it. I would really give it 5 stars but for me education and respect for the rules are the most important things, everything else is optional. So since we all know that the average generic Italian doesn't respect the rules if there isn't someone to call him out or fine him, it's useless for you to bombard our ears with the recording of the rules on the intercom if you, the people in charge of control, don't enforce them!!

They understand problems related to covid, but Italo trains certainly made the situation worse with disorganization and ABOVE ALL WE GOT ON THE TRAIN AND THE SEATS WERE NOT SANITIZED!!! Upon arrival at the station, the passengers got off and we got on directly without any prior sanitization procedure.

I must say that they give the impression of doing the best without means in the sense.... very kind and attentive staff, trains on time but unless you book the compartment just for you... rather uncomfortable seats, lack of bar or restaurant carriage, very little choice in the distributors (it is almost better to bring yourself but eat from home or fast while waiting to arrive)
I chose Italo Treno for the Rome - Venice route and I was quite satisfied. Lots of Covid checks but it's now inevitable... I also liked the portal once connected, really stimulating. Good price.

I found myself with my daughter at the Bologna station in the middle of August (it was at least 35° and we were wearing masks) coming from Trieste well in advance at platform 1, the ITALO train had been announced on the electronic board at the platform with a delay of approx. 30 minutes. Suddenly the announcement with loudspeaker and electronic display board of the change of track from 1 to 6. The ride was useless, the train had already left two minutes after the announcement. At least a dozen people remained on the ground with us. Incredible that the travel assistants did not notice the lack of such a large number of passengers. We were traveling for a family engagement, we had to take another train and then a taxi. "Wasted" costs €150. In addition to the immeasurable (dis)stress, there is also the mockery of a complaint with a form with inadequate windows; a very expensive telephone number; the journey to the post office with a long queue (because even the smallest company and I have a certified email address, while telephone operators are not allowed to communicate it, in addition to the waste of time, there is also the waste of paper and stamps!). The response to the complaint is a copy and paste with my wrong name and an invitation to read the transport conditions or to call the very expensive number again. No PEC address! Now CODACONS. DISASTROUS! SHAMEFUL!  A.F.

Nothing to say. In Italy, the best train. There are always offers, space for large suitcases.. I traveled on the Florence-Turin, Florence-Milan/Bergamo routes. I've always had a great time, which is why I don't even look for alternatives on the Trenitalia website anymore.

Rome-Naples: a disaster, departure 15" late and journey in 1.45" instead of an hour and fifteen minutes. Naples-Rome: perfect! departure on precise time and even arriving early!!! Good sanitation of the carriages. Courteous traveling staff. It's a shame that in the Rome and Naples stations the "Italo" lounges no longer provide seating EVEN IF THEY ARE SPACED to allow waiting for arriving/departing trains.

Avoid using them at all costs! Italo have been using the corona virus as means for them to take customers money without providing any service. They offered us vouchers for their cancelations, where the voucher numbers are not valid or do not exist and customer service refuse to provide any help.

Starting from the premise that I have always traveled with the arrows, I decide to try italo for convenience of timetables, train 8136/38 from Paola to Milan cle., train with continuous creaking of the bin next to the seat, due to Covid as on the arrows the bistro carriage is closed, but doing as on the arrows, with a trolley selling food and drinks would not be difficult, it would be enough to want it, but no... Poorly equipped machines that don't work and without even a money changer, hygiene kit like on the arrows with shopper supplied with masks, head rest, water and gloves not even to pay for it, what can I say to be a private individual so you should be the top, you are at the level of a regional train of the FS, incomparable with the arrows which are superior in every aspect... Italo simply a shame... Never again!!!!

Train from Bergamo to Rome and vice versa, trains on time, going in smart and returning in first class. Clean trains complete with every service, I rediscovered the train compared to the traditional plane, when you arrive you are already in the city centre. In first class they stopped by many times to serve water and snacks. The only flaw was "the Wifi" kept disconnecting, in the end I didn't use it.

I can't give zero stars otherwise I would have done it, after a long time about two years I take an Italo train this morning number 8111 from Milan to Paola, in Bologna my girlfriend had to get on to get off together, once in Bologna the train stops for a few minutes, letting people get off and those who have to get on get on, but only two people manage to get on, after which the train staff, Very incompetent, decides to close the doors and leave without caring about the other people who had to get on, Leaving about thirty people. So I rushed to the conductor asking him to stop and do something. And the conductor's excuse, we are on time, actually a minute late. Now I don't know if the fault lies with the company or with the staff on board. But if he's staff on board I hope they fire him all. While if it belongs to the company I hope that some penalty will be applied to it. Trenitalia is criticized a lot for always being late, but I have been traveling from Milan to Paola for two years, always with Trenitalia and I have never had any problems.

Good morning! I missed the 10.40am train this morning which left before my eyes, unfortunately it can happen to anyone. I went to the Italo office to ask for help, the lady at the kiosk offered me to pay a supplement of 42 euros, including my 20% penalty. In total I paid 111.90 euros for this trip. Do you really want to pay the penalty? For what? They take advantage of the misfortunes of others...!? I think that companies as important as ITALO must take better care of their customers, they have devices and staff to check the presence of passengers and if someone is missing we can leave 10 minutes late. Especially now that very few people travel.

I had purchased 2 Bologna-Napoli tickets for last March. Obviously the trip was canceled due to covid. Italo promised a refund for this. The refund arrived via voucher for only 50% of the expense. In order not to completely lose what I have already spent, I purchase two more tickets for September, which however cost me almost double compared to what I paid for them in March. In the end I spent 2 and a half times what I originally planned so I tell you: I WILL NEVER TAKE A TRAIN AGAIN IN MY LIFE!

DO NOT BUY ITALO TICKETS FOR AUGUST 2ND. THEY WILL PROBABLY BE CANCELLED! Today, 2 August 2020, following the new Ministry of Health ordinance on Covid regulations which reiterates the need for distancing of at least one metre, Italo spontaneously canceled tickets for some passengers (including the undersigned who was supposed to travel on train 8920 of the 4.55pm Rome Termini - Bologna) which had evidently sold hoping the rule would not be renewed and/or using a window period between the expiry of the previous one legislation that imposed distancing and that of 2 August (so much so that on Friday 31 July the distancing on train 8921 at 5.40pm from Bologna to Rome was not guaranteed: the seats were all occupied). Ok, I can understand that you, dear Sg Italo, tried to sell as many tickets as possible during an alleged "window period" but I find it SCANDALOUS that this morning, upon receiving the cancellation email (among other things, received with a few hours' notice of departure), you continued to make tickets available for purchase for today... without darkening the boxes for IMMEDIATE PURCHASES (as your competitor company Trenitalia did which, dear Sg Italo, gave me confirmed that it had immediately blacked out purchases for high speed in order to be able to relocate, in compliance with the regulations, the majority of passengers who had already purchased... thus guaranteeing them the scheduled journey). Your Tickets, which if purchased today for today, dear Sg Italo, confirmed to me by your assistance, will probably be canceled from the buyers immediately afterwards. ABSURD! Ps: your refund will not make me forget, with a view to a future purchase, the inconvenience caused to me today by your disorganization. PPs: at 3.45pm on August 2nd the 4.55pm Italian train 8920 which was canceled for me can still be purchased via the app!
Voucher for Covid arrived very late (after a battle costing a lot of money and patience), not monetizable and money wasted. Shame on you.

I bought my Italo train ticket at short notice from a self service kiosk at Milano Centrale station. I booked a smart class ticket, similar to Frecciarossa Standard Class. The train arrived into the platform a few minutes late so boarding was rushed but it wasn't long before the train departed. The Smart Class carriage was impressive with all leather seating and a decent amount of legroom. There was a footrest as well as charging points at each seat. The ride at 300km/h was quite lively but comfortable enough. Arrival into Torino Porta Nuova was about five minutes behind schedule. I enjoyed the journey with Italo trains and I would be happy to use them again

First of all, let’s get the good stuff out if the way cause it’s quicker. The trains are clean and usually faster and cheaper then Train Italia for long distance trains. It’s usually a pleasant experience. That being said, DO NOT use them if you have to make a tight connection or are relying on them to be on time because more often then not, they won’t be.
If everything goes well, it's convenient, but if there's a slight problem, customer support simply doesn't exist.

Never use this train service!!! 7 of us booked from Milan to Firenze. As we arrived in Milan at different times, one couple booked 1 hour after us. They paid EUR30 each whereas we paid EUR50 each. When I questioned this, the lady stood up, shouted at me and pushed me out the door. She said some people get specials and others dont. Within an hour of booking exactly the same train, something doesn't add up. I would understand if they booked before as it would work on first come first served, but after!!! We were also told to book 1st class it was a similar price, we did that because the booking lady said we would get service at least twice on the journey. The cart comes around once, has the worst coffee available and the snacks are not like anything that was described. On top of all of this, our return journey was paid for at the same time as the outbound journey. We told the lady we need to be back in Milan at 10AM and she advised getting the 7:30AM train from Firenze. However she booked us on the 7:30PM train which we only noticed whilst on the train. The conductor said its not a problem, when you get to Firenze just change it and they will probably ask for more money but tell them no (He knew exactly what would happen). We get to Firenze, we query with them and lo and behold, charged extra to change (another EUR15) for a mistake made by their company. She said well you should have checked!!! We said we didn't expect your staff to be so poorly trained in something as simple as booking a train ticket! Last but not least, we get to Florence at 7 for the train, its cancelled and have to wait for the next one, no notification sent to us even though they had our contact details! We will NEVER use this company again and I suggest no one else does, unless you understand Italian and their complex pricing/scam system! Even then, goodluck!!!

we bought several months ago. I had intended to visit Italy (Milan, Rome, Venice, Florence and Genoa) since 11 until 19 March 2020. Unfortunately, due to worse epidemiological situation in Italy, Wizz air (flight company) canceled all flights from Kutaisi (republic of Georgia) to Milan. I'm feeling so angry because they We were refused refund money back. our Embassy wants to help us and send them official legal letter but they don't have email addres. i don't understand how is it possible than in 21 century company can work without email. I think they are hiding is. They are liars and I don't suggest use their service.

The Italian government requires all passengers from China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan to quarantine for 14 days after entering the country. That is to say, after we got off the plane, we could only stay in the hotel for 14 days, otherwise we would be punished. Therefore, the ITALO tickets we booked at that time became unusable and we applied for a refund from ITALO, but ITALO refused. It really felt bad! In addition, ITALO LO did not provide an email to contact me. All their emails were for advertising. I would never get a reply. I called more than 10 times before I finally got through. The service staff’s English was terrible and they hung up on me. I felt that ITALO made me feel like I had encountered a fraud group. I can only give the lowest evaluation to ITALO and Italy. . Italy government has asked anyone come from China(including Taiwan) need self-isolation for 14 days as we entering ITALY. So it's impossible for us to use the ticket for travel from ROME other cities; however, ITALO refused to refund us.BTW, they don't provide EMAIL to communicate, all of the EMAIL they provide are only for advertising.Phone number is so hard to dial in, and I have to call more than 10 times to get through. Most important of all, their English speaking and listening really sucks!I think that ITALO like a scam group to me. I could only give the lowest rating to ITALO and this country.

You can purchase tickets in advance on Italo's official website, but it is convenient to use Omio, a European train and plane ticket app, which makes it easy to compare prices and displays them in Japanese. We were worried about carrying large suitcases, so we booked the special vehicle "Club Executive". I was able to enjoy my train journey with peace of mind because I was able to leave my luggage in a place where I didn't have to worry about it being stolen. However, if I had a small suitcase, I could put it in the shelf above my seat, so I thought the 1st class "Prima" was sufficient. The seat itself hasn't changed much. Prima also has snack and drink service. A perk of Club membership is access to lounges located at each station. Delays were frequent. The platform number will not be displayed on the bulletin board until 10 minutes before departure, so I was nervous before I got used to it.
A dialogue of fools, I can't communicate with them, €100 went for nothing, I'm looking for an email to reach them.. Anyone knows, I'd love to receive it.. Thank you

Italo is a private fast train transport but is a scam. We receive an expense of 90$ in our credit card for a ticket bought in their app that we never did. Just Fraud.Trying to speak with them 2,5 bucks for 10 sec call. Stay away from them. Italian Mafiaaaa
We bought the ticket online and traveled from Rome to Florence. Comfortable and spacious armchairs. Very pleasant trip!

We took the privately operated Italo train from Naples to Rome and it was just slightly cheaper at the time of booking than the comparable competitor, Frecciarossa offered by Trenitalia. I prefer the Trenitalia app and website as it updates during the journey and states the platform number for departures and arrivals. On Italo it didn’t state which platform for departure even until right at departure time and we needed to ask. Its also a bit of a hassle having to run both apps if you are travelling generally throughout Italy by train. The Italo reservation system also seats all passengers together even if the rest of the carriage is empty. I think Italo is a bit of hype riding the coat tails of the ferrari name. In future I’ll probably just stay with Trenitalia, however choice is a good thing.

I'll start by saying that both on the outward journey and on the return journey it was very punctual!!! On the return journey it is not acceptable that in the last carriage the services were not accessible already at the departure and that the remaining ones were already dirty at the departure. It's a shame because the train is also excellent for punctuality.

A few days ago I involuntarily forgot my trolley on the Italian train when getting off at the Bologna stop. The train was headed to Naples so I immediately called the assistance number to report it. The operator told me that essentially, even if the train is still running, no one can contact the on-board staff to have the luggage put aside, but you have to wait for the conductor to read the notification sent and IF he finds the luggage he will call you back. In the end the line went dead because the credit ran out (€1 per minute if you call from your cell phone) since I was struggling to figure out how to recover my luggage before it was stolen. In short, I didn't receive any calls from any train conductor. Only the following day did an assistant at the Naples station find my suitcase abandoned on platform 24 and call me saying that he would deliver it to the Polfer (which among other things I discovered later that it doesn't keep abandoned suitcases). Maybe the train conductor left it there because he didn't feel like contacting me? In short, no one bothered to go and check in the 3 hours in which the train from Bologna arrived in Naples, and say that there were staff on board (there were even those from Telethon): terrible service for a high-speed train which in my opinion should offer a completely different service to the customer. Anyone can forget something on the train, even more so if it's a train like this you really expect completely different assistance.

This company offers exclusively high-speed trains and connects the major Italian cities. We traveled from Naples to Padua and found the experience much more pleasant and relaxing than driving or flying. Tickets can be reserved online and the boarding experience at Naples train station was easy and timely. Our reserved seats were comfortable and there was plenty of room for luggage. Coffee, other beverages and snacks were offered throughout the ride at no cost. There was a restaurant car where you could buy more substantive food and/or beverages, including wine and beer. It took about four hours to ride from Naples to Padua, with about 7-8 intermediate stops. That is a shorter time than flying, since there are no direct flights between those two cities. Italo is not as luxurious as the Japanese Shinkansen or the French TGV, but it is a pleasant and functional alternative that allows you to enjoy the scenery of the beautiful Italian countryside.
You pay €45 for a trip, the bathrooms are narrower than a regional train, the Wi-Fi doesn't work and neither do the power sockets to charge your smartphone or PC. Horrible, not recommended.

We were in a rush and so were not able to book the ticket at the station kiosk. We were trying to book the tickets while boarding and it did not accept as a minute has passed post the train time. Since we were on the train  we thought of purchasing the ticket from the Ticket Inspector. She pushed us to buy the most premium ticket saying the regular seats not available. She also made us buy a ticket for the infant. Later we realised many regular seats were empty. Sheer cheating from a private operator.Also washroom at the end of the train with baby diaper changing table was not working. You go from coach 1 to coach 8 only to realise it is closed. Very poor management.Please be careful

Me and my family took a .italo train trip from firenzi to Naples, and we never felt so disrespected in our entire life! The company did no gave us any assistance! We got in touch 24h before the trip (by phone, as requested) to get the lift to the train, and when we got at the station, surprise: not only there was no lift, they tried to make us pay 60+ euros for special seats (even when we told that the only issue was the stairs to get inside the train, cuz my mom could walk from the door to her previously choosen seat). The employees were completely rude and misinformed. Did not offer any type of useful information (including sending us to ANOTHER COMPANY ROOM, saying that they should solve our problems). We will never travel in .italo’s trains ever again, even if we need to walk to our destination.For those who need assistance to get inside the train: they will charge you for seats you don’t wish to buy, justifying them as “company rules”! - notice: their website does not say anything about extra fees.Once you get at the train station, don’t even bother trying to get any assistance (especially if you are a foreign family). Inside the train, the employee only checked for OUR tickets - TWICE! - (and the trains was completely full). We felt very offended.The company should be more prepared to deal with their costumers needs, not the other way around.Not to say only bad things: the trains are new and comfortable (but we found some bottles e papers left from the previous passengers, so I cannot say it was clean).

We travelled from Venice to Rome at 10.05 Italo train (red bullet train). While the interior is clean and tidy and great service. The only downside is that al the window so dirty and we cannot see clearly what happening outside/looked like. As tourist we would like to see many things about The trips including while on a train. I think all the window need to be clean before start to do the service.
In my opinion one of the best train companies in ItalyFree WiFi on board the trainClean In 1st class drink service included

Italo is a private company that offers high-speed train service. Identified with the acronym NTV which means new passenger transport. We traveled twice, joining the routes from Rome to Florence and then to Salerno. The cars or floats as they are called in Italy are comfortable, the bathrooms were in good clean condition, a good place to store luggage, they have vending machines for drinks or snacks and they always left on time. We bought the ticket in advance from Buenos Aires. It was our first experience in this type of transportation and it really is an excellent way to travel.

Overall a great experience. Got to sit in a comfortable seat in Prima, not crowded, a little table and a charging point. There may have been wifi, but I had my own available so am not sure. The trip was maybe just under 4 hours and seemed to fly by (pardon the almost pun). The trip itself was comfortable and the train was pretty quiet. I bought my tickets at the last moment so was as much as a plane fare on the same day, but hear that tickets bought in advance, you can get some pretty good deals. Food and drinks available, and I'm sure I had a free coffee at some point. Bit of a grey and rainy day so can't say that the view was what I was hoping for, apart from that, I recommend giving the train trip a go.

Firstly, we bought our tickets at the station. (Rome Termini) This is our real and honest review. There are 3 parts that they failed under customer service.  1) Purchasing of tickets, touting seemed to be allowed at termini. When we were at the Rome Termini, there is a guy who posed as the train assistant who tried to con us money.He is in brown jacket, blue eyes, with a lanyard I Love Rome. Do look out for him as he is con man and will try to get money from you, either through the train tickets or some tips. He will worked closely with Italo Railway. The real Italo train assistants will try to help him con you as well (both at the ticket office and in their ticket room) and do nothing but watch you being conned. He is very persistent and will make his point to get some money now. He got angry with us when we refuse his help for 3 times. (we obviously didn’t buy from him) The guy being a con man lurking around the station is already bad enough. However, the customer service officers of Italo train, shouldn’t they be doing something. I checked Italo’s reputation, it seemed Italo is not that fantastic and have multiple rating of one star across Google, trip advisor and etc. I believe Italo’s target customers include tourists, probably Italo need to do something about this to help boost their reputation?! 2) When we walked to their office to buy our own tickets,  I mentioned to the ticket officers about the shady man, instead of acting on it. To my shock, they just shrugged away the question and brushed us away. They still shook their head in dismay towards us as we walked away. Worst customer service! 3) During the purchase of our tickets, not much explanation was given, what is our seats are like. When prompted, they just say, it’s like first class ??? When we board the train, it’s not first class ! We were seated opposite strangers. How is that first class? Disappointing. At the end, Italo when googled, you will hear that they are more prestigious and fast. I doubt so. I am much better off with their national train. The bad rating about italo are more accurate than the positive ratings. We are tourists, we are more easily deceived and they do treat tourist as a 2nd class in Italo. They don’t really has any regard for tourists. Other Italians were given better seat than ours. If people were to ask me about my opinion on Italy, I will tell them not to come to Italy as the customer service is really bad from their train stations. The expectations for Italy trains are already set low but they managed to go lower :( Such a upsetting memory of Italy.

We departed Venice during a time when it was hardest hit by flood. Luckily as well as amazingly the trains were operating. At the station, we started with the .italo ticket machine until we come to the ticket type and time selection. Next to the machine was a manned booth with a customer, so we looked around to see standing behind us an .italo rep Andre. He speaks English and is very helpful. Definitely he saved us an hour of wait time for the next train as he kept answering no problem, conveying to us that the entire ticket to boarding process is shorter than what we have grown accustomed to in Europe.The .italo has a club lounge for those choosing the club ticket with a cabin of 4 on a coach. Lounge is nice and clean, with helpful staff, and a very spacious and clean  WC, with baby changing station. The cleanliness of the lounge WC can ease even the pickiest parents stressed about finding the best space to change their babies.The coach itself is clean and well kept. Luggage racks very suitable for carry-on type luggage.The train trip itself was smooth and relaxing. Although the trip lasted 3hrs and 50min plus delays, we were informed all the time of the amount of delay incurred which end up to be 20 minutes more. One of my companion can get motion sickness but did the entire trip without any issues since it was very smooth, fairly constant speed, and relaxing all the way. Small snack and drink choices were offered.I really enjoyed their service and would definitely take their trains again.
We took this train twice in Italy and it was amazing, the trains were clean fast and always on time. Great job ITALO team!

We used Italo services when traveling from Rome to Florence. Trains arrived back and forth without delays. Travel time is 1 hour 30 minutes. The trains are very similar to our Sapsan. The seats are comfortable, and there is a coffee machine in carriages 3 and 6. The trip turned out to be very comfortable. We bought tickets at the box office just before departure, but you can buy them in advance.

We had the opportunity to ride the Italo express train a total of 2 times: from Milan to Venice (1st class) and from Venice to Florence (2nd class). The express train was on time and the service was very good. The 1st class seats are very comfortable, like airplane seats. The seats are adjustable, there is a reading light, a charging plug. There are service staff serving coffee, drinks, and snacks, and there is a self-service counter for coffee, water, and snacks. The 2nd class seats are the same. The only difference is that they only serve coffee and drinks.   Importantly, the price is not very expensive. Considered very impressive

Europe is famous for its super-fast rails and how we can skip this in our 17 days journey. We had booked Italo train for most of the legs of our trip. Sometimes I got a really good deal, sometimes it was expensive. But for the trip, it never disappointed me. It started on time, reached the destination on time. Either it was Prime, smart or Comfort class, seating was comfortable.  Especially, Rome to Naples journey was very smooth. Top speed was 300km/h. I even clicked the photo of its dashboard.They have Wi-Fi onboard (unlimited for deluxe coach). Designated space for keeping your 28-30 inch luggage.  The restroom was super clean. In Prima & Club, you can buy (or pre-order) an Eataly lunchbox for around €16-€19.  Complimentary coffee, soft drinks, wine, or prosecco is served from a trolley. There's no bar or restaurant car, but passengers can use the coffee machine and vending machine. You're free to bring your food & drink onboard...Italo is a private company that started operating Italo high-speed trains on the Milan-Florence-Rome-Naples route in the beginning.
